styles.line: America lost 1.3 million bee colonies, yet the count rose 6 %: a news short that works with the sound off.
styles.line_cn: 美国一年死掉 130 万箱蜜蜂，总数却涨了 6%：静音也能看懂的新闻。

styles.line: 1926: the papers say the Charleston will ruin America's knees; at Ford's own picnic the kids dance it anyway.
styles.line_cn: 1926 年报纸说查尔斯顿会跳坏膝盖，福特工人野餐会上的孩子照跳不误。

styles.line: The last minute of the Artemis II launch, uncut: one cell opens to nine, and they merge into one at ignition.
styles.line_cn: 阿尔忒弥斯二号发射的最后一分钟，一秒不剪：格子从 1 开到 9，点火合成 1。

styles.line: One day in New York in time-lapse: rivers of light, a grid on the sixteenths, 1899 beside today.
styles.line_cn: 纽约的一天：延时光河、踩着十六分音符的网格，1899 年和今天并排。

styles.line: Newsreel, photos, testimony and the 1937 inquiry on one clock: five sources point to the same spot.
styles.line_cn: 新闻片、照片、证词和调查报告排上同一条时间轴，五路来源指向一处。

styles.line: The Empire State's 1931 brochure credits its builders; the site film and Hine's photos answer: 2,500 a day.
styles.line_cn: 帝国大厦的小册子写着建造者，工地实拍和老照片给出答案：每天 2,500 人。

styles.line: Down 3–0 at half-time, Fenerbahçe scored three in 12 minutes: freeze, draw, split screen, shot map.
styles.line_cn: 半场 0–3，费内巴切 12 分钟连进三球：冻住画面、画线、分屏、射门图。

styles.line: Four AI stories from one week in a full on-air package: rundown, headline strap, price board, spec card.
styles.line_cn: 一周四条 AI 新闻，一整套电视台包装：串联单、标题条、翻牌价格表、规格卡。

styles.line: A satellite follows the map to the Aral Sea and finds a desert; only the part someone dammed came back.
styles.line_cn: 卫星照着地图去找咸海，找到的是沙漠；只有筑了坝的那一块回来了。

styles.line: Four bridge types are tested on one briefing wall, and the ship that must pass under picks the winner.
styles.line_cn: 一条河要架桥，四种桥型在一面简报墙上逐个受检，拍板的是桥下要过的船。

styles.line: A laser survey strips the canopy off a Connecticut forest and finds 3.4 km of old farm walls.
styles.line_cn: 激光点云剥掉一片森林的树冠，露出当年农田的石墙：3.4 公里。

styles.film: How a Flattened City Grew Back
styles.line: A projector paints Rotterdam's white model layer by layer, from the 1940 gap to today's towers.
styles.line_cn: 投影机把数据一层层刷上鹿特丹白模：从 1940 年的空洞到今天的塔楼。

styles.line: Twelve years of wind and solar stacked as real plates, spiralling round a walnut dial until solar overtakes.
styles.line_cn: 十二年风电和太阳能装机叠成实物，绕表盘升成两条螺旋，2021 年太阳能反超。

styles.line: Half an open-source keyboard comes apart in one orbit, down to the chip, then closes with its real dimensions.
styles.line_cn: 开源键盘的一半在一次环绕中逐层拆开，看到主控再合拢，标上真实尺寸。

styles.line: One continuous move from a liver slide to a single nucleus; two circles, counted pixel by pixel, differ 2.4 times in blue.
styles.line_cn: 一镜从肝组织玻片推到单个细胞核，两个圆逐像素数出 2.4 倍的蓝。

styles.line: The telegram said 57 seconds; under a loupe, the Wrights' glass negatives and the archive say 59.
styles.line_cn: 电报说最长飞了 57 秒；放大镜下，莱特兄弟的底片和档案说是 59 秒。

styles.line: The moon can't sleep, so a little girl climbs onto the roof to sing it a lullaby.
styles.line_cn: 月亮失眠了，小女孩爬上屋顶给它唱摇篮曲。

styles.line: Follow the rain from Australia's red desert heart to its green coast in one unbroken painted walk.
styles.line_cn: 跟着降雨从澳洲红色腹地一路画到绿色海岸，一镜到底。

styles.line: A swordsman crosses the river on the water and splits the current with a single stroke.
styles.line_cn: 侠客踏水过江，一剑断流。

styles.line: In a grey, rainy square one red umbrella opens, and a waltz paints the whole plaza in colour.
styles.line_cn: 灰色雨中广场，第一把红伞撑开，圆舞曲把整个广场刷上颜色。

styles.line: One unbroken line draws a whole life, then the pen passes to a child.
styles.line_cn: 一根不离纸的线画完一个人的一生，再把笔交给孩子。

styles.line: How your phone knows where you are: GPS, atomic clocks, and the 38 microseconds relativity adds every day.
styles.line_cn: 手机怎么知道你在哪：GPS、原子钟，和相对论每天多出的 38 微秒。

styles.line: A park that is only a pen sketch; wherever the wind carries her straw hat, colour follows.
styles.line_cn: 公园只是一张钢笔速写，风把草帽吹到哪里，哪里才有颜色。

styles.line: Ten suns scorch the earth until the archer Hou Yi draws his bow, told with leather puppets on a lit screen.
styles.line_cn: 十日炙烤大地，后羿张弓射日。

styles.line: A traveller walks toward a distant mountain; every shot is a woodblock print, a great wave at the climax, the mountain and the whole scroll at the end.
styles.line_cn: 旅人走向远山，每个镜头都是一幅版画；巨浪是高潮，结尾是远山与整幅画轴拉远。

styles.line: On New Year's Eve the beast Nian comes to town, and one girl's giant paper-cut lights up the village to scare it off.
styles.line_cn: 除夕年兽进村，小女孩剪出的大窗花照亮全村，把它吓跑。

styles.line: A single mooncake tells the Mid-Autumn story of reunion and longing inside a glowing paper-cut lightbox.
styles.line_cn: 一枚月饼讲中秋的团圆与思念，纸雕灯箱层层透光。

styles.line: A Sunday-morning bike ride through the city — bakery, park, riverside — each stop adding an ink until three misregistered plates overprint.
styles.line_cn: 周日早晨骑车穿过城市：面包店、公园、河边，每到一处加一版油墨，最后三版套印。

styles.line: A chubby orange cat stands trial for testing gravity and 4 a.m. parkour, and walks free.
styles.line_cn: 橘猫胖橘被立案审查：测试重力、凌晨跑酷，最后无罪释放。

styles.line: A village spends a whole winter casting one bell; the first time it rings, the snow stops.
styles.line_cn: 村子用一整个冬天铸一口钟，钟声第一次响起，雪停了。

styles.line: A natural-history plate engraves itself: the burin cuts the copper, the bee builds up line by line, and a watercolour wash brings it to life.
styles.line_cn: 一张博物志图版自己刻出来：雕刀推开铜版，蜜蜂一线线成形，最后手工水彩上色。

styles.line: Three trail posters are screen-printed one ink at a time, then climbed in one long take from noon to dusk.
styles.line_cn: 三条步道各一张丝印海报，一色一刮印出来，再沿山脊一镜到底从正午爬到黄昏。

styles.line: A concert poster lays itself out by five Swiss design rules; the fifth is to break just one.
styles.line_cn: 一张音乐会海报按瑞士设计的五条规则自己排版，第五条是只打破一条。

styles.line: Opening titles for an imaginary 1964 spy film: a chase for a stolen key until the shapes lock into the title.
styles.line_cn: 虚构 1964 年间谍片的片头：追一把被偷的钥匙，几何碎片最后拼成片名。

styles.line: A grand hotel, 1930: a bellboy races lifts and revolving doors to deliver one letter before midnight.
styles.line_cn: 1930 年的大饭店，门童赶在午夜前把一封信送上顶楼。

styles.line: An inventor's blueprint draws, explodes and assembles a cloud-catching machine, and its revision cloud starts to rain.
styles.line_cn: 发明家的蓝图自己画出一台接云机器，修订云线变成了真的雨云。

styles.film: The Dragon of the East Window
styles.line: Sunlight crosses a cathedral window from dawn to dusk, waking each pane of a knight-and-dragon tale.
styles.line_cn: 阳光从清晨移到黄昏，照到哪一格花窗，哪一格的故事就动起来。

styles.line: All 43 sports of the 2026 Asian Games as beat-locked geometric pictograms.
styles.line_cn: 2026 亚运会 43 个大项，几何象形人卡着节拍快闪。

styles.line: A moon-base AI wakes after forty years to a signal from Earth, and replies by drawing “home” in characters.
styles.line_cn: 月球基地的 AI 沉睡 40 年后被唤醒，用字符画出“家”来回复。

styles.line: A hundred years of summer temperatures, where the chart itself tells the story.
styles.line_cn: 一百年的夏季气温，图表本身就是故事。

styles.line: A coffee's journey from the plantation to your hands, across one isometric world.
styles.line_cn: 一杯咖啡从种植园到你手里的旅程。

styles.line: Launch film for Tidy, a fictional app: one buried cursor snaps hundreds of windows back into place.
styles.line_cn: 虚构 app Tidy 的发布片：被埋掉的光标一键把几百个窗口归位。

styles.line: Clawd hops out of the terminal into the Claude app and acts out plan mode and self-checks in one take.
styles.line_cn: 像素小人 Clawd 搬进 Claude 应用，一镜到底演示 Plan 模式和自检。

styles.line: An e-bike is scanned into a hologram; target boxes lock onto the battery, motor and brakes.
styles.line_cn: 电助力车被扫描成全息线框，目标框依次锁定电池、电机、刹车。

styles.line: A coffee cup chases a runaway sugar cube around the kitchen, 1930s-cartoon style.
styles.line_cn: 一只咖啡杯满厨房追一块逃跑的方糖。

styles.line: A courier girl rides through a rain-soaked neon city to deliver a tape before the dawn launch.
styles.line_cn: 快递少女骑车穿过雨后霓虹都市，赶在黎明发射前送到一盘磁带。

styles.line: A jaded genius opens a portal just to buy coffee and tumbles through ever-stranger universes.
styles.line_cn: 厌世天才开传送门只想买杯咖啡，却穿过越来越离谱的平行宇宙。

styles.line: A robot vacuum set up in three steps, told like a 1950s classroom film.
styles.line_cn: 用 50 年代教育片的口吻，三步教你装好一台扫地机。

styles.line: At the final boss door a hero saves the game, and the save screen replays the whole journey.
styles.line_cn: 勇士在最终 Boss 门前存档，存档画面闪回一路冒险。

styles.line: The lighthouse goes dark; a girl carries the last flame through a night forest and up the storm cliffs.
styles.line_cn: 灯塔熄灭，孙女提着最后一簇火穿过夜林、爬上风暴悬崖。

styles.line: A clumsy cadet survives a five-second boot camp, faster and faster, until the boss: landing home.
styles.line_cn: 见习宇航员闯五秒训练营，越来越快，Boss 关亲手降落回地球。

styles.line: The history of AI as a rhythm game: models take the stage on the beat, and a report card closes the show.
styles.line_cn: 把 AI 发展史做成一局节奏游戏，模型踩着拍登场，最后发成绩单。

styles.line: A baker's boy chases a runaway loaf downhill, then breaks it in half for a hungry girl.
styles.line_cn: 面包店学徒追一个滚走的面包，最后掰成两半分给饿肚子的小女孩。

styles.line: A new night-shift hire films their first night in an endless yellow office, following the rules on the wall.
styles.line_cn: 新夜班员工拍下入职第一晚：无尽的黄色办公空间，和墙上的员工守则。

styles.line: A brick astronaut builds a rocket from spare parts and flies to a brick moon.
styles.line_cn: 积木宇航员用零件拼出火箭，飞向积木月亮。

styles.line: A pop-up book opens on a desk; a sprite named Pip adventures through paper worlds and jumps out into ours.
styles.line_cn: 立体书在书桌上打开，小精灵 Pip 在纸片世界冒险，最后跳出书外。

styles.line: Morning rush hour in a town that looks like a model: traffic, trains and tiny people.
styles.line_cn: 玩具城的早高峰，一切都像模型。

styles.line: An island and its village grow tile by tile from an empty sea, each tile a note, into a starry night.
styles.line_cn: 空海里一格格长出小岛和村庄，每放一块响一个音符，直到星空。

styles.line: Unboxing and close-ups of Aura, fictional glass earbuds, in strip-light sweeps and caustics.
styles.line_cn: 虚构玻璃耳机 Aura 的开箱与特写。

cinema.title: OPUSCAR 98 · 98 Years of Best Picture
cinema.note: One style per film. t0/dur: where the film sits in OPUSCAR 98 (seconds). render: 2D / 2.5D (3D models rendered into flat layers) / 3D; dim adds the tone (B&W, sepia). prompt_*: a reusable style prompt. shots: the cuts as they appear in the finished film.

films.title: Wings
films.style_zh: 默片 3D 空战 · 正色片黑白 + 琥珀染色
films.desc_en: A three.js dogfight graded like a 1927 orthochromatic print: white skies, deep blacks, an amber tint, gate weave and scratches. Wings is remembered for aerial combat shot from cameras strapped to the planes, so most cameras here ride on the planes.
films.desc_zh: 用 three.js 搭的一战空战，按 1927 年正色片拷贝调色：天空发白、黑位很深、整体琥珀染色、片门抖动和划痕。《翼》最出名的是把摄影机绑在飞机上拍的空战，所以这里大部分机位都装在飞机上。
films.prompt_en: Smooth-shaded 3D graded as a silent-era orthochromatic print: high contrast, reds go black. Sky near-white, ground in readable mid-greys, deep blacks (25-35% of frame) only in silhouettes. Tint: blend whites half-way toward amber #FFCC80, so the sky is pale cream-amber, never solid orange; blacks stay black. Only the hero the story centres on keeps colour, whole figure at ~70% saturation (e.g. #D97757); every lamp, fire or other light source stays grey. 24 fps gate weave (±1 px), flicker (±5%), fine grain (±4%), 1-3 thin scratches, sparse dust, rounded corners, vignette; open on a 1 s iris. Signature shot: a camera rigged to something moving with the subject, rig in frame; then chase and POV. Cut every 2-3 s; white out through cloud, smoke or glare. Reference: William Wellman, *Wings* (1927). Avoid: motion blur, colour in the greys.
films.prompt_zh: 平滑着色的 3D 按默片正色片拷贝调色：高反差，红色发黑。天空近白，地面留清楚的中灰层次，深黑占画面 25%–35%，只在剪影里。染色：白位向琥珀 #FFCC80 混一半，天空是淡奶油琥珀，不要整片橙；黑位不变。只有故事围绕的那个主角留色，整个人都留，饱和度约七成（如 #D97757）；灯火和其他光源一律是灰的。叠 24 fps 片门抖动（±1 像素）、闪烁（±5%）、细颗粒（±4%）、一到三条细划痕、稀疏灰尘，片门圆角加柔和暗角，第一镜 1 秒圆形光圈打开。招牌镜头：机位绑在跟主角一起动的东西上，露出一截支架，轻微震动；再接跟拍和主观镜头。每 2–3 秒一切，穿过云、烟或强光白场转场。对标 William Wellman《翼》（1927）。避免：运动模糊、灰阶里有颜色。

shots.en: Head-on over the cowling: Clawd in a leather cap with goggles pushed up sits between the struts; the iris opens and the camera pushes in slowly.
shots.zh: 机头正前方对着座舱：Clawd 戴皮飞行帽、护目镜推在额头，夹在两根支柱中间；圆形光圈打开，镜头缓缓推近。

shots.en: Wide aerial: the planes circle among the clouds above patchwork fields and chalk trenches, one Fokker trailing black smoke; a slow push in.
shots.zh: 大全景：机群在云间盘旋，下面是格子田和白垩战壕，一架福克拖着黑烟；镜头缓缓推近。

shots.en: Cowling camera with engine shake: Clawd looks back at the Fokker on its tail and raises an arm as the twin Vickers flash.
shots.zh: 机头机位带发动机震动：Clawd 回头看咬尾的福克，抬起一只手，双挺维克斯机枪开火闪光。

shots.en: From the Fokker's upper wing, its guns firing, chasing Clawd's SPAD ahead; the camera rides fixed to the enemy plane.
shots.zh: 从福克上翼看出去，敌机机枪开火，追着前方 Clawd 的 SPAD；机位固定在敌机上。

shots.en: Over Clawd's shoulder as the SPAD dives: the upper wing and wires in front, shell craters and zig-zag trenches rushing up.
shots.zh: 过 Clawd 肩头的俯冲镜头：前面是上翼和张线，弹坑和折线战壕迎面扑来。

shots.en: The SPAD, ghostly in the cloud bank, flies at the camera; the fog thickens until the frame whites out to cream.
shots.zh: 云团里的 SPAD 像幽灵一样朝镜头飞来，雾越来越浓，画面白到奶油色。

films.direction_en: Clawd is the American pilot: leather cap, goggles, white scarf, seated in the SPAD. The prologue hands over to the opening frame and the iris opens in the first beat; then five hard cuts, roughly every two beats. Around beat 5 Clawd looks back and the guns fire, and the cloud shot whites out into the cream that opens No. 2.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮美军飞行员：皮飞行帽、护目镜、白围巾，坐在 SPAD 座舱里。开场序幕接到第一镜，第 1 拍光圈打开；之后五刀硬切，大约两拍一切。第 5 拍前后它回头、机枪开火；最后穿云白场，接上第 2 部开头的奶油白。
refs: RFC aerial photographs of the Somme, 1916–18

films.title: The Broadway Melody
films.style_zh: 黑金银装饰艺术歌舞海报
films.desc_en: An Art Deco revue poster in black, gold and silver: airbrushed gradients, a stepped proscenium, a chrome condenser mic. It is 1929 Broadway at the height of Deco, and the film where sound arrives, so rings of sound pour out of the mic.
films.desc_zh: 会动的黑金银装饰艺术歌舞海报：喷枪渐变、阶梯形台口、镀铬电容麦克风。1929 年的百老汇正是装饰艺术盛期，这部又是有声片降临的一部，所以让声波从麦克风里一圈圈放出来。
films.prompt_en: Art Deco revue poster. Black lacquer ground; gold and silver from banded metallic gradients (3-5 hard bands); airbrush glows, sunbursts, ziggurat steps, streamlined curves; a stepped proscenium frame of gold lines and bulbs. Palette: ground #0A0908, gold #D6B560, highlight #F3E2A2, silver #BFC4C9; skin pale silver-cream; one saturated accent (e.g. #D97757) only on the hero the story centres on. Elongated Erté-style figures with real faces; fringe, sequins or feathers where the subject allows. Fine grain, glints, stars. Frontal symmetry, a central spotlight. Motion: chasing bulbs, a row of repeated elements (dancers, waves, columns) rippling toward the centre, rings radiating from the main sound or light source; slow pushes, cut on the music's beat (without music, every 2-3 s). References: A. M. Cassandre's posters, Erté's costumes. Avoid: flat yellow for metal, faceless figures, extra hues.
films.prompt_zh: 装饰艺术歌舞海报。黑漆底；金和银都用分带金属渐变做（每个面 3–5 条硬分界），喷枪光晕、放射线、阶梯形、流线型，场景外圈套一道层层退进的金线台口框，嵌一排灯泡。色板按用途：底 #0A0908，金 #D6B560，高光 #F3E2A2，银 #BFC4C9；皮肤用淡银奶油色；只有故事围绕的那个主角用一个饱和强调色（如 #D97757）。人物是 Erté 式修长造型，有五官表情，题材允许时加流苏、亮片或羽毛。细颗粒、闪光点、星星。正面对称，中间一束追光。动起来：灯泡流动，一排重复元素（舞者、浪头）向中心卷成波浪，主要声源或光源放射环纹；镜头慢推，踩音乐的拍子切，无乐每 2–3 秒一切。对标 A. M. Cassandre 的海报、Erté 的服装设计。避免：平涂黄色冒充金属、人物没脸、多余的颜色。

shots.en: Out of the white: the Astor Theatre marquee, 'THE BROADWAY MELODY / ALL TALKING · ALL SINGING · ALL DANCING', bulbs chasing; Clawd with boater and cane at left; a slow pull back.
shots.zh: 从白场里淡入：Astor 剧院的雨棚招牌（THE BROADWAY MELODY / ALL TALKING · ALL SINGING · ALL DANCING），灯泡流动；Clawd 戴硬草帽、拿手杖站在左边；镜头缓缓拉远。

shots.en: The whole stage: Deco proscenium, chorus girls on the risers, Clawd tapping beside the giant condenser mic as it starts pouring out sound rings; a slow pull back.
shots.zh: 舞台全景：装饰艺术台口、台阶上的歌舞女郎，Clawd 在巨大的电容麦克风旁踢踏，麦克风开始一圈圈放出声波；镜头缓缓拉远。

shots.en: Close on the chrome spring-ring mic, rings radiating and notes flying; a push in.
shots.zh: 镀铬弹簧环麦克风特写，声波放射、音符飞出；镜头推近。

shots.en: Truck along the kick line: feathered headdresses, sequins, legs kicking in a wave.
shots.zh: 沿着踢腿队列横移：羽毛头饰、亮片短裙，腿一排排踢成波浪。

shots.en: Clawd in close-up, tapping, the boater tilting, the mic ring behind; a slight push in.
shots.zh: Clawd 近景，踢踏中草帽一歪一歪，身后是麦克风环；轻推。

films.direction_en: Clawd is the hoofer in a straw boater with a black cane, tapping all the way through. The film fades in from No. 1's white; on beat 4 the mic comes alive and the sound rings pour out (the talkies arrive). Four hard cuts run street → stage → mic → chorus line → Clawd.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 是戴硬草帽、拿黑手杖的踢踏舞者，从头踢踏到尾。开头从第 1 部的白场里淡入；第 4 拍麦克风活过来，声波涌出（有声片来了）。四刀硬切：街口 → 舞台 → 麦克风 → 歌舞队 → Clawd。

films.title: All Quiet on the Western Front
films.desc_en: A woodcut after Käthe Kollwitz: big masses of black, white knife-cut contours, rough grain, with Clawd printed from its own orange block. Kollwitz's German anti-war prints of 1921–22 come from the same war and the same grief as the film.
films.desc_zh: 珂勒惠支式木刻：大块的黑、刀刻的白轮廓、粗糙木纹，Clawd 用单独一块橙色版套印。珂勒惠支 1921–22 年的反战版画，和这部片出自同一场战争、同一种悲痛。
films.prompt_en: Expressionist woodcut after Käthe Kollwitz, *Krieg* (1921-22). 60-70% solid black; white contour cuts 1/300-1/150 of frame width separate forms; faces are white shapes with a few black features; hands large. Figures fill the frame, cropped by its edges. Each cut tapers in and out with chipped edges, is wider the nearer it sits to the light, in slightly uneven bundles. Ink #17130F on paper #E8DFCA; texture is only wood-grain streaks and under-inked speckle (±5%). One colour block (e.g. #D97757) only on the hero the story centres on, flat on its body or clothes, cuts over it; black stays 60%+. Light enters through one opening (window, cloud gap); lamps get a short ring of cuts. The ground under figures stays uncut black. Quiet motion (breathing, a small gesture); slow pans and push-ins. Avoid: grey fog or midtones, even striped hatching, gore.
films.prompt_zh: 仿凯绥·珂勒惠支《战争》组画（1921–22）的表现主义木刻。画面六到七成是实黑；形体之间用白色轮廓刀分开，刀宽为画幅宽的 1/300–1/150；人脸刻成白形，只留几笔黑五官；手要大。人物占满画面，被画框裁切。每刀都有尖的进刀收刀和碎木边，离光越近的刀越宽，刀痕成组排、节奏略不均。墨色 #17130F 印在 #E8DFCA 纸上；纹理只有木纹条和缺墨斑点（±5%）。只有故事围绕的那个主角套一块色版（如 #D97757），平铺在身体或衣服上，刀痕照样压在上面，黑仍占六成以上。光只从一个开口进来（窗、云缝）；灯只刻一小圈短刀痕。人物脚下的地面留不刻的黑。动作安静（呼吸、一个小手势）；慢摇、慢推。避免：灰雾灰调、排刀规整成条纹、血腥。

shots.en: Pan along the trench past carved faces: one soldier with his face in his hands, one staring in fear, one asleep.
shots.zh: 沿战壕横摇，扫过刻出来的脸：一个双手捂脸，一个惊恐地看着，一个睡着了。

shots.en: Tight on a soldier's face under the steel helmet, staring straight out (a nod to the 1930 poster); a slow push in.
shots.zh: 钢盔下一张直视镜头的脸（致敬 1930 年原海报）；慢推。

shots.en: Medium: Clawd in a Stahlhelm on the firing step slowly reaches toward the loophole, where a white butterfly sits on a tin; a push in.
shots.zh: 中景：Clawd 戴德军钢盔站在射击台上，慢慢把手臂伸向射击孔，孔沿铁罐上停着一只白蝴蝶；镜头推近。

shots.en: Close on the white butterfly at the loophole, Clawd's orange arm entering from the left; a push in.
shots.zh: 射击孔边白蝴蝶特写，Clawd 的橙色手臂从左边伸进来；推近。

shots.en: Wide over no-man's land to a cemetery of white crosses under a flare; a ghost column fades in, walking away; a slow pull back.
shots.zh: 大全景：照明弹下的无人地带和白十字架墓地，幻影士兵的队列淡入、往远处走去；缓缓拉远。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Paul in a German Stahlhelm. The film is held slow (1.2×) and quiet: the reach starts around beat 3 and takes three beats to stretch out, and the ghost soldiers appear only in the last shot. Four hard cuts go from the faces in the trench to Paul's arm, the butterfly and the field of crosses.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮保罗，戴德军钢盔。整段放慢（1.2 倍）、压得很静：第 3 拍前后开始伸手，用三拍慢慢伸到底；幻影士兵只在最后一镜出现。四刀硬切：战壕里的脸 → 保罗的手臂 → 蝴蝶 → 十字架墓地。

films.title: Cimarron
films.desc_en: A gold-toned albumen panorama of 1889: soft lens, a little pan blur, cream highlights and umber shadows, silver grain; only Clawd is hand-tinted. Cimarron opens on the 1889 land rush, so it is shot as a photograph of that year, keeping the chapter monochrome.
films.desc_zh: 1889 年的金调色蛋白印相全景：柔焦、轻微的横向拖影、奶油高光和暖褐暗部、银盐颗粒，只有 Clawd 手工上色。片子开场就是 1889 年俄克拉何马圈地狂奔，用那一年的照片质感来拍，这一章也保持单色。
films.prompt_en: A moving 1880s gold-toned albumen photograph. Paint soft-edged flat shapes by brightness: main subjects dark (15-30%), ground 50-60%, sky about 90%; visible hatching and grass tufts (lines ~1/300 of frame width). Then print: grayscale, slight blur (~1/800 of frame width), a faint smear of three horizontal offset copies growing with camera speed, multiply cream #F2DCB4, lift blacks to umber #2E1C0F, blotchy development (±5%), vignette to #785634, per-frame grain (±4%), dust, scratches. Hand-tint only the hero the story centres on (e.g. #D97757) as transparent dye, mask feathered 2-3 px; lamps stay sepia. Wide panorama: the middle band packed with repeated small elements (figures, animals, vehicles; for a lone subject fences, posts, trees), no big plane dominating. Camera: one 4-5 s ease-out pull back from the hero to the panorama. Avoid: hard ink outlines, colour beyond the hero, a flat grey print.
films.prompt_zh: 会动的 1880 年代金调色蛋白照片。先画边缘柔和的平涂形，按亮度分：主体深（15%–30%），地面 50%–60%，天空约 90%；物面和草丛有看得见的排线（线宽约画幅宽 1/300）。再“印”：转灰度，轻柔焦（约画幅宽 1/800），三层横向错开的淡影随运镜拉长，乘奶油色 #F2DCB4，黑位抬成暖褐 #2E1C0F，显影不匀（±5%），暗角压到 #785634，每帧刷新颗粒（±4%），稀疏灰尘划痕。只给故事围绕的那个主角手工上色（如 #D97757），像透明染料，蒙版羽化 2–3 像素；灯光仍是棕褐。横向全景，中间一条带排满重复小元素：人物、动物、车辆，题材冷清就用篱笆、木桩、树；别让一整块大面占满画面。天空默认发白。运镜：从主角近景 4–5 秒缓出拉到全景。避免：硬墨线、主角以外的颜色、干净的数码天空、发灰的印相。

shots.en: Starts tight on Clawd riding a black horse at the head of the run and pulls all the way back until the whole rush is in frame: schooners, a coach, a sea of riders in the dust.
shots.zh: 从骑黑马冲在最前的 Clawd 近景开始，一路拉到全景：篷车、驿站马车、尘土里一大片骑手。

shots.en: Cut to Clawd close on horseback: it raises the Colt and fires into the air, the frame jolting with the recoil; a slight push in.
shots.zh: 切到 Clawd 骑马的近景：举起左轮朝天开枪，画面随着后坐力一震；轻推。

films.direction_en: Clawd is Yancey Cravat in a white Stetson and a neckerchief, riding a black horse at the front. The run plays at 1.1×. The camera first pulls back to show more horses, then one cut to the close shot, where Clawd draws and fires on beat 5.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮扬西·克拉瓦特：白色宽边牛仔帽、领巾，骑黑马冲在最前。整段按 1.1 倍跑。先拉远看到更多的马，再一刀切回近景，第 5 拍拔枪朝天开火。

films.title: Grand Hotel
films.style_zh: 米高梅银色黑白 3D 大堂
films.desc_en: A three.js model of the circular lobby, graded in MGM's silver black and white with Clawd's orange as the only colour. The film's best-known image is the shot straight down the well, galleries closing in rings, so the set is built around it.
films.desc_zh: 用 three.js 建的圆形大堂，按米高梅的银色黑白调色，Clawd 的橙是唯一的颜色。这部片最出名的是从顶上笔直往下拍、回廊一圈圈收进去的镜头，整个布景就按这一镜来建。
films.prompt_en: A real 3D set, by default an Art Deco interior (marble, chrome, chandelier, glossy checkerboard floor); outdoors keep the real setting with glossy surfaces (wet pavement, still water) and symmetrical framing. Ambient occlusion, soft bloom; 1930s studio silver: about 40% deep black, glossy whites near 90%, no washed-out greys. Light falls in shafts from one high source. All neutral grey except the hero the story centres on (e.g. #D97757), at least 1/6 of frame height; warm lamps render white, bloom only around them. Grain (±3%), halation. Signature shot: eye-height wide into a deep symmetrical set, floor and ceiling in frame, floor reflections; then 4-6 s tracks; one overhead on rings, figures as chess pieces. Period figures (heads, hats, limbs) walk routes. References: art director Cedric Gibbons, cinematographer William Daniels. Avoid: walking in place, frame-filling abstract patterns, colour casts.
films.prompt_zh: 真 3D 场景，默认装饰艺术风大堂（大理石、镀铬、吊灯、亮面棋盘格地面）；室外保留真实场景，表面做出光泽（湿路面、静水），构图对称。环境光遮蔽加柔和辉光，调成 30 年代片厂银色黑白：约四成画面深黑，白位亮度约九成，不发灰。光从一个高处光源成束落下。只有故事围绕的那个主角留色（如 #D97757），至少占画面高度六分之一；暖灯渲染成白光，辉光只在灯旁。颗粒（±3%），灯旁光晕。招牌镜头：平视大全景，望进对称纵深，地面和天花同时入画，地面有倒影；再接 4–6 秒的侧向跟拍；俯拍同心圆、人像棋子只用一次。年代人物有头、帽、四肢，按路线走。对标美术指导 Cedric Gibbons、摄影师 William Daniels。避免：原地踏步、抽象图案铺满画面、偏色。

shots.en: Straight down the six-gallery light well, the rings closing toward the key tower; the orange bellboy is a single dot crossing the checkerboard marble; a slow push in as the lens narrows.
shots.zh: 从天窗下笔直往下看：六层回廊一圈圈收向钥匙塔，橙色门童是棋盘格大理石上唯一的一个点，正走过地面；镜头慢慢推近。

shots.en: Side tracking shot at Clawd's height: it walks with its suitcase, the lobby sliding past, the revolving door turning ahead; the camera eases forward and in.
shots.zh: 贴着 Clawd 身高的侧面跟拍：它拎着皮箱往前走，大堂从身后滑过，前方旋转门在转；镜头边跟边往前、往里靠。

films.direction_en: Clawd is the bellboy in a pillbox cap, carrying a suitcase covered in hotel labels. It really walks, 1.4 m/s at 2.4 strides a second, matched to the distance it covers. The film plays 1:1 with one hard cut at 1.08 s, from the overhead to the tracking shot.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮门童，戴圆筒小帽，拎一只贴满旅馆标签的皮箱。它是真的在走：每秒 1.4 米、2.4 步，步子和位移对得上。整段 1:1 播放，1.08 秒处从俯拍一刀切到侧面跟拍。

films.title: Cavalcade
films.desc_en: A Mucha-style Art Nouveau panel: swelling brown outlines, pastel flats, a mosaic ground and a halo behind the central figure. Cavalcade opens on New Year's Eve 1899 with a family toasting the new century, so the halo is a clock striking twelve.
films.desc_zh: 慕夏式新艺术装饰画：膨胀的褐色轮廓线、粉彩平涂、马赛克底，中心人物身后一个光环。电影开场就是 1899 年跨年夜一家人举杯迎接新世纪，所以光环做成敲十二点的钟面。
films.prompt_en: Alphonse Mucha colour lithograph. Brown contours #4B3326, about 1/250 of frame width, doubling on the shadow side (light from upper left), tapered ends; pastel flats, each with a hard-edged darker shadow tone. Palette: cream #F5ECD6 paper/sky, sage #A9B490 foliage/drapery, pale gold #CFA55A halo/ornament, rose #DBA49C skin/flowers; the hero the story centres on in one stronger accent (e.g. #D97757). Wide frame: figure and a big ring-filled halo in the middle third, arched panels either side, behind them a muted-teal (sage plus grey) square-tile mosaic; whiplash vines, local flowers; a bottom band of serif capitals in the user's language, 1/25 of frame height. No plain area over 1/8 of frame. Almond eyes, heavy lids; hair or cloth in three-tone strands. Litho grain, paper mottle, vignette. Slow sway; tilt down to the halo, pull back. Avoid: thin clean lines, saturated colour, empty backgrounds.
films.prompt_zh: 慕夏式彩色石印。褐色 #4B3326 轮廓线，宽约画幅宽 1/250，背光侧（光默认从左上来）加粗到两倍，两端收尖；粉彩平涂，每块在背光侧叠一层深一档的硬边色。色板：奶油 #F5ECD6 作纸和天空，鼠尾草绿 #A9B490 作植物衣褶，淡金 #CFA55A 作光环装饰，玫瑰 #DBA49C 作皮肤和花；故事围绕的那个主角用一个更浓的强调色（如 #D97757）。横幅：人物和细环纹大光环居中三分之一，两侧拱格，后面铺灰青（鼠尾草绿掺灰）方块马赛克；鞭线藤蔓和花草；底部一条衬线大写铭文，用用户语言，字高约画面 1/25。留白不超过画面八分之一。杏仁眼、厚眼睑；头发或衣料三色成束。石版颗粒、纸斑、暗角。慢摆；下摇到光环再拉远。避免：干净细线、饱和色、空荡背景。

shots.en: Tilt down from the CAVALCADE title and the galloping-horse frieze onto the clock halo, pushing in; the hands close on XII and the halo flares on the stroke.
shots.zh: 从 CAVALCADE 标题和奔马横饰带往下摇到钟面光环并推近；指针合到 XII，敲钟那一下光环一闪。

shots.en: Medium on the toast: Clawd in a top hat and white bow tie springs up and raises its coupe while Jane and Robert raise theirs from either side; a slight pull back.
shots.zh: 举杯中景：戴高礼帽、白领结的 Clawd 一跳，举起香槟碟，两侧的简和罗伯特也举杯；轻拉。

shots.en: Pull back to the whole Mucha panel: glasses raised, rose petals falling, the band 'LONDON · XXXI DECEMBER MDCCCXCIX · A NEW CENTURY' at the foot.
shots.zh: 拉远到整幅慕夏装饰画：三只杯子举着，玫瑰花瓣飘落，底部是 LONDON · XXXI DECEMBER MDCCCXCIX · A NEW CENTURY 铭文带。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays one of the Marryots at the toast, in a silk top hat and white bow tie with a champagne coupe. The clock strikes twelve on beat 3 and the halo flares; the shot cuts straight to the toast, where Clawd hops and raises its glass. Played 1:1: two hard cuts, then a pull-back that settles on the whole poster.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 是举杯的马里奥特家一员：丝质高礼帽、白领结、手持香槟碟。第 3 拍钟敲十二点、光环一闪，紧接着切到举杯，Clawd 一跳把杯子举起来。1:1 播放，两刀硬切，最后一个拉远停在整张海报上。

films.title: It Happened One Night
films.desc_en: A 1934 black-and-white rubber-hose cartoon: thick-thin ink, pie-cut eyes, white gloves, cel shading over grey watercolour backgrounds, with film grain. It is the film's own year, and a road comedy gag suits cartoon timing.
films.desc_zh: 1934 年的黑白橡皮管卡通：粗细变化的墨线、饼切眼、白手套，赛璐璐平涂叠在灰阶水彩背景上，带胶片颗粒。和电影同一年，公路喜剧的笑点也适合卡通的节奏。
films.prompt_en: Early-1930s black-and-white rubber-hose cartoon. Characters: noodle limbs, white gloves, pie-cut eyes, round heads; thick-thin ink #141414 (1/400-1/150 of frame width) swelling away from the light (default upper left); fills pure black and white plus at most one light grey for the hard shadow, gloss on blacks. Backgrounds stay mid-grey (30-80%), never pure black/white: graphite lines left in, grey watercolour washes with pooled edges and granulation, paper grain. Only the hero the story centres on has colour (e.g. #D97757): its whole body, or its one key prop if the hero is human. ±1 px gate weave, grain (±4%), flicker, scratches, dust. Actions anticipate, overshoot, settle: squash on landing, stretch on fast moves, eyes pop when surprised, a camera jolt on hits. References: Fleischer's Betty Boop shorts; Disney's Silly Symphonies backgrounds. Avoid: smooth vector lines, grey characters merging with the background.
films.prompt_zh: 30 年代初的黑白橡皮管卡通。角色：软管四肢、白手套、饼切眼、圆脑袋，三到四头身；墨线 #141414 粗细变化（画幅宽 1/400–1/150），背光一侧变粗（默认光从左上）；角色平涂只用纯黑、纯白，加至多一种浅灰作硬阴影，黑面一道高光。背景只用中间灰（明度 30%–80%），不用纯黑白：铅笔线不擦，灰色水彩罩染，边缘积水有颗粒沉淀。只有故事围绕的那个主角带颜色（如 #D97757）：整个身体，主角是人时只给关键道具。加 ±1 像素片门抖动、24 fps 颗粒（±4%）、闪烁、划痕、灰尘。动作都有预备、冲过头再回落：落地压扁、快动拉长、吃惊时弹眼，碰撞时镜头轻震。对标弗莱舍工作室的 Betty Boop 短片、迪士尼《糊涂交响曲》的背景。避免：光滑矢量线、角色发灰和背景糊在一起。

shots.en: Close on Clawd's gloved thumb and smug face, the empty road behind, a car coming over the rise; a slow push in.
shots.zh: Clawd 竖起的白手套大拇指和得意的脸，身后是空路，一辆车从坡顶开过来；慢推。

shots.en: Two-shot: Clawd thumbing on the verge, Ellie on the fence rail hitching her skirt up to the calf; a slight pull back.
shots.zh: 双人镜头：Clawd 在路边竖拇指，艾莉坐在栅栏上把裙摆撩到小腿；轻拉。

shots.en: The payoff, wide: the car skids to a stop between them, the driver's eyes popping out; Clawd's eyes go wide, gloves open, hat jumping; the camera jolts on the stop.
shots.zh: 收尾全景：车在两人中间急刹，司机眼珠弹出来；Clawd 瞪大眼、张开双手，帽子跳起；急停那一下镜头一震。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Peter in a grey fedora, loosened striped tie and pencil moustache, with white gloves on its arm tips. Ellie lifts her skirt on beats 3–4; the car skids to a stop on beat 5, the one moment played at 1×, and Clawd's jaw-drop lands on it. Two hard cuts: thumb → two-shot → payoff.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮彼得：灰色软呢帽、松开的条纹领带、一撇小胡子，手臂末端戴白手套。第 3–4 拍艾莉撩裙子，第 5 拍车急刹停下（只有这一下放回 1 倍速），Clawd 的目瞪口呆正好卡在这一下。两刀硬切：拇指 → 双人 → 收尾。

films.title: Mutiny on the Bounty
films.desc_en: An 18th-century Admiralty sea chart engraved in copperplate, with rhumb lines, compass roses, soundings and thin hand colour; the Bounty is a ship vignette on the sheet. The film is a voyage, so the whole film stays on the chart.
films.desc_zh: 18 世纪英国海军部海图的铜版画：恒向线、罗盘玫瑰、水深数字、手工淡彩，邦蒂号是图上的一幅船舶插画。这部片讲的是一次航行，所以整段都留在海图上。
films.prompt_en: A late-18th-century copperplate map, default an Admiralty sea chart (inland: a survey map). Fine burin hatching and cross-hatching (lines ~1/1200 of frame width) give all tone; a minimum line width makes small detail darken, not vanish. Ink #1C1610 on laid paper #EFE3C4, light foxing, folds. Thin hand colour: water #9EBCBC along edges, land #B8C08C; the hero the story centres on (e.g. #D97757) is the one strong colour. Rhumb lines from 32-point roses, a graduated border, hachured hills, cartouche, one ornament (e.g. a sea monster), serif lettering. Put the action in an unboxed engraved vignette fading into the chart, filling 60-75% of frame height at the end of the move. Camera: one 5-6 s glide from the whole sheet into the vignette, chart still around it; a dotted route inks itself in. Avoid: cropping the paper, heavy washes, stiff figures.
films.prompt_zh: 18 世纪末的铜版地图，默认是英国海军部海图（内陆题材换成测绘图）。明暗全靠刻刀细排线和交叉排线，线宽约画幅宽的 1/1200；线宽设下限，细小处变暗而不是消失。墨色 #1C1610 印在 #EFE3C4 直纹纸上，带淡霉斑和折痕。只上很薄的手工淡彩：沿水边的海蓝 #9EBCBC，陆地 #B8C08C；故事围绕的那个主角（如 #D97757）是唯一的浓色。32 向罗盘玫瑰拉出恒向线网、刻度边框、晕滃山形、装饰图名框、一个装饰物（如海怪）、衬线字。情节放进一幅不加边框的排线插画，排线向纸面渐隐；推到底时插画占画面高度 60%–75%。运镜：一个 5–6 秒的镜头从整张图滑进插画，四周留着地图；一条虚线路线自己画出来。避免：切出纸面、浓重水彩、僵硬的人物。

shots.en: One continuous move: from the whole chart, with the Bounty sailing her dotted track, the camera glides in to the ship vignette, rhumb lines and roses still around it; on deck Clawd swings the cutlass up and points Bligh away as the launch falls astern and its track to Timor inks itself across the sheet.
shots.zh: 一镜到底：从整张海图开始，邦蒂号沿虚线航迹前进，镜头滑进图上的船舶插画，四周仍是恒向线和罗盘玫瑰；甲板上 Clawd 举起弯刀、指着布莱让他下船，小艇落到船尾，驶向帝汶的航迹在图上一路画出来。

films.direction_en: Clawd is Fletcher Christian in a bicorne worn athwartships, cutlass in hand. The film never leaves the chart: one glide, no cuts. The cutlass goes up on beat 4 and levels at the launch a moment later with a glint, while the launch drifts astern through the last beats.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮弗莱彻·克里斯蒂安：横戴双角帽、手持弯刀。整段不离开海图，一个镜头滑进去，不切。第 4 拍举刀，紧接着刀锋一闪指向小艇；最后几拍小艇往船尾漂开。
refs: Robert Dodd, The Mutineers turning Lieut. Bligh… adrift (1790)

films.title: The Great Ziegfeld
films.style_zh: 银色黑白 3D 螺旋婚礼蛋糕舞台
films.desc_en: A three.js model of the revolving spiral 'wedding cake' stage in MGM's silver black and white: satin, chiffon and ostrich feathers against deep black, Clawd the only colour. The 175-step spiral of 'A Pretty Girl Is Like a Melody' is the film's famous set piece.
films.desc_zh: 用 three.js 建的旋转螺旋“婚礼蛋糕”舞台，米高梅银色黑白：缎面、雪纺和鸵鸟羽毛衬在深黑里，只有 Clawd 是颜色。《A Pretty Girl Is Like a Melody》那座 175 级的螺旋舞台是这部片的名场面。
films.prompt_en: Real 3D stage spectacle in 1930s studio silver: the subject's world built as a revue set on a round tiered platform turning about 3° per second, draped and garlanded; its people become rows of costumed chorus figures with faces and arms. Costumes light satin grey, set mid-grey, pleated curtain backdrop darker, theatre deep black; whites below pure white. Soft front key; brighter rim lights edging satin and feathers near-white. Faint shafts, grain (±3%). All neutral grey except the hero the story centres on (e.g. #D97757); lamps render white. Signature shot: low medium along the tiers, figures 1/4-1/3 of frame height, the hero on the front tier. Then a 3 s curtain rise, a 10 s crane up to a level medium of the hero. Reference: Robert Z. Leonard, *The Great Ziegfeld* (1936). Avoid: flat lighting, faceless cones, fast spinning.
films.prompt_zh: 真 3D 舞台大场面，调成 30 年代片厂银色黑白：把题材的世界搭成圆形分层转台上的歌舞布景，慢慢转（每秒约 3 度），挂满垂幔花环；题材里的人变成一排排穿戏服、有脸有手的合唱队。灰阶：戏服浅缎灰，布景中灰，褶皱大幕更深，剧场深黑；白色不到纯白。正面柔和主光，轮廓光更亮，把缎子和羽毛的边勾到近白。淡光柱，颗粒（±3%）。只有故事围绕的那个主角留色（如 #D97757），灯都渲染成白光。招牌镜头：贴低的中景沿层台看过去，人物占画面高度四分之一到三分之一，主角在前排。再接帷幕升起（3 秒）、10 秒吊臂上升，落到平视主角的中景。对标 Robert Z. Leonard《歌舞大王齐格飞》（1936）。避免：平均打光、没脸的锥形人、转得太快。

shots.en: Low front shot: the chiffon curtain flies up off the revolving cake, revealing tiers of fan-girls with Clawd tiny at the top; the camera tilts up.
shots.zh: 正面低机位：雪纺帷幕从旋转的蛋糕舞台上飞起，一层层举扇的女郎露出来，顶上是小小的 Clawd；镜头往上仰。

shots.en: Crane up the spiral past the feather fans, a white grand piano and the violinists, stopping short of the top.
shots.zh: 沿螺旋吊臂上升，扫过羽毛扇、白色三角钢琴和小提琴手，停在顶层之下。

shots.en: Near-level medium on Clawd at the summit in an ostrich-feather headdress: it turns to the camera and flings its arms up into a V; a slow push in.
shots.zh: 几乎平视的中景：顶上的 Clawd 戴鸵鸟羽毛头饰，转身面对镜头，双臂甩成 V 字；慢推。

films.direction_en: Clawd is the star at the top of the cake, wearing a rhinestone band with a fountain of ostrich plumes. The scene runs at 1.2×, and the star is saved for the last cut: Clawd turns, hops and throws its arms into the V on beat 5. Two hard cuts link curtain, crane and summit.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 是蛋糕顶上的明星：水钻头带上一丛鸵鸟羽毛像喷泉一样翻落。场景按 1.2 倍跑；明星留到最后一刀才露脸，第 5 拍它转身、一跳、双臂甩成 V 字。两刀硬切连起帷幕、吊臂和顶层。
refs: Cedric Gibbons and John Harkrider (sets and costumes)
Oliver T. Marsh, Ray June, George Folsey (cinematography)

films.title: The Life of Emile Zola
films.style_zh: 报纸活字印刷 + 线刻插图
films.desc_en: Letterpress newsprint with 1890s line engraving: a wood-type headline, dense columns of lead type, ink spread and under-inking on yellowed paper, figures in hatching. The film's best-known image is L'Aurore's 'J'Accuse…!' front page of 13 January 1898.
films.desc_zh: 报纸活字印刷加 1890 年代线刻插图：木活字大标题、密排铅字正文，泛黄新闻纸上的油墨外扩和缺墨，人物用排线画。这部片最有名的画面就是 1898 年 1 月 13 日《震旦报》的《我控诉》头版。
films.prompt_en: 1890s newspaper print. Set text as a sharp mask, then print: ~1 px blur and a noisy threshold for ink spread, ragged edges, under-inked patches, faint mirrored show-through. Page grammar: masthead, a wood-type headline across the width (~1/6 of frame height), 3-6 columns of small type in the user's language (~1/80 of frame height) flanking one large engraved picture. Wood-type letters are grained blocks. Everything pictured is a line engraving: hatching lines about 1/1000 of frame width, spaced 1/400, following the form, cross-hatching only in darks, heavier shadow-side contours, paler distance. Warm black #17130F on newsprint #E8E0CC; the hero the story centres on gets one accent plate (e.g. #D97757), offset 1-2 px. Motion: type blocks slam down, bounce and leave their print; one repeating mechanical motion, pages turning. Avoid: clean digital type, smooth grey shading, other colours.
films.prompt_zh: 1890 年代的报纸印刷。文字先排成清晰墨版再“印”：约 1 像素模糊加噪声阈值切边，做出油墨外扩、字边毛糙、局部缺墨、淡淡的背面镜像透字。版面语法：报头、横贯全宽的木活字大标题（约画面高度 1/6）、3–6 栏小字正文（用用户的语言，字高约画面 1/80）夹着一幅大线刻插图。木活字一字一块，带木纹。所有画面都是线刻：线宽约画幅宽 1/1000、间距约 1/400，顺着形体走，交叉排线只用在暗部，背光一侧轮廓加粗，远处用淡墨。暖黑 #17130F 印在新闻纸 #E8E0CC 上；故事围绕的那个主角单独一块强调色版（如 #D97757），套印偏 1–2 像素。动起来：活字块砸下、回弹、留下印迹；一个反复的机械动作，报纸翻页。避免：干净的数码字体、平滑灰调、其他颜色。

shots.en: Close on the L'Aurore front page dated 13 January 1898: the wood-type letters of 'J'Accuse…!' drop in one by one and the page jolts as the last one lands; a push in.
shots.zh: 《震旦报》头版特写（JEUDI 13 JANVIER 1898）：“J'Accuse…!”的木活字一个个砸下来，最后一个落下时整版一震；镜头推近。

shots.en: Medium on Clawd as Zola in front of the page: it looks up from its newspaper, springs up and thrusts the quill high, a newsboy shouting at right; a slight pull back.
shots.zh: 中景：扮左拉的 Clawd 站在头版前，从手里的报纸上抬起头，一跳，把鹅毛笔高高举起，右边报童在叫卖；轻拉。

shots.en: The rotary press running, a printer holding up a wet sheet, papers flying out; the camera pulls back and trucks right.
shots.zh: 轮转印刷机在转，印刷工举起湿报纸，报纸一张张飞出来；镜头拉远并向右移。

films.direction_en: Clawd is Zola in pince-nez, with a quill and that day's paper. The last letter lands on beat 2 and the page jolts; on beat 3 Clawd's head comes up and the quill shoots up. The scene runs at 1.05×, and two hard cuts go headline → Zola → press.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮左拉：夹鼻眼镜、鹅毛笔、手里拿着当天的报纸。第 2 拍最后一个字母落下，整版一震；第 3 拍它从报纸上抬头，鹅毛笔高高举起。场景按 1.05 倍跑，两刀硬切：大标题 → 左拉 → 印刷机。
refs: Le Petit Journal and L'Illustration line engravings

films.title: You Can't Take It with You
films.desc_en: A 1930s WPA silkscreen poster: six flat opaque inks, split-fountain gradients, slight misregistration on rag paper. The Federal Art Project posters of 1936–39 were American graphic design of the film's own years, and they keep it apart from No. 10's newsprint.
films.desc_zh: 30 年代 WPA 丝网海报：六色不透明平涂油墨、分色渐变、轻微套印错位，印在棉浆纸上。1936–39 年联邦艺术计划的海报就是这部片同年代的美国平面语言，也和第 10 部的报纸拉开距离。
films.prompt_en: A 1936-39 WPA (Federal Art Project) silkscreen poster. Six opaque inks printed light to dark, each later screen cut away around lighter shapes (clouds, sun): cream #F0E2C0 for light, ochre #E0A842 and vermilion #C84A2A for sky and warm planes, teal #22686E for water and shade, the hero's own ink (e.g. #D97757, only on the hero the story centres on), brown keyline #322018 last. Shadows: a darker ink overprinted, never grey. Big areas get split-fountain blends: two inks in 2-3 coarse steps, the middle one their overprint. Screens 1-3 px off register; wandering stencil edges, squeegee streaks, warm rag-paper grain (±5%) on every flat. Figures fill 1/2-2/3 of frame height: big planes, crescent shadows, expressive faces. A bold capital title band, user's language. Slow pushes; screens pop in one by one. Avoid: halftone dots, smooth gradients, clean vector flats.
films.prompt_zh: 1936–39 年 WPA 联邦艺术计划的丝网海报。六色不透明油墨从浅到深套印，后印的版要在不该盖住的浅色形（云、太阳、高光）处镂空：奶油 #F0E2C0 给光和云，赭 #E0A842、朱红 #C84A2A 给天空和暖色面，青 #22686E 给水和阴影，主角专用色（如 #D97757，只用在故事围绕的那个主角身上），最后印深棕描边 #322018。阴影是深一色叠印，不用灰。大面积用分色渐变：两色 2–3 级粗台阶，中间一级是两色叠印。每版套偏 1–3 像素，模版边缘游移，刮板拖痕、漏印，平涂上都有暖色棉浆纸纹（±5%）。人物占画面高度二分之一到三分之二：大块面、月牙形暗面、棕色描边、脸有表情。留一条粗体大写标题，用用户的语言。慢推，一版一版弹出来。避免：网点、平滑渐变、干净的矢量平涂。

shots.en: The whole Vanderhof living room as a poster: Clawd as Grandpa in round glasses plays harmonica in the teal wing chair, Essie dances on pointe in the window, Kolenkhov shouts the count, De Pinna pops out of the cellar hatch; a slight pull back.
shots.zh: 整个凡德霍夫家客厅，像一张海报：Clawd 扮爷爷，戴圆眼镜坐在青色扶手椅里吹口琴，埃西在窗前踮脚跳舞，科伦科夫高喊拍子，德皮纳从地下室活板门里探出头；轻拉。

shots.en: Close on Clawd with glasses and harmonica, notes drifting up, De Pinna at the edge of frame; a push in.
shots.zh: Clawd 近景：圆眼镜、口琴，音符往上飘，德皮纳在画面边上；推近。

shots.en: Back on the room as the cellar fireworks go off: rockets, starbursts and smoke columns fill it; the camera pulls back.
shots.zh: 回到客厅，地下室的烟花炸开：火箭、星爆和烟柱填满屋子；镜头拉远。

films.direction_en: Clawd is Grandpa Vanderhof: round wire spectacles and a harmonica, crutches leaning on the chair. The whole household keeps doing its own thing at once while the cellar fireworks build through the last shot. Two hard cuts: room → harmonica → fireworks.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮凡德霍夫爷爷：圆形金属框眼镜、口琴，拐杖靠在椅子边。一屋子人各干各的，地下室的烟花在最后一镜里越炸越大。两刀硬切：客厅 → 口琴 → 烟花。
refs: WPA Federal Art Project silkscreen posters, 1936–39

films.title: Gone with the Wind
films.desc_en: Impasto oil with palette-knife slabs, ridged paint and Technicolor heat: skies burning from gold to blood red, red earth, black silhouettes. Gone with the Wind is where colour arrives in the film, so Tara at sunset is the first fully saturated frame.
films.desc_zh: 厚涂油画：刮刀色块、颜料堆起的棱，Technicolor 的热度——从金色烧到血红的天空、红土、黑色剪影。全片的色彩从《乱世佳人》开始降临，第一张满色画面就是夕阳下的塔拉。
films.prompt_en: Impasto oil in a 1939 Technicolor palette. Palette-knife slabs: long horizontal sky bands (1/15-1/6 of frame width long, about 1/60 tall), shorter strokes following form on land and figures, calm thin areas between; ridges lit from upper left, paint thickest in highlights, canvas weave where thin. Default sunset sky: wine #3A0912, red #A8241A, orange #F27A22, gold #FFD878; ground red-brown #6E2214; warm near-black silhouettes. The hero the story centres on stays a readable warm mid-tone (e.g. #D97757), never a silhouette. Strong backlight, gold rims; in close shots a warm side light on half the face and hands. Epic-poster composition: big dark silhouettes (trees, buildings, rocks, figures) on a low horizon. Lamps as painted flames. Camera: slow push on the wide, low push-in on the hero, crane up to a vista. Avoid: tiled same-size strokes, muddy browns, smooth gradients.
films.prompt_zh: 1939 年 Technicolor 配色的厚涂油画。刮刀色块：天空用长条横向色带（长为画幅宽的 1/15–1/6，厚约 1/60），地面和人物用顺形体的短笔触，之间留出平静、薄涂的区域；颜料棱受左上方的光，越亮越厚，薄处露布纹。默认是落日天空，从酒红 #3A0912 经大红 #A8241A、橙 #F27A22 烧到金 #FFD878；地面红褐 #6E2214；剪影是带暖意的近黑；故事围绕的那个主角保持看得清的暖中间调（如 #D97757），不做成剪影。强逆光，金色轮廓光；近景加一道暖色侧光照亮半边脸和手。构图像史诗海报：大块深色剪影（树、房子、岩石、人物）压在低地平线上。灯火用油画火焰。运镜：全景慢推，低机位推近主角，最后吊臂升起看大景。避免：大小一样的碎块铺满画面、脏棕色、平滑渐变。

shots.en: Tara in silhouette: the great oak, the white house and cedars black against a sky burning from gold toward blood red; Clawd stands on a red-earth rise holding a radish; a slow push in.
shots.zh: 塔拉剪影全景：大橡树、白房子和雪松黑压压地立在从金色烧向血红的天空下，Clawd 站在红土丘上拿着萝卜；慢推。

shots.en: Low push-in against the burning sky: Clawd in a wide straw hat with a green ribbon raises the radish high, backlit with a gold rim.
shots.zh: 压低地平线推近，背后是燃烧的天空：戴绿缎带宽檐草帽的 Clawd 把萝卜高高举起，逆光一圈金边。

shots.en: Close on Clawd's face and hat, the ribbon tails whipping in the wind.
shots.zh: Clawd 脸和草帽的近景，缎带尾巴在风里翻飞。

shots.en: Atlanta burning: the wagon charges past the flaming warehouse and timber frame, Clawd beside Rhett on the seat, Prissy and Melanie behind; the camera trucks with it as flames sweep the foreground.
shots.zh: 亚特兰大大火：马车冲过燃烧的仓库和木构架，Clawd 坐在瑞德旁边的驾座上，后面是普莉西和梅兰妮；镜头跟着横移，前景火舌掠过。

shots.en: One crane move at the depot: from Clawd among the wounded, up and back until rows of soldiers cover the red ground to the horizon, a torn flag in the yard and Clawd a single orange dot.
shots.zh: 火车站一条升降长镜头：从站在伤兵中间的 Clawd 一路升高后退，一排排伤兵铺满红土直到地平线，场中一面破旗，Clawd 只剩一个橙色小点。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Scarlett in a wide straw hat with a green ribbon, holding a radish. The sky warms from gold to blood red over the first seven beats and the radish goes up on beat 6. Four hard cuts move through Tara, the oath, Atlanta and the depot, and the last five beats are a single crane shot.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮斯嘉丽：系绿缎带的宽檐草帽，手里一根萝卜。前 7 拍天空从金色烧到血红，第 6 拍举起萝卜。四刀硬切走过塔拉、发誓、亚特兰大和车站，最后 5 拍是一条升降长镜头。
refs: Ernest Haller and Ray Rennahan (Technicolor cinematography)

films.title: Rebecca
films.desc_en: Charcoal on toothed paper: velvet blacks, smudged greys, moonlight and mist lifted out with an eraser. Hitchcock's Rebecca is a black-and-white Gothic dream of a house in mist and then in flames, and charcoal can draw both.
films.desc_zh: 粗纹纸上的炭笔画：天鹅绒般的黑、抹开的灰，月光和雾用橡皮擦出来。希区柯克的《蝴蝶梦》是一场黑白哥特梦，庄园先在雾里、后在火里，炭笔两样都画得出来。
films.prompt_en: Charcoal on toothed paper. Fine tooth (grain ~1/600 of frame width): light pressure catches only the peaks, heavy pressure fills the valleys. Grain only in midtones; velvet blacks, clean-paper lifts. Values: ~60% dark-to-mid grey, 15% deep black in the nearest foreground and largest masses, lights small. Charcoal #121111 on paper #EEECE7. Marks: broken vine lines, side-of-the-stick sweeps (1/60-1/30 of frame width) following form, hatching, finger smudges, eraser lifts for edges and glows; mist is horizontal streaks erased out of a toned area (as in William Kentridge's animated drawings). Only the hero the story centres on is in pastel (e.g. #D97757), laid fairly solid, tooth peeking through, outlined in charcoal; flames stay charcoal-and-paper. Moonlight from above; 2-3 fog bands drift at different speeds. Camera: slow subjective push, foreground parting. Avoid: digital noise, smooth digital glows, grey blacks, empty bright skies.
films.prompt_zh: 有纹的纸上画炭笔。纸纹细（颗粒约画幅宽 1/600）：轻压只挂纹峰，重压填满纹谷。颗粒只在中间调；黑如天鹅绒，擦白是干净纸面。明暗：约六成画面暗到中灰，一成半深黑，在最近的前景和最大块面上，亮处少。炭色 #121111，纸色 #EEECE7。笔法：藤炭干笔断线，炭条侧锋顺形体宽扫（宽为画幅宽 1/60–1/30），排线，手指抹，橡皮擦出边光和光晕；雾是在铺好的灰调上横向擦出来的（如 William Kentridge 的动画素描）。只有故事围绕的那个主角用粉彩（如 #D97757），铺得较实、透点纸纹，炭笔勾边；火焰保持炭黑和纸白。月光从上方来，两三层雾带不同速横漂。运镜：主观镜头慢推，前景向两边分开。避免：数码噪点、光滑的数码光晕、发灰的黑、空亮的天空。

shots.en: Subjective push up the overgrown moonlit drive; the trees part on Manderley in the mist, its phantom windows glowing.
shots.zh: 沿着荒草蔓生的月下车道主观推进，树林分开，雾里露出曼德利，几扇本不该亮的窗亮着灯。

shots.en: Close on Clawd as the second Mrs de Winter, in a velvet headband and cardigan collar, Manderley behind; a slow push in.
shots.zh: Clawd 近景，扮第二任德温特夫人：天鹅绒发箍、开衫翻领，身后是曼德利；慢推。

shots.en: Manderley in moonlight, the camera pushing in as fire breaks out across its windows.
shots.zh: 月光下的曼德利，镜头推近，火从一扇扇窗里烧起来。

shots.en: Mrs Danvers standing motionless in the burning window, hands folded, her cold face lit flat; a push in toward her face.
shots.zh: 丹弗斯太太一动不动站在燃烧的窗口，双手交叠，冷脸被平光照着；镜头往她脸上推。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays the second Mrs de Winter in a velvet headband and cardigan, looking up at the house. It stays out of the opening dream push; then three hard cuts go Clawd → the house catching fire → Danvers, and every shot pushes in, so the 2.5 s keep moving toward the fire.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮第二任德温特夫人：天鹅绒发箍、开衫，仰望庄园。开场的梦境推进里没有它；接着三刀硬切：Clawd → 起火的庄园 → 丹弗斯太太。每一镜都在往里推，2.5 秒一路推向大火。

films.title: How Green Was My Valley
films.desc_en: Opaque gouache in the 1941 poster's gold and green: solid colour masses, coal-black tips, Kyffin Williams' heavy dark hills and broken contours. Gouache keeps it apart from No. 3's woodcut; the scene is the colliers walking home down the valley, singing.
films.desc_zh: 用 1941 年原海报金黄加绿配色的不透明水粉：扎实的色块、煤黑的渣山、Kyffin Williams 式厚重的深色山体和断续描边。用水粉而不用木刻，和第 3 部区分开；画的是矿工唱着歌走下山谷回家。
films.prompt_en: Opaque gouache after Welsh painter Kyffin Williams. Directional strokes 1/80-1/40 of frame width, 2-5 times as long, ragged, fully covering; broken dark dashes outline buildings, walls and ridges; dark hills flecked with lighter green or slate knife marks. Palette: sky and light pale gold #F1C565 (not mustard), fields green #86A03F, darks coal #1D1B1E, far hills and water slate #48505E, small accents yellow #F6CF2F, other colours mixed from these; the hero the story centres on #D97757, at least 1/8 of frame height. Fields and sky light (~60%), hills and buildings dark. Warm grade under 10%, vignette, grain. Default low late-afternoon side light: fields lit, ridges rim-lit. From high ground in true perspective, a path leading the eye down; small repeated buildings (or walls, rocks) stepping along slopes. Motion: looping smoke or cloud, a lateral track. Avoid: watercolour transparency, vector fills, mud.
films.prompt_zh: 仿威尔士画家 Kyffin Williams 的不透明水粉。方向性笔触宽为画幅宽 1/80–1/40，长是宽的 2–5 倍，边缘毛糙，完全覆盖；房子、墙、山脊用断续深色短线勾边；暗山上刮几笔亮绿或灰蓝。色板：天空和光淡金 #F1C565（别成芥末黄），田野绿 #86A03F，暗部煤黑 #1D1B1E，远山和水面灰蓝 #48505E，小点缀黄 #F6CF2F，其他颜色由这几色调出；故事围绕的那个主角用 #D97757，至少占画面高八分之一。田野和天空偏亮（约六成），山和房子偏暗。暖色调色不超过一成，暗角，颗粒。默认傍晚低角度侧光，田野受光，山脊有轮廓光。从高处真透视取景，一条路把视线引下去；小房子（或墙、石块）顺山坡一级级排开。动起来：烟或云循环飘动，横向跟拍。避免：水彩透明感、矢量平涂、发暗发脏。

shots.en: From the hilltop among the daffodils: Clawd in a flat cap and red scarf sits in the left foreground holding a daffodil, the street of terraces leading down to the pithead and the coal tip; a slow pull back.
shots.zh: 山顶黄水仙丛里俯瞰：戴平顶帽、系红围巾的 Clawd 坐在左前景，手拿一枝黄水仙，排屋街一路通到谷底的井架和煤渣山；慢拉。

shots.en: Close on the pithead frame and its winding wheel turning, terraces climbing the green slope behind; a locked-off camera.
shots.zh: 井架和转动的大轮特写，后面绿坡上爬满排屋；固定机位。

shots.en: Lateral tracking shot down the terrace street: the colliers walk home in three rows, faces black with coal, singing; Clawd walks in the front row as the houses slide past.
shots.zh: 沿排屋街的横向跟拍：下工的矿工分三排往下走，脸上是煤灰，边走边唱；Clawd 走在前排，房子从身后滑过。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays young Huw in a tweed flat cap and knotted red scarf, with a daffodil. It sits above the valley first, then walks down the street in step with the singing colliers. Two hard cuts: valley → winding wheel → street.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮少年休：粗花呢平顶帽、打结的红围巾、一枝黄水仙。先坐在山顶看山谷，再跟着唱歌的矿工齐步走下街。两刀硬切：山谷 → 井架大轮 → 街道。

films.title: Mrs. Miniver
blend_en: Stone lithograph with crayon shadow plate
Frank Newbould and Abram Games WWII posters
blend_zh: Frank Newbould、Abram Games 二战海报
films.desc_en: A WWII British Home Front lithograph poster: flat brick red, deep green, cream and grey-blue, with a grainy crayon shadow plate. It fits the film's last scene, a village singing in its bombed church while Spitfires pass overhead.
films.desc_zh: 二战英国本土战线的石印海报：砖红、深绿、奶油、灰蓝的有限套色，阴影是石版蜡笔颗粒。配影片结尾：被炸穿屋顶的乡村教堂里全村唱诗，喷火式战机从破洞上方飞过。
films.prompt_en: A 1942 British wartime stone-lithograph poster. Simple, strong shapes from three plates, 1-3 px off register: a colour plate with all flat fills; a grey-blue crayon plate darkening every shadow with short slanted stone grain; a green-black key line about 1/500 of frame width around every shape, figures and clouds included. Palette by role: cream #EBDFC2 paper and highlights, grey-blue #8497A6 sky and shadow, brick red #A23F2D and deep green #34503F as accents, at most a quarter of the frame; browns and skin mixed from cream and brick; key #1E2422. Scenes may be full. Airbrushed skies; only the paper grain boils at 12 fps. Pale light bands, angled from the source, cancel the shadow plate. Figures stand frontally. Camera: slow drifts, a tilt up. References: Frank Newbould, Abram Games. Avoid: dot screens, clean vector edges, big saturated fields.
films.prompt_zh: 做成 1942 年英国战时的石印海报。造型简化有力，三版套印，略错位 1–3 像素：色版承载所有平涂；冷灰蓝蜡笔版压暗每一处阴影，带短而斜的石纹颗粒（不用网点）；墨绿黑轮廓版给每个形描一圈约画幅宽 1/500 的线，人物和云也要描。配色按用途：奶油 #EBDFC2 是纸色和亮部，灰蓝 #8497A6 是天空和阴影，砖红 #A23F2D 和深绿 #34503F 只作点缀，合计不超过画面四分之一；棕色和肤色由奶油加砖红调出；轮廓色 #1E2422。场景可以排满。天空用喷枪渐变，只有纸纹每秒 12 帧跳动。浅色光带顺着光源方向斜落，照到之处阴影版消失。人物正面站立，像海报里的人。镜头慢移带视差、上摇。对标 Frank Newbould、Abram Games。避免：网点阴影、干净的矢量边、大片饱和色。

shots.en: Wide down the bombed nave: the village sings from the pews under shafts of sun; Clawd sits in the front pew in a lace-trimmed straw hat with hymn book and red rose, singing. The camera eases back slightly.
shots.zh: 全景，顺着被炸的教堂中殿看过去：村民站在长椅间唱诗，阳光成柱照下；Clawd 戴花边草帽坐在第一排，拿着赞美诗集和红玫瑰在唱。镜头微微后拉。

shots.en: Close on Clawd with the rose: the engines come over, it stops singing and looks up toward the roof. Slight push-in.
shots.zh: Clawd 和玫瑰的近景：引擎声传来，它停下不唱，抬头看向屋顶。镜头轻推。

shots.en: Looking straight up through the torn roof: snapped rafters frame the sky as a V of Spitfires crosses it. Slow push with a slight roll.
shots.zh: 从教堂里垂直仰拍屋顶的破洞：断裂的椽子框住天空，喷火式战机排成 V 字飞过。镜头慢推并略微旋转。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Mrs. Miniver: a lace-trimmed straw hat, a hymn book and the red 'Miniver' rose. It sings through the wide shot; on the cut to the close-up it hears the engines and looks up, and the third shot is its view through the hole as the Spitfires pass. Hard cuts, linked by one upward look.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮米尼弗夫人：花边草帽、赞美诗集和红色的「米尼弗夫人」玫瑰。全景里它在唱诗；切到近景时听见引擎声，停下抬头；第三个镜头是它的视线，穿过屋顶破洞看喷火式编队飞过。三个硬切，靠一个抬头的动作连起来。
refs: Frank Newbould, Your Britain — Fight for it Now (1942)

films.title: Casablanca
films.desc_en: The film's own look, Arthur Edeson's studio black-and-white, painted as a retouched glamour still: rich greys, soft-focus close-ups with catchlights, venetian-blind shadows, light shafts in smoke and fog. Clawd, as Rick, is the only colour.
films.desc_zh: 影片本身的样子：Arthur Edeson 的片厂黑白，画成精修剧照：带眼神光的柔焦特写、百叶窗投影、烟雾里的光柱。扮里克的 Clawd 是唯一的颜色。
films.prompt_en: 1940s Hollywood studio black-and-white, painted like a retouched glamour still. Forms: smooth airbrushed tone blocks. Faces: short key (light on the face's far side from camera; the near cheek in shadow, holding a Rembrandt triangle of light), two catchlights per eye. Slatted shadows from anything at hand (blinds, railings, branches) fall diagonally across surfaces; light shafts show only in smoke or fog. Values: 30-40% of the frame deep black, whites small and glowing; outdoor skies mid-dark. Grade: diffusion glow, an S-curve, fine grain (±3%), soft vignette, faint flicker; fog stays local. Only the hero the story centres on keeps colour, on its body or costume (e.g. #D97757); skin and lamps stay grey. Camera: a long glide, a push to a face, a pull-back into fog. References: cinematographer Arthur Edeson (*Casablanca*, Michael Curtiz, 1942). Avoid: flat lighting, grey haze, stiff busts.
films.prompt_zh: 40 年代好莱坞片厂黑白，画成精修剧照。形体是边缘干净的喷枪明暗块。人脸用短光位：主光照亮离镜头远的那半边脸，靠近镜头的脸颊落在暗部，留一块伦勃朗三角光；每只眼两个眼神光。条状影子借手边的东西（百叶窗、栏杆、树枝），斜落在物面上；光柱只在烟雾飘过处显形。明暗：三到四成画面是深黑，白色面积小而发光；外景天空中暗灰。调色：轻柔光溢出、S 曲线、细颗粒（±3%）、柔暗角、轻微闪烁；雾只在局部。只有故事围绕的那个主角的身体或衣服保留颜色（如 #D97757），皮肤和灯光都是灰阶。镜头：长运镜，推向一张脸，再拉远退进雾里。对标摄影师 Arthur Edeson（《卡萨布兰卡》，Michael Curtiz，1942）。避免：平光、整片灰雾、僵硬的胸像。

shots.en: One travelling move through Rick's Café: past fans and smoke to Sam at the piano with Ilsa leaning on it, a push toward her soft-focus face as the tear rises, then right across the room to Clawd at its table in a bow tie, raising the champagne glass.
shots.zh: 一条运镜穿过里克的咖啡馆：越过吊扇和烟雾滑到弹琴的萨姆和靠在琴上的伊尔莎，推向她泪光渐起的柔焦脸，再横移过整个房间，落到桌边系着领结的 Clawd，它举起香槟杯。

shots.en: Hard cut to the foggy airfield: close on Clawd under the fedora with its collar up, a glance back, then a long pull-back to Ilsa, Renault and the Electra with its propellers turning in the fog.
shots.zh: 硬切到雾中机场：Clawd 戴软呢帽、竖着风衣领的近景，它回头一瞥；镜头长长地拉远，露出伊尔莎、雷诺上尉和雾里螺旋桨转动的 Electra 客机。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Rick: bow tie and champagne coupe in the café, fedora and turned-up trench collar at the airport. The café is one unbroken camera move ending on its toast, 'Here's looking at you, kid'; the single hard cut at the halfway beat jumps to the airport, where a glance back and a long pull-back close the scene.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮里克：咖啡馆里是领结和香槟碟杯，机场上是软呢帽和竖起的风衣领。咖啡馆是一条不断的运镜，收在它举杯（"Here's looking at you, kid"）；正中那一拍是全段唯一的硬切，跳到机场，一个回头加一次长拉远收尾。

films.title: Going My Way
blend_zh: 铅条拼色玻璃 + 灰调描绘
films.desc_en: Backlit Gothic stained glass: leaded pot-metal pieces with grisaille-painted faces, Chartres blue, ruby borders, and coloured light pooling on the church floor. Father O'Malley's boys' choir is set into the window under a gold star for 'Swinging on a Star'.
films.desc_zh: 逆光的哥特彩色玻璃：铅条拼起的色玻璃、灰调描出的人脸、沙特尔蓝和宝石红边框，彩光洒在教堂地上。奥马利神父和唱诗班嵌在窗里，头顶是金色星章。
films.prompt_en: A backlit Gothic stained-glass window filling 80-90% of frame height and ~60% of width, neighbours glowing at edges. Every shape is cut glass: lightness varied ±8% per piece, streaks, seed bubbles, a brown edge mat, black lead (about 1/250 of frame width). Sky and empty ground: diamond quarries (about 1/30 of frame width); the border is ruby with beads. The main figure is at least half the window's height, in dark-brown grisaille line. Palette by role: background cobalt #1B3F9E, border ruby #B3121F, highlights gold #E3A526, lead #16161A; skin pale amber; scenery deep greens. Only the hero the story centres on is orange glass (e.g. #D97757). Bright glass blooms into the leads; coloured light spills onto floor and sill. Camera: tilt down, pan, settle on the pooled light. References: Chartres Cathedral; Harry Clarke. Avoid: flat fills, random cuts, dark empty wall.
films.prompt_zh: 逆光的哥特彩窗，占画面高度八到九成、宽度约六成，两边露出相邻发光的窗。每个形状是一块切好的玻璃：每块明度浮动约 8%，有流纹气泡和褐色内描边，外压黑铅条（宽约画幅宽 1/250）。天空和空地切成菱形格（每格约画幅宽 1/30）；边框是带圆珠的宝石红。主要人物至少占窗高一半，用尖细的深褐线描脸和衣褶。配色按用途：背景钴蓝 #1B3F9E，边框宝石红 #B3121F，高光金 #E3A526，铅条 #16161A；皮肤淡琥珀；景物用深绿、青绿。只有故事围绕的那个主角是橙色玻璃（如 #D97757）。亮玻璃光晕吃进铅条；彩光落在地面和窗台上。镜头：下摇、横摇，落到光斑上。对标沙特尔大教堂、Harry Clarke。避免：平涂、随意切割、窗四周大片暗墙。

shots.en: Starts on the gold star medallion and the SWINGING ON A STAR banderole, then tilts down the lancet onto Clawd as Father O'Malley, conducting the glass boys' choir.
shots.zh: 从金色八角星章和「SWINGING ON A STAR」飘带开始，沿尖拱窗往下摇，落到扮奥马利神父的 Clawd，它在玻璃里指挥男孩唱诗班。

shots.en: Medium on the glass choir: boys in red cassocks and surplices singing, the camera panning right past Clawd's baton arm.
shots.zh: 玻璃唱诗班的中景：穿红袍白衣的男孩们在唱，镜头向右横摇，扫过 Clawd 举指挥棒的手。

shots.en: Cut down into the nave: the window's colours pooled on the marble aisle between the pews, altar candles lit; the camera tilts down toward the floor.
shots.zh: 切到教堂中殿：彩窗的颜色洒在长椅之间的大理石过道上，祭坛蜡烛亮着；镜头往地面下摇。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Father O'Malley inside the glass, its body cut from the warmest terracotta glass, with a straw boater, Roman collar, baton and songbook. It conducts on the beat while the boys' mouths open and close out of step. One tilt carries us from the star to Clawd, then hard cuts go to the choir and down to the coloured light on the floor. Runs 1.8× fast.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 在玻璃画里扮奥马利神父：身体是最暖的陶土色玻璃，戴草帽和罗马领，拿指挥棒和歌本。它跟着拍子指挥，男孩们的口型各自错开。一个下摇从星章落到 Clawd，再硬切到唱诗班，最后落到地上的彩光。表演 1.8 倍速。

films.title: The Lost Weekend
blend_zh: John F. Seitz 硬光黑白
films.desc_en: The picture is typed: monospaced characters on a pica grid, grey built from character density and overstrikes, uneven ribbon ink on bond paper. Don Birnam lugs his typewriter to the pawnshops, so his own machine types the street; Clawd is struck in orange ribbon.
films.desc_zh: 画面是打出来的：等宽字符落在 pica 网格上，灰阶靠字符疏密和叠打，色带墨色不匀。唐抱着打字机去当铺，于是整条街由打字机打出；Clawd 用橙色色带打。
films.prompt_en: Type every image: one bold monospaced glyph per keystroke, fixed grid, cells 1/150 of frame width wide, twice as tall. Strike 85-95% of cells; bare paper only for highlights. Grey from a key ladder (light . : -, mid = + o, dark X # M); darks (about 30%) are overstrikes like M#. Shapes read as crisp-edged fields, clear silhouettes. Each material repeats its own keys (e.g. I H verticals, _| courses, ~ water). Signs stay legible. Uneven ribbon: half-inked strikes, a few keys always high or low. Paper #EBE6DA, ink #1D1C21; only the hero the story centres on, at least 1/3 of frame height, is struck in red-orange #D4704F, its shadow black. Hard sidelight casts long, crisp, dense shadows. The picture types itself within the first second, then holds. Reference: Paul Smith's typewriter art. Avoid: sparse frames, shapeless streaks.
films.prompt_zh: 所有画面都用打字机字符打出来：等宽粗体字逐个敲，落在固定网格上，格宽约画幅宽 1/150、格高是格宽两倍。85%–95% 的格子都要打字，只有最亮的光留纸白。灰阶靠字键分级（浅 . : -，中 = + o，深 X # M），暗部约占三成，用 M# 这样的叠打。形体靠边界清楚的字块和剪影读出。每种材质重复自己的字键（如竖向结构 I H，砖缝 _|，水 ~）。招牌或说明要打得能读。色带墨色不匀：半边缺墨，几个键总是偏高或偏低。纸 #EBE6DA，墨 #1D1C21；只有故事围绕的那个主角用红橙色带 #D4704F 打，至少占画面高度三分之一，影子仍是黑的。硬侧光投出边缘清楚的密集长影。画面在第一秒内打完，然后停住。对标 Paul Smith 的打字机画。避免：稀疏空白、看不出形的横向字条。

shots.en: Wide one-point view under the Third Avenue El: the street types itself onto the page row by row while Clawd, in a fedora, walks with the typewriter in hand; the camera eases back.
shots.zh: 第三大道高架铁下的一点透视全景：街景一行行打到纸上，戴软呢帽的 Clawd 提着打字机往前走；镜头微微后拉。

shots.en: Close on Clawd: typed hat, eyes and the grey typewriter at its side, girders behind; slow push-in.
shots.zh: Clawd 近景：字符打出的帽子、眼睛和身边灰色的打字机，背后是钢梁；镜头慢推。

shots.en: Insert on J. GOLDMAN's LOANS sign in typed block letters, the CLOSED card hanging below; slow push-in.
shots.zh: J. GOLDMAN 的 LOANS 当铺招牌特写，字母由字符拼成，下面挂着 CLOSED 牌；镜头慢推。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Don Birnam: a typed fedora, the typewriter he hopes to pawn, legs stepping on alternate frames. The street appears around it as if being typed; then a close-up and the CLOSED sign land the joke in two quick hard cuts. Runs 1.8× fast to fit the slot.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮唐·伯南：字符打出的软呢帽，提着想拿去当掉的打字机，四条腿逐帧交替迈步。街道像被打字机打出来一样在它身边出现；接着两个快速硬切，近景和 CLOSED 牌，把「当铺关门」交代完。表演 1.8 倍速。

films.title: The Best Years of Our Lives
films.style_zh: 画报新闻摄影半调跨页
films.desc_en: A 1946 picture-magazine news photo printed in coarse black halftone on coated stock, with the gutter fold and an overprinted caption. Deep-focus rows of stripped B-17s run to the horizon; Clawd is the only colour, on its own spot-orange plate.
films.desc_zh: 1946 年画报的新闻摄影跨页：铜版纸上的粗黑网点、中缝折痕、叠印的图片说明。深焦里拆光的 B-17 排到地平线；Clawd 单独印在专色橙版上，是唯一的颜色。
films.prompt_en: Each frame is a 1946 picture-magazine photo spread. Render the scene as a grey photo (3D or painted): low sun, long shadows, deep focus (near and far both sharp). The photo bleeds across both pages, crossed by a soft vertical gutter crease. Print as a 45° black halftone, dot pitch about 1/250 of frame width, ink #1A1A1A on off-white coated stock #ECE6D8. A short black headline and caption sit in a quiet area. Only the hero the story centres on, at least 1/4 of frame height, prints on its own spot-orange plate (e.g. #D97757) at another angle, 2-3 px off, black only in its deepest shadows. Camera: walk in, push to a detail, pull back to reveal an open magazine. References: cinematographer Gregg Toland; *Life* post-war photo essays. Avoid: the gutter cutting the hero, coarse dots that break the photo.
films.prompt_zh: 每一帧当成 1946 年画报的新闻摄影跨页。先把场景按照片渲染成灰调（3D 或手绘都行）：低角度太阳、长影子、深焦，近处和地平线一样清楚。照片满版跨过两页，竖向中缝折痕从中间穿过，带一点阴影。再印成 45° 黑色网点，间距约画幅宽 1/250，米白铜版纸 #ECE6D8，墨 #1A1A1A，略有扩墨。从第一镜起，在安静的区域叠印一小块黑色标题和图说。只有故事围绕的那个主角走专色橙版（如 #D97757），换一个网角，错版 2–3 像素，黑版只留在它最深的暗部；主角至少占画面高度四分之一。镜头：走进全景，推进一个细节，再拉远，照片缩成一本摊开的杂志。对标摄影师 Gregg Toland、《生活》杂志战后摄影专题。避免：中缝切过主角，网点粗到照片碎掉。

shots.en: Low deep-focus wide in the boneyard: Clawd, in a garrison cap and fleece collar, walks under a stripped B-17's wing, stops and looks up at the glass nose; the camera trucks right and pushes in.
shots.zh: 低机位深焦全景，飞机坟场：戴船形帽、竖着羊毛领的 Clawd 走到一架拆光的 B-17 机翼下，停步，抬头看玻璃机头；镜头右移并推近。

shots.en: Inside the bombardier's glazed nose, looking out over the rows of bombers to the mountains, Clawd at the left edge; slow push-in.
shots.zh: 轰炸员的玻璃机头舱里往外看，一排排轰炸机伸向远山，Clawd 在画面左边缘；镜头慢推。

shots.en: Pull back: the photo shrinks into an open magazine, GRAVEYARD OF THE FORTRESSES, lying on a dark desk.
shots.zh: 拉远：照片缩进一本摊开的杂志，标题 GRAVEYARD OF THE FORTRESSES，放在深色桌面上。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Fred Derry: captain's garrison cap and B-3 sheepskin collar. It walks the corridor of bombers, stops on the beat and looks up; we cut inside the nose it is looking at, then pull back to reveal the whole scene as a page in a 1946 magazine. Two hard cuts, the last shot one continuous pull-back.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮弗雷德：上尉的船形帽和 B-3 飞行夹克的羊毛领。它沿着轰炸机走廊走，踩着拍子停下抬头；切进它望着的机头舱，再一路拉远，原来整个画面是 1946 年杂志上的一页。两个硬切，最后一镜是一次连续的拉远。
refs: The Best Years of Our Lives one-sheet (1946)

films.title: Gentleman's Agreement
films.desc_en: Graphite pencil in the manner of 1940s magazine illustration: construction lines, near-parallel hatching passes, rubbed darks and eraser lifts on toothy paper. The drawing builds itself around a polite refusal at a hotel desk; Clawd alone is in coloured pencil.
films.desc_zh: 40 年代杂志插画式的石墨铅笔：先打构图线，再一遍遍平行排线，擦抹暗部、橡皮提亮。画面围绕酒店前台一次客气的拒绝逐步画出，只有 Clawd 是彩色铅笔。
films.prompt_en: Graphite pencil like a 1940s magazine illustration, finished and controlled. The drawing builds in the first 1-1.5 s, then holds: faint perspective rays and head ovals, pressure-tapered contours (about 1/600 of frame width) overshooting at corners, then 1-4 near-parallel hatching passes (more for darker), about 1/300 of frame width apart, following the form, then rubbed tone and eraser lifts. The finished frame is toned nearly edge to edge: setting fully drawn in mid-greys, about 15% dark accents, only the outer tenth fading to loose margins. Paper #F2EEE5 with a light tooth; lead #2C2B2E. Only the hero the story centres on wears coloured pencil (e.g. #D97757) on its clothing; skin stays graphite. Faces carry the drama. Camera: a slow ease out, then cuts to close-ups. References: illustrators Al Parker and Robert Fawcett. Avoid: cross-hatch grids, scribbly sketching, a near-empty page.
films.prompt_zh: 用石墨铅笔画成 40 年代杂志插画，画得完整、有控制。画面在前 1–1.5 秒内画成，然后停住：先淡淡的透视线和头部椭圆，再画两头轻中间重、转角出头的轮廓（宽约画幅宽 1/600），然后一到四遍近乎平行的排线（遍数越多越暗），间距约画幅宽 1/300，顺着形体走，再擦抹出平滑的过渡，用橡皮提亮。完成的画面几乎铺满：环境和背景都画充分，以中灰为主，深色约占一成半，只有最外一圈约十分之一淡成没画完的边角。纸 #F2EEE5 带轻齿纹，铅色 #2C2B2E。只有故事围绕的那个主角的衣服用彩铅（如 #D97757），皮肤仍是铅笔灰。戏在脸上。镜头：缓缓拉远，再切特写。对标插画家 Al Parker、Robert Fawcett。避免：交叉网格、潦草速写感、大片空白纸面。

shots.en: Wide on the hotel lobby being drawn as we watch, from construction lines to hatching: Clawd, in a PRESS-card fedora, holds its notepad up to the front desk; the camera eases back.
shots.zh: 酒店大堂全景，画面当场被画出来，从构图线到排线：戴着插 PRESS 卡软呢帽的 Clawd 把采访本举到前台；镜头微微后拉。

shots.en: Push in from the manager to his close-up: the slight bow, the smile, the eyes that don't smile, every key still on the rack behind him.
shots.zh: 从前台经理推到他的特写：微微欠身、微笑，眼睛却不笑，身后钥匙架上每把钥匙都还挂着。

shots.en: Locked-off medium on the lady in the fox stole by the lift, her eyes turned back toward Clawd.
shots.zh: 固定机位中景：电梯旁披狐皮围脖的女士，眼睛回头瞟向 Clawd。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Phil Green: a fedora with a PRESS card, a spiral pad and a pencil, standing still at the desk. The first shot is the drawing itself appearing around it; then two hard cuts to the witnesses carry the meaning, the manager's polite refusal and the lady's sideways look. Little moves; the beats land on the cuts. Runs 1.8× fast.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮记者菲尔：插 PRESS 卡的软呢帽、采访本和铅笔，站在前台不动。第一镜是画面在它身边被画出来；接着两个硬切给旁观者，经理客气的拒绝和女士斜过来的目光，意思全在这两张脸上。拍点落在剪切上。表演 1.8 倍速。

films.title: Hamlet
blend_zh: Roger Furse 光秃的罗马式布景
films.desc_en: A real-time 3D Elsinore in high-contrast deep-focus black-and-white: volumetric fog, wet stone, swells breaking into lace foam, silver grain. It follows Olivier's castle, foggy battlements and sea rock; Clawd is the only colour, lifting Yorick's skull.
films.desc_zh: 实时 3D 的艾尔西诺，高反差深焦黑白：体积雾、湿石头、碎成蕾丝白沫的海浪、银盐颗粒。照奥利维耶片中的城堡、雾中城垛和礁石来拍；Clawd 是唯一的颜色。
films.prompt_en: A real 3D scene in late-1940s deep-focus black-and-white. Built forms: bare masonry, block by block, bevelled, staggered (Romanesque arches only where the setting has them); wet surfaces dark and glossy. Soft overcast light, no hard shadows: dark masses against a silver sky. Low fog fills the lower third; the far background ends at 60-70% grey, the midground sharp; a bright patch behind cloud throws faint shafts. Water, if any: layered swells, lace foam, misty spray. Post: ambient occlusion, gentle bloom, high-contrast silver grade (true blacks, unclipped whites), grain (±3%), faint flicker. Only the hero the story centres on keeps its colour (e.g. #D97757); every light source stays grey. Camera: slow drift in, a track along a high edge, a low angle on the hero. Reference: Laurence Olivier, *Hamlet* (1948). Avoid: hard sunlit shadows, white-out fog, tiled textures.
films.prompt_zh: 真 3D 场景，40 年代末的深焦黑白。建筑是裸露的砌体，逐块砌出，带倒角和错缝（场景本有这类建筑时才用罗马式半圆拱）；湿的表面发黑发亮。阴天柔光，没有硬投影：深色实体衬着银灰天空。高度雾贴着画面下三分之一，成片里远景是 60%–70% 灰，中景清晰；云后亮天透出淡淡光柱。有水时：多层涌浪、蕾丝般的白沫、礁石上的水雾。后期：环境光遮蔽、轻辉光、高反差银色调色（有真黑，白不过曝），颗粒 ±3%，轻微闪烁。只有故事围绕的那个主角保留颜色（如 #D97757），所有光源都是灰的。镜头：慢慢漂近，沿高处横移，低机位仰拍主角。对标 Laurence Olivier《哈姆雷特》（1948）。避免：晴天硬影子、雾糊成一片白、贴图平铺。

shots.en: Wide from the sea: Elsinore on its headland over the breaking surf, Clawd a tiny figure on the rock at the right; slow drift in.
shots.zh: 从海上看的全景：海岬上的艾尔西诺，脚下浪花拍岸，Clawd 是右边礁石顶上的一个小身影；镜头缓缓漂近。

shots.en: On the fog-bound wall-walk the armoured Ghost fades in and beckons, Clawd watching from the near side; slight push-in.
shots.zh: 浓雾里的城墙步道：披甲的鬼魂从雾中显形、招手，Clawd 在近处看着它；镜头轻推。

shots.en: Low angle on the sea rock: Clawd, in lace cuffs with a sheathed short sword, lifts Yorick's skull before the castle in the fog; slow push-in.
shots.zh: 低机位仰拍海边礁石：戴蕾丝袖口、挂短剑的 Clawd 在雾中城堡前举起约里克的骷髅；镜头慢推。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Hamlet: Yorick's skull, the white lace cuffs, belt and short sword from the poster. Three hard cuts walk through the film's three images, the castle on its cliff, the Ghost in the fog and the soliloquy rock, and the skull comes up on the beat in the last shot. Runs 1.8× fast.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮哈姆雷特：约里克的骷髅，海报上的白色蕾丝袖口、腰带和短剑。三个硬切走过这部片的三个画面：悬崖上的城堡、雾里的鬼魂、独白的礁石；最后一镜里骷髅踩着拍子举起来。表演 1.8 倍速。

films.title: All the King's Men
films.desc_en: A Southern campaign poster in wood-type letterpress: red, blue and black ink on cream stock, wood grain in the solids, starved patches, misregistered formes and halftone portraits. It is Willie Stark's rally; Clawd is printed in a fourth, orange ink.
films.desc_zh: 南方竞选海报的木活字凸版：红、蓝、黑三色油墨印在米黄纸上，实地有木纹，供墨不匀，版间错位，肖像走半调网点。这是斯塔克的竞选集会，Clawd 用第四版橙墨印。
films.prompt_en: A letterpress poster from wood type and cuts. Three inks on cream stock #EEE3C7: blue #20488C (sky, water, shadow masses), red #C82C28 (warm surfaces, stripes), black #1E1B1E (outlines, type); only the hero the story centres on gets a spot ink (e.g. #D97757). Each ink 2-4 px off register; solids knock out the inks beneath, halftones overprint. Wood grain, pinholed starved patches, squeezed edges. Mid tones: coarse dots (about 1/200 of frame width), varied angles, on at most a third of the frame. Figures as linocuts: heavy outlines, gouged white lines, crescent shadows. Picture fills about 70%; short wood-type lines (about 1/10 of frame height, user's language) with offset shadows sit on banners and signs. Camera: small pushes, a lateral track, a bump on each strong beat (or every 2 s). Reference: Hatch Show Print. Avoid: busy grey mid-tones, perfect registration.
films.prompt_zh: 每帧都是木活字和刻版印的凸版海报。米黄纸 #EEE3C7 上印三色：蓝 #20488C 管天空、水和大块暗部，红 #C82C28 管暖色面和条纹，黑 #1E1B1E 管轮廓和字；只有故事围绕的那个主角多加一块专色（如 #D97757）。每色一版，错位 2–4 像素；实地挖空下层，只有网点处叠印。实地有木纹、缺墨针孔，边缘挤墨。中间调走粗网点（约画幅宽 1/200），各版网角不同，不超过画面三分之一。人物像麻胶版画：粗黑轮廓、刻刀白线、月牙阴影。画面约七成是图；一两行粗木活字短句写在图里的横幅和招牌上，带错位投影，字高约画面十分之一，用用户语言。镜头：小推，横移，重拍上特写一震（无音乐每 2 秒）。对标 Hatch Show Print。避免：碎灰调代替大块实地、套色精准得像电脑。

shots.en: Wide on the bunting-hung platform in the town square: Clawd as Stark in front of its own giant halftone portrait, fist half up, the crowd roaring under STARK FOR GOVERNOR placards; small push-in.
shots.zh: 小镇广场挂满彩旗的讲台全景：扮斯塔克的 Clawd 站在自己的巨幅半调肖像前，拳头举到一半，台下人群举着 STARK FOR GOVERNOR 牌子欢呼；镜头小幅推进。

shots.en: Into the crowd: placards pumping, fists and shouting mouths, EVERY MAN A KING; lateral track right.
shots.zh: 切进人群：牌子上下挥动，拳头和喊叫的嘴，EVERY MAN A KING；镜头向右横移。

shots.en: Close on Clawd, fedora pushed back and tie loosened: the fist punches all the way up and pumps again; the camera bumps on the punch.
shots.zh: Clawd 近景，软呢帽往后推、领带拉松：拳头一下举到顶，再挥一次；镜头在出拳那一下跟着一震。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Willie Stark: a pushed-back fedora, a loosened red-and-blue tie, a rolled speech in one hand. The fist comes half up in the wide, the crowd answers in the middle shot, and in the close-up it punches all the way up on the beat and pumps once more, with a small camera kick on the hit. Hard cuts throughout.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮威利·斯塔克：往后推的软呢帽、拉松的红蓝领带，一只手里卷着讲稿。全景里拳头举到一半，中间一镜是人群的回应，特写里它踩着拍子一拳举到顶、再挥一次，镜头在出拳时轻轻一震。全部硬切。

films.title: All About Eve
films.style_zh: 赫希菲尔德一笔画漫画
films.desc_en: Al Hirschfeld's Broadway caricature: one flowing ink line that swells and tapers, solid blacks against white, lots of empty paper, one exaggerated trait per person. The film is about the theatre, so its party is drawn as a theatre-page cartoon; Clawd is the only colour.
films.desc_zh: 艾尔·赫希菲尔德的百老汇漫画：粗细变化的流畅墨线、黑块对白、大量留白，每人只抓一个夸张特征。这部片讲剧场，派对就画成报纸剧场版漫画；Clawd 是唯一的颜色。
films.prompt_en: An Al Hirschfeld-style caricature. Lines are elastic, long and continuous, one stroke per contour: about 1/800 of frame width at the ends, swelling to 1/250 on curves. Dark clothing, hair and big objects go solid black; grey only as sparse parallel hatching. The setting is fully drawn in thin line, architecture, furniture and props in detail, white kept between objects: about 60% paper white, never an empty page. Push one trait per figure (a long neck, a big head). Paper #FBFAF6, ink #131012; only the hero the story centres on has its body or main garment filled flat with one colour (e.g. #D97757) instead of black. Lines write on within the first second, then hold; a short hand-lettered line may sit in the white. Camera: ease back, pan across, push in. Avoid: stiff limbs, stick figures, a bare setting.
films.prompt_zh: 画成 Al Hirschfeld 式的漫画，白纸黑墨。线条有弹性、长而连贯，能一笔画完的轮廓就一笔：两端约画幅宽 1/800，转弯处加粗到 1/250。深色衣服、头发和大件物体用实心黑块；灰调只用稀疏的平行排线。环境用细线画完整：建筑、家具、道具连同细节都画，物与物之间留白；约六成纸面留白，但绝不是空纸。每个人物靠姿态和比例夸张一个特征（长脖子、大头），五官具体。纸 #FBFAF6，墨 #131012；只有故事围绕的那个主角的身体或主要衣服用一种颜色平涂（如 #D97757），代替黑块。线条在第一秒内一笔笔写完，然后停住；留白处可有一句手写短句。镜头：拉远，横摇扫过场景，小推。避免：四肢僵直、火柴人、空荡荡的环境。

shots.en: Wide on Margo's party inking itself on, stairs first, then the guests and the piano; 'FASTEN YOUR SEATBELTS, IT'S GOING TO BE A BUMPY NIGHT' is hand-lettered into the white space, with Clawd as Margo on the staircase; slight pull-back.
shots.zh: 玛戈家派对的全景一笔笔画出来：先是楼梯，再是宾客和钢琴；留白处手写出 "FASTEN YOUR SEATBELTS, IT'S GOING TO BE A BUMPY NIGHT"，扮玛戈的 Clawd 站在楼梯上；镜头微微拉远。

shots.en: Pan right across the guests, Birdie, Max, Addison, Miss Caswell and the pianist, to Eve in the corner.
shots.zh: 向右横摇扫过宾客：伯蒂、马克斯、艾迪森、卡斯韦尔小姐、钢琴师，停在角落里的伊芙。

shots.en: Close on Clawd in pearls and black curls on the staircase, raising the martini; slight push-in.
shots.zh: 楼梯上 Clawd 的近景：黑色卷发、珍珠项链，举起马提尼；镜头轻推。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Margo Channing: a row of black curls, a string of pearls, a martini, one arm on the banister. The first shot is the drawing being made and the line of dialogue being written; a pan finds Eve watching from the corner, and after the last cut Margo lifts the glass on the beat. Runs 1.8× fast.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮玛戈：一排黑色短卷发、一串珍珠、一杯马提尼，手搭在扶手上。第一镜是画面被画出来、台词被写出来；一个横摇找到角落里盯着她的伊芙；最后一个硬切后，玛戈踩着拍子举杯。表演 1.8 倍速。

films.title: An American in Paris
blend_en: Loose ink line over offset colour
blend_zh: 松动墨线 + 错开的色块
films.desc_en: Raoul Dufy's watercolour: fast blue-black ink lines over big transparent patches of cobalt, lemon and rose that never line up with them. The film's closing ballet was designed after Dufy, so the Place de la Concorde and its dancers are painted his way.
films.desc_zh: 拉乌尔·杜飞的水彩：快速的蓝黑墨线，底下是钴蓝、柠檬黄、玫瑰红的透明色块，线和色永远对不齐。影片结尾的芭蕾布景就是照杜飞画的，协和广场和舞者都用他的画法。
films.prompt_en: Paint in Raoul Dufy's watercolour manner: colour first, line second, never aligned. Transparent washes (wet edges, pooled rims, granulation) cover most of the frame, 10-40% oversized, slid one way by about 1/30 of frame width: cobalt #2258CE for sky and water, lemon #FCE02E for light and ground, rose #EC3A7C for warm planes. Overlaps mix violet or green, never brown; keep the hero's wash off blue. Then draw the whole scene densely in quick, thin blue-black ink (about 1/700 of frame width) with flicked ends: buildings, windows, figures, extras; straight edges overshoot corners; trees and clouds as looped strings. Ink #1E1E3A; bare paper 20-30%, skin included. The hero the story centres on gets its own wash (e.g. #D97757). Figures bounce. Camera: small pushes, cuts on the beat (or every 2 s). Avoid: muddy colour, lines tracing the colour, sparse line.
films.prompt_zh: 用拉乌尔·杜飞的水彩画法：先上色、后画线，两者永远对不齐。透明色块铺满大部分画面，带湿边、积色边和颗粒，比物体大一到四成，朝同一方向滑开约画幅宽 1/30：钴蓝 #2258CE 管天空和水，柠檬黄 #FCE02E 管光和地面，玫瑰红 #EC3A7C 管暖色面。重叠可混出紫或绿，绝不脏成棕，主角的色块别压在蓝上。再用蓝黑墨 #1E1E3A 快速细线把整个场景画满（线宽约画幅宽 1/700），有提按和甩尾：建筑、窗、人物、小配景；直边单独一笔、角上出头；树冠和云画成一串小圈。留白两到三成，皮肤是纸白。故事围绕的那个主角有自己的一块色（如 #D97757）。人物轻快有弹性。镜头：小推，踩拍子切（没有音乐约每 2 秒）。避免：颜色叠脏、线描死色块、线条稀疏。

shots.en: Wide on the Place de la Concorde: dancers whirl round the fountain below the obelisk and the Eiffel Tower; Clawd as Jerry, in a cobalt cap with a brush, hops beside Lise in yellow; small push-in.
shots.zh: 协和广场全景：舞者绕着喷泉旋转，后面是方尖碑和埃菲尔铁塔；扮杰瑞的 Clawd 戴钴蓝帽、拿画笔，在黄裙丽丝身边跳；镜头小幅推进。

shots.en: Close on Clawd mid-hop, the brush trailing a ribbon of paint, Lise's arm reaching in; slow push-in.
shots.zh: Clawd 跳在半空的近景，画笔甩出一条颜料带，丽丝的手臂伸进画面；镜头慢推。

shots.en: Cut to a flag-hung Paris street in pink, lemon and blue, Clawd hopping down the middle among strollers; slow push-in.
shots.zh: 切到插满三色旗的巴黎街道，楼面是粉、黄、蓝，Clawd 在街心行人之间蹦跳；镜头慢推。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Jerry from the poster: Gene Kelly's cobalt cap tipped back, a rose neckerchief, a painter's brush that swings a ribbon of paint. It hops on every beat through all three shots, so the dance itself is the cutting rhythm: the square, the close-up with Lise, then the bannered street. Runs 1.8× fast.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮海报上的杰瑞：往后歪的钴蓝软帽（吉恩·凯利那顶）、玫瑰红小领巾、甩出颜料带的画笔。三个镜头里它每一拍都在跳，舞步本身就是剪辑节奏：广场、和丽丝的近景、插满旗的街道。表演 1.8 倍速。
refs: Preston Ames and Irene Sharaff (ballet design)

films.title: The Greatest Show on Earth
blend_en: Flat ink with heavy black outline
blend_zh: 平涂油墨 + 粗黑轮廓
films.desc_en: A Strobridge circus lithograph: flat chrome yellow, vermilion and cobalt with heavy black outlines, screened and slightly off register on grainy stone. DeMille's big top becomes a three-ring poster, with Clawd as the Great Sebastian making the poster's trapeze catch.
films.desc_zh: Strobridge 马戏团彩色石印：铬黄、朱红、钴蓝平涂，粗黑轮廓，带网点、错版和石版颗粒。德米尔的大帐篷画成三圈海报，Clawd 扮塞巴斯蒂安做空中接人。
films.prompt_en: A circus chromolithograph after the Strobridge Lithographing Co. (c. 1890). Flat ink, heavy black outlines (about 1/300 of frame width), crescent shadows, light from upper left. Four stones: chrome yellow #F4C416, vermilion #D62C24, cobalt #1E4EA0, key black #181210 on warm cream paper #EBD9B4; overprints and tints give only orange, green, brown, tan, pale blue, grey. Solids print flat; screens (dots about 1/250 of frame width) only on gradients (sky, skin, ground), each stone at its own angle, 1-3 px off register, stone grain. The hero the story centres on is solid yellow under solid vermilion, a flat orange (e.g. #D97757). Exaggerated perspective, radial lines converging on the action, several actions at once; any crowd is tiny individual figures, though a lone figure works. Camera: tilt up, lateral dolly, cut on action. Avoid: off-palette colours, dot-only crowds, a screened, pinkish hero.
films.prompt_zh: 19 世纪末马戏团彩色石印，仿 Strobridge 石印公司。平涂油墨加粗黑轮廓（约画幅宽 1/300）；阴影是月牙形加深，加排线；光从左上来。四块石版：铬黄 #F4C416、朱红 #D62C24、钴蓝 #1E4EA0、黑 #181210，印在暖奶油纸 #EBD9B4 上；叠印和浅网只能得到橙、绿、棕、土黄、浅蓝、灰。实地平印，只有天空、皮肤、地面这类渐变处挂网（网点约画幅宽 1/250），各版网角不同，错位 1–3 像素，带石版颗粒。故事围绕的那个主角用黄实地叠朱红实地，得到平的橙（如 #D97757）。构图用夸张透视：放射线汇向主要动作，几件事同时发生；有人群时画成许多可辨的小人，只有一个人物也成立。镜头：上摇，横移，在动作中切到高潮。避免：四色以外的颜色、只有圆点的人群、挂网挂成粉色的主角。

shots.en: Wide in the big top: three rings, the bowl of spectators, elephants on the track; tilt up the canvas to Clawd hanging from the highest trapeze.
shots.zh: 大帐篷全景：三个表演圈、碗形看台、跑马道上的大象；沿帐篷往上摇，落到倒挂在最高秋千上的 Clawd。

shots.en: Lateral dolly along the elephant parade, trunk to tail under spangled riders, past the ring curb and the front-row heads.
shots.zh: 横移跟拍大象游行：一头卷着一头的尾巴，背上坐着亮片舞女，前景是围栏和前排观众的后脑勺。

shots.en: Cut on the action to the catch: Clawd, hanging by its knees in a spangled cape, holds the pink flyer in one hand and flings the other arm out to the crowd as the swing carries them right; the camera follows with a slight push and roll.
shots.zh: 动作中切到接人：Clawd 披亮片斗篷、膝弯倒挂，一只手抓住粉衣女飞人，另一只手向观众甩开，秋千把它们荡向右边；镜头跟着微推并略微倾斜。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays the Great Sebastian: a sequinned cape with a gold scalloped edge, upside down on the trapeze.
