The tilt up finds it on the bar, the elephant dolly keeps the parade moving through the middle, and the cut lands on the catch, timed so the swing is on the poster's right-hand side, arm flung out to the crowd.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮伟大的塞巴斯蒂安：金色扇贝边的亮片斗篷，倒挂在秋千上。上摇找到秋千杠上的它，中间的大象横移让游行一直往前走，最后在动作中切到接人那一下，时间卡在秋千荡到右边、和海报构图一致的位置，它把手臂甩向观众。
refs: The Greatest Show on Earth one-sheet (1952)

films.title: From Here to Eternity
films.desc_en: 1953 high-key black-and-white: hard sun, dark filtered sky, blown white foam, wet sand mirroring the sky, silver grain and halation. It stages the kiss in the surf at Halona Cove; Clawd, playing the bugle on the lava rock, is the only colour.
films.desc_zh: 1953 年的高调黑白：硬朗阳光、压暗的天空、泛白的浪沫、映着天的湿沙，银盐颗粒和光晕。拍哈洛纳海湾浪里那一吻；坐在熔岩上吹军号的 Clawd 是唯一的颜色。
films.prompt_en: Early-1950s high-key black-and-white photography, painted in 2D to read as a photo: no outlines or flat fills, only soft gradients plus fine texture (sand, rock pitting, cloth). Values: about 70% of the frame above mid-grey; sky light-mid grey, one step below the bright clouds; deep blacks small. Default: hard midday sun, short crisp shadows; under other light keep the pale sky and bright values. Water, foam and mist blow out at the peaks, keeping lace detail; wet surfaces mirror the sky. Print finish: gentle S-curve, slightly soft lens, halation, fresh fine grain (±4%), light vignette, flicker. Only the hero the story centres on keeps colour, whole figure (e.g. #D97757), shaded photographically. Camera: tilt down from the sky, tight level frame, slow pull-back. Reference: cinematographer Burnett Guffey (*From Here to Eternity*). Avoid: low-key frames, white blanks, cartoon fills.
films.prompt_zh: 50 年代初高调的黑白外景摄影，用 2D 画出照片感：不描线、不平涂，只用柔和渐变加细腻纹理（沙粒、岩石麻点、布纹）。明暗：约七成画面亮于中灰；天空浅中灰，只比亮云暗一档；深黑很少。默认正午硬朗的太阳，影子短而清楚；其他光线下仍保持浅天空和明亮结构。水、浪沫或雾在最亮处冲白，留住蕾丝细节；湿的表面映着天空。按印片收尾：柔和 S 曲线、略软的镜头、高光晕、每帧刷新的细颗粒（±4%）、轻暗角、轻微闪烁。只有故事围绕的那个主角整个人保留颜色（如 #D97757），明暗也有照片感。镜头：从天空下摇，平视紧框，再慢慢拉远。对标摄影师 Burnett Guffey（《乱世忠魂》）。避免：低调暗沉、死白一片、卡通平涂。

shots.en: Open on the sky over Halona Cove, a formation of planes among the cumulus; tilt down to the sea.
shots.zh: 开在哈洛纳海湾上空，积云间飞过一队飞机；镜头往下摇到海面。

shots.en: Tight and level on the lovers in the swash: the breaker runs up over them and recedes to lace while the kiss goes on; slow push with a drift right.
shots.zh: 平视紧框浪里的恋人：浪头冲上来盖过他们，又退成蕾丝般的白沫，两人一直在吻；镜头慢推并向右漂移。

shots.en: Wide on the cove: Clawd, in a garrison cap on the lava ledge, lifts the bugle and plays toward the lovers; slight pull-back.
shots.zh: 海湾全景：戴船形帽的 Clawd 坐在熔岩石台上，举起军号朝恋人吹响；镜头微微拉远。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Prewitt, with an olive garrison cap and the army bugle from the poster. The sky shot tilts down into the cove, the wave covers the kiss across the middle shot, and on the cut to the wide Clawd lifts the bugle to its mouth on the beat, as if playing the scene out.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮普鲁伊特：橄榄色船形帽，拿着海报上那支军号。天空一镜往下摇进海湾，中间一镜海浪盖过那一吻，切到全景时 Clawd 踩着拍子把军号举到嘴边，像是在为这场戏吹号。

films.title: On the Waterfront
blend_zh: 50 年代美国社会现实主义
films.desc_en: Ben Shahn's social realism: a trembling, blotted ink line over flat tempera blocks laid slightly off the drawing, big hands and long working faces, restrained slate, brick and ochre. Shahn painted dockers and union halls, which is this film's world.
films.desc_zh: 本·沙恩的社会现实主义：颤抖的转印墨线，下面是错开的平涂蛋彩色块，大手长脸的工人，颜色克制在灰蓝、砖红、赭黄。沙恩画的就是码头工人和工会，正是这部片的世界。
films.prompt_en: Ben Shahn's social-realist tempera. Ink lines (about 1/500 of frame width) jitter and wander, break each outline into two or three strokes, sometimes doubled by a fainter offset ghost (a blotted line). Flat tempera blocks sit 2-4 px off the line, rough-edged, dry-brush streaks (one brush wide, about 1/100 of frame width) over a third of each block; model form with a darker flat of the same hue. Palette by role: slate #768492 sky and cool areas, brick #9E4834 and ochre #C89852 ground, buildings, clothes, ink #1F1A1A, warm board #F0E9DA; skin pale ochre; other colours: these darkened or greyed. The hero the story centres on wears the one warm accent on its main garment (e.g. #D97757). Big heads and hands, long faces, heavy jaws, heavy clothes. Camera: short pushes, tilt up, close-up. Avoid: smooth gradients, clean closed outlines, cheerful colour.
films.prompt_zh: 仿本·沙恩的社会写实蛋彩画。墨线（宽约画幅宽 1/500）会颤：细抖叠着慢摆，一个轮廓分两三笔、不闭合，偶有转印鬼线（旁边多一道偏移的淡线）。颜色是平涂蛋彩块，比墨线偏 2–4 像素，边缘毛糙，每块约三分之一面积带干笔拖痕，拖痕一笔宽（约画幅宽 1/100），不随色块放大；明暗只用同色深一档的硬边平色。配色按用途：灰蓝 #768492 管天空和冷色区，砖红 #9E4834、赭黄 #C89852 管房屋、土地和衣服，墨 #1F1A1A，底板暖白 #F0E9DA；皮肤浅赭；其他颜色由这几色加深或加灰。故事围绕的那个主角的主要衣服用唯一的暖色（如 #D97757）。人物头大手大、长脸重下巴，衣服下垂。镜头：短推，上摇，收在近景。避免：平滑渐变、干净闭合的轮廓、鲜亮讨喜的颜色。

shots.en: Medium on the morning shape-up at Pier B: dockers jam the gate and their hands go up for the brass tags, Clawd out of frame; slight push-in.
shots.zh: PIER B 门口清晨派工的中景：码头工人挤在门前，一双双手举起来抢铜工牌，Clawd 不在画面里；镜头轻推。

shots.en: Wide on Terry's rooftop coop: Clawd, in a knit cap and plaid collar, holds a pigeon on its raised hand beside Edie, the water tower and Manhattan skyline behind, as the flock lifts off; slow push with a slight tilt up.
shots.zh: 屋顶鸽舍全景：戴针织帽、立着格子领的 Clawd 举手托着一只鸽子，旁边是伊迪，身后是水塔和曼哈顿天际线，鸽群飞起；镜头慢推并略微上摇。

shots.en: Close on Clawd and the grey pigeon on its hand, a freighter, rooftops and the skyline over its shoulder; slight push-in.
shots.zh: Clawd 和手上灰鸽的近景，肩后是货轮、屋顶和天际线；镜头轻推。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Terry Malloy: a navy knit cap, red-and-black plaid collar and cuff, a pigeon on its hand. The hard cut from the clamouring hands at the dock to the quiet rooftop puts the film's two worlds side by side; the flock rises across the middle shot, and the close-up rests on Clawd and the bird. Runs 1.8× fast.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮特里：深藏青针织帽、红黑格子的领子和袖口，手上停着一只鸽子。从码头上争抢的手硬切到安静的屋顶，两个镜头就把这部片的两个世界摆在一起；中间一镜鸽群飞起，近景停在 Clawd 和鸽子身上。表演 1.8 倍速。

films.title: Marty
blend_zh: 暖色 50 年代客厅插画
films.desc_en: A 1955 kinescope playing on a wood-cabinet TV in a warm Bronx living room: scanlines, phosphor glow, a rounded bulging screen, ghosting and snow, all black-and-white except Clawd. Marty began as a live 1953 TV play, so the film is shown as television.
films.desc_zh: 1955 年的电视录像，在布朗克斯暖色客厅的电视里播：扫描线、荧光晕、圆角凸屏、雪花，只有 Clawd 有颜色。原作是直播电视剧，所以当电视拍。
films.prompt_en: A 1950s kinescope playing on a wood-cabinet television. Inside the screen: black-and-white with a cool phosphor tint (#DCE6EA whites), soft (half resolution, scaled up), halation, ghosting, tearing bands, a rolling hum bar, light snow, lifted blacks, flicker, grain; only the story's hero keeps its colour (e.g. #D97757), under the same artefacts. Tube: rounded corners, sides bowing outward, about 330 scanlines, glass reflections. Outside, a warm flat-illustrated living room (ochre wallpaper, wood, a table lamp), lit warm by the lamp; the screen casts a clear cold-blue glow on nearby walls. Signature shot: hold about 2 s with the TV filling 60% of the frame, then push through the glass (4-5 s) until the broadcast fills the frame, scanlines visible, then steady TV-studio mid shots. Reference: director Delbert Mann's live Philco Television Playhouse dramas. Avoid: heavy snow, a dull, evenly lit room.
films.prompt_zh: 把场景做成 50 年代木壳电视里播放的 kinescope 录像。屏幕里：黑白，冷色荧光调（白位约 #DCE6EA），画面发软（半分辨率再放大），有光晕、重影、撕裂带、缓慢滚动的暗带、少量雪花、抬起的黑位、闪烁和颗粒；只有故事围绕的那个主角保留颜色（如 #D97757），同样带这些瑕疵。显像管：圆角、四边外鼓，约 330 条扫描线，玻璃反光。屏幕外是暖色扁平插画风的客厅（赭黄墙纸、木家具、台灯），台灯打暖光，屏幕在附近墙面投出明显的冷蓝光。招牌镜头：电视占画面约六成，先停约 2 秒，再用 4–5 秒推进玻璃，直到节目铺满画面、扫描线还在，然后用演播室式稳定中景拍戏。对标导演 Delbert Mann 的 Philco 电视剧场直播剧。避免：雪花盖住画面、客厅沉闷平光。

shots.en: Ma's parlour, lamp and rotary phone at left, her wing chair at right: the Stardust Ballroom on the TV, and the camera pushes in through the glass.
shots.zh: 妈妈的客厅：左边是台灯和转盘电话，右边是她的翼背椅，电视里在播星尘舞厅；镜头推进屏幕玻璃。

shots.en: Two-shot across the dance floor, scanlines still on: Clawd, in a butcher's paper cap and striped tie, walks over from the pillar toward Clara; the camera tracks right.
shots.zh: 跨过舞池的双人镜头，扫描线仍在：戴屠夫纸帽、系条纹领带的 Clawd 从柱子边走向克拉拉；镜头向右跟移。

shots.en: Medium on the ask: Clawd holds out its hand, and Clara lifts her eyes to it and smiles; slight push with a drift right.
shots.zh: 邀舞的中景：Clawd 伸出手，克拉拉抬眼看它，笑了；镜头轻推并向右漂移。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Marty: a white butcher's paper cap and a striped tie, shy by the pillar. The push through the glass takes us from the living room into the broadcast; it works up the nerve and crosses the floor in the two-shot, and the last cut lands on the ask, hand out, with Clara's smile arriving just after.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮马蒂：白色屠夫纸帽和一条条纹领带，害羞地靠在柱子边。推进玻璃把我们从客厅带进节目；双人镜头里它鼓起勇气穿过舞池，最后一个硬切落在邀舞上：它伸出手，克拉拉的笑随后才来。

films.title: Around the World in 80 Days
films.style_zh: 50 年代 UPA 现代主义卡通
films.desc_en: A flat, geometric 1950s cartoon: colour blocks printed off their ink lines, broken outlines, crayon grain on cream paper. The film's own six-minute end-title animation was made by Saul Bass in this modernist style.
films.desc_zh: 50 年代平面几何卡通：色块和墨线错位套印、墨线断续、奶油纸上的蜡笔颗粒。本片 6 分钟的片尾动画就出自 Saul Bass，正是这种现代主义画法。
films.prompt_en: 1950s UPA modernist cartoon. Uneven ink lines #221C19 about 1/400 of frame width, sometimes broken; colour blocks sit about 1/300 of frame width off them, all one way. Objects are overlapping flat cut-out facets: a lit face and a shadow face one flat step (about 15%) darker. Pale aqua sky and cream paper #F2E9D3 cover most of the frame; mustard #E3A92B, teal #2B8C86, orange-red #D4452B are accents; sky, greens and slate blues are these mixed toward paper. Other times of day change only the sky colour. Crayon grain ±5% brightness everywhere, few flecks. Poster layout: one big graphic shape (a building or sun disc), angular outlined figures beside it. Light beams: flat pale wedges. Hard cuts every 1–2 s; slow parallax drift. After UPA, *Gerald McBoing-Boing* (1950); Saul Bass, *Around the World in 80 Days* titles (1956). Avoid: gradients, perfect registration, saturated colour everywhere.
films.prompt_zh: 50 年代 UPA 现代主义卡通。墨线 #221C19 约画面宽的 1/400，有粗细、偶尔断开；色块相对墨线统一朝一个方向错开约 1/300。物体由重叠的平面剪片拼成：一块受光面，加一块同色深约一成半的平色暗面。明亮通透：浅水绿天空和奶油纸 #F2E9D3 占大半画面，芥末黄 #E3A92B、青绿 #2B8C86、橙红 #D4452B 只作点缀；天空、草绿、灰蓝由这些色兑纸色得到。其他时段只改天空颜色。全画面轻蜡笔颗粒（亮度 ±5%），少量纸白斑点。海报构图：一个大图形（建筑、日轮或山峰），旁边是带轮廓的棱角人物。光束画成浅色平涂楔形。机位之间每一两秒硬切，段内慢视差。对标 UPA《Gerald McBoing-Boing》（1950）、Saul Bass《环游地球八十天》片尾（1956）。避免：渐变、套色太准、饱和色铺满画面。

shots.en: Map insert, locked off: a globe turns on a teal ground as the red route runs London, Suez, Bombay, Yokohama, San Francisco; a small balloon carrying Clawd floats at the right.
shots.zh: 地图插入镜头，定机位：青绿底上的地球仪转动，红色航线依次跑过伦敦、苏伊士、孟买、横滨、旧金山；右边一只小气球里坐着 Clawd。

shots.en: Wide: the mustard-and-blue checkerboard balloon drifts over the faceted Alps and a Swiss village, Clawd in a top hat at the basket rail; slow lateral pan.
shots.zh: 全景：芥末黄配蓝色棋盘带的热气球飘过分面的阿尔卑斯和瑞士小镇，戴高礼帽的 Clawd 站在吊篮边；缓慢横移。

shots.en: Close on Clawd as Fogg, with top hat, furled umbrella and a raised champagne coupe, while Passepartout leans out with an ice bucket to scoop snow off the peak; slight push in.
shots.zh: Clawd 扮的福格近景：高礼帽、收起的雨伞、举着香槟杯，旁边路路通探身用冰桶从雪峰尖上舀雪；轻微推近。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Phileas Fogg: top hat, furled umbrella, a glass of champagne. Three hard cuts, two beats each: map, wide, close. The route races round the globe, the balloon drifts over the Alps, and the close lands on Passepartout scooping snow to chill the champagne.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮福格：高礼帽、收起的雨伞、一杯香槟。每两拍一刀硬切：地图、全景、近景。红色航线绕地球跑一圈，气球飘过阿尔卑斯，近景落在路路通从雪峰上舀雪冰镇香槟。

films.title: The Bridge on the River Kwai
films.desc_en: A general-arrangement blueprint pinned to a drafting table: white lines on Prussian blue, folds, water stains, red-pencil revisions. The film is about a colonel obsessed with building a perfect bridge, so the bridge appears as his engineering drawing.
films.desc_zh: 钉在绘图桌上的总布置图：普鲁士蓝底上的白线、折痕、水渍和红铅笔修改。电影讲一个执意把桥造好的上校，所以把桥画成他的工程图。
films.prompt_en: Cyanotype engineering blueprint. The sheet fills the frame (the walnut drafting table shows only on a pull-back): mottled Prussian-blue paper #143874, uneven exposure, a greenish over-exposed margin, creases, faint water stains. White lines #ECF4FF, sharp but printed: outlines about 1/600 of frame width, hatching and dimensions half that, broken where exposure was weak, a slight cyan bloom. Draw the subject densely in drafting grammar: elevations, sections, detail circles, dimension chains, hidden lines, single-stroke lettering, a title block. Notes and actions in red pencil #D63426, in the user's language. The one hero subject is the only hand-painted element, drawn above scale (at least 1/5 of frame height), opaque gouache in one warm hue (e.g. orange #D97757); nothing else is warm. Camera: layered parallax push-in; cut to detail views. Avoid: neon glow, clean digital blue, sparse sheets.
films.prompt_zh: 青晒工程蓝图。图纸铺满画面（胡桃木绘图桌只在拉远时露出）：斑驳的普鲁士蓝纸 #143874，曝光不匀，边缘过曝发绿，有折痕和淡水渍。白线 #ECF4FF 锐利但是印出来的：轮廓约画面宽的 1/600，剖面线和尺寸线减半，曝光弱处断续，带几像素青色微晕。用制图语法把主体画得密：立面、剖面、详图圈、尺寸链、虚线、单线工程字、标题栏。批注和动作用红铅笔 #D63426，写用户的语言。唯一的主角是图上唯一手绘上色的东西，比图纸比例放大（至少占画面高五分之一），不透明水粉，一种暖色分几个深浅（比如橙 #D97757），其余没有暖色。镜头：推近时各层视差，再切详图。避免：霓虹发光、干净的数码蓝、空荡的图纸。

shots.en: Medium wide on the bridge elevation: Clawd (Colonel Nicholson) on the deck whistling, notes rising, POWs marching below left, the exploder at right and a train coming on from the far right; slow push in.
shots.zh: 桥立面的中全景：Clawd（尼科尔森上校）站在桥面上吹口哨，音符往上飘，左下战俘列队行进，右边是引爆器，火车从最右边开上来；缓慢推近。

shots.en: Insert on the exploder box ('PLUNGER – ONE PUSH'): the T-handle goes down, the red-pencil wire running off to the charges; slight push in.
shots.zh: 引爆器箱特写（PLUNGER – ONE PUSH）：T 形手柄按下，红铅笔引线通向炸药；轻微推近。

shots.en: Back on the elevation: the charges go off in a scribbled red-pencil fireball inside hatched smoke clouds, the span and the train's carriages drop into the river; slow pull back.
shots.zh: 回到桥立面：炸药炸开，红铅笔乱线画成的火球裹在排线画的烟团里，桥跨和火车车厢落进河里；缓慢拉远。

films.direction_en: Clawd is Colonel Nicholson: a British officer's peaked cap and a swagger stick, whistling on its own bridge. Three cuts build cause and effect: the train rolls on, the plunger goes down, the span blows. The explosion stays inside the drawing, a red-pencil scribble and hatched smoke rather than real fire.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮尼科尔森上校：英军大檐帽、军官短手杖，站在自己的桥上吹口哨。三个镜头讲因果：火车开上桥、引爆器手柄按下、桥跨炸断。爆炸也留在图纸里：红铅笔乱线成火球，排线画烟，不画真实的火光。

films.title: Gigi
films.style_zh: 罗特列克美好年代石印
films.desc_en: A Toulouse-Lautrec colour lithograph: flat poster colour, dry-brush contours, spattered ink instead of halftone, caricatured faces. Gigi's big moment is walking into Maxim's while all of Paris stares, and Lautrec drew exactly that Paris.
films.desc_zh: 图卢兹-罗特列克式彩色石印：大块平涂、飞白轮廓、用喷溅墨点代替网点、讽刺漫画式面孔。琪琪的高光时刻是走进马克西姆餐厅、全巴黎回头盯着她，正是罗特列克画过的巴黎。
films.prompt_en: Belle Époque colour lithograph after Toulouse-Lautrec. Flat colour plates with wobbly edges; figures and main shapes outlined in a loaded brush (blunt start, swelling middle, split dry tail), about 1/250 of frame width. Crachis only on shadow sides, cast shadows and glows: 1–3 px dots at 1920×1080, sparse, under 15% of the frame, a darker step of the colour beneath. Large surfaces get grouped dry-brush streaks. Palette: yellow #F1C232, orange-red #E0602C, olive #6E7036, black #1D1A16 on cream stone-grained paper #EFE3C3, plus a muted bottle teal and greyed mauve; flesh is orange-red thinned with paper. Caricatured profiles with drawn faces; one large figure cropped by the frame edge in front. Flat, even light; shadows are flat plates. Camera: shallow parallax, a slow pan settling on a medium shot. Avoid: Mucha halos, smooth gradients, regular halftone, all-over speckle.
films.prompt_zh: 罗特列克式美好年代彩色石印。大块平涂色版，边缘略手抖；人物和主要形体用饱蘸的笔刷勾轮廓，起笔钝、中段鼓、收尾分叉飞白，粗约画面宽的 1/250。牙刷弹的墨点只在背光面、投影和光晕处：1920×1080 下点径一到三像素，稀疏，合计不到画面一成半，颜色取底色深一档。大面用成组的同向干笔条纹。色板：黄 #F1C232、橙红 #E0602C、橄榄绿 #6E7036、黑 #1D1A16，底是带石版颗粒的奶油纸 #EFE3C3；另加灰暗的瓶绿和淡紫，肤色是橙红兑纸色。人物是夸张的讽刺侧脸，画出五官；前景放一个被画框裁掉的大人物。光平而匀，阴影也是平涂色版。镜头：浅视差，慢慢横摇过场景，落到中景。避免：慕夏式光环、平滑渐变、规整网点、满屏黑点。

shots.en: Wide of Maxim's: Clawd (Gaston) in top hat and white tie walks Gigi in on its arm between two cropped foreground silhouettes; the nearest diners start to turn; slow push, drifting right.
shots.zh: 马克西姆餐厅全景：戴高礼帽、白领结的 Clawd（加斯东）挽着琪琪走进来，两侧是被裁掉的前景剪影；最近的几桌客人开始回头；缓慢推近并向右漂移。

shots.en: Lateral pan along the red banquette: caricatured diners turn to stare, lorgnettes up, fans stopped.
shots.zh: 沿红丝绒卡座横摇：一张张讽刺漫画式的面孔转过来瞪着看，长柄眼镜举起，扇子停住。

shots.en: Mid shot of the pair still walking in; Gigi's eyes come to the lens and she winks, as on the poster; slight drift right.
shots.zh: 两人继续往里走的中景；琪琪的目光转向镜头，眨了一下眼，和原海报一样；轻微右移。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Gaston: top hat, white tie and cane, with Gigi on its arm. The couple keeps walking and the room's gaze follows them. Three cuts on the beat: the entrance, the stares in a pan along the banquette, then the pair again for Gigi's wink to camera.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮加斯东：高礼帽、白领结、手杖，琪琪挽着它。两人一直往里走，满屋的目光跟着转。三刀卡在拍子上：进门全景、横摇众人瞪眼、再回到两人，琪琪对镜头眨眼收尾。
refs: Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec, Moulin Rouge: La Goulue (1891)

films.title: Ben-Hur
films.style_zh: 3D 大竞技场战车赛 · 65mm 史诗
films.desc_en: A fully procedural 3D Circus in widescreen-epic light: hard desert sun, dust, marble and gold, a Technicolor grade and 65mm grain. The chariot race is the film's most famous sequence, so the scene is the race, under the poster's golden colossus.
films.desc_zh: 程序生成的 3D 大竞技场，宽银幕史诗光感：沙漠烈日、沙尘、大理石和金色，特艺七彩调色加 65mm 颗粒。战车赛是全片最有名的段落，就直接拍比赛，头顶是海报上的金色巨神。
films.prompt_en: 1959 65mm widescreen epic built in 3D. Default: hard high sun (about 50°), short crisp shadows, cobalt sky fading to sandy white; under a low sun shadows stay hard but long, the sky turns amber. Marble, gilt, red granite and sandstone, with mouldings and fluted columns, never bare boxes. Warm sunlit haze mixes about 20% into mid-distance colours. Technicolor-print grade: warm, saturated, slightly contrasty, no clipping or bloom; fine grain (±3%), slight gate weave. Scale is the point: monumental architecture, statues and repeated elements fill the background, never empty. The one hero subject (e.g. orange #D97757) is the most saturated thing in frame; any repeated motion (stride, wheel, oar) keeps time with speed. Signature shot: low tracking beside the moving hero, 35–50 mm full-frame; then wide, top-down, close-up, low angle. Avoid: clean CG light, empty or primitive sets, overexposure.
films.prompt_zh: 1959 年 65mm 宽银幕史诗，用 3D 搭。默认是硬朗的高太阳（约 50°），影子短而利，天空钴蓝、到地平线渐成沙白；太阳低时影子仍硬但拉长，天空转琥珀色。大理石、镀金、红花岗岩和沙色石头，做出线脚和槽柱，不能是光秃方盒。暖色尘雾约两成混进中景颜色。调色像 Technicolor 拷贝：暖、饱和、略高反差，不过曝不加辉光；细颗粒（±3%）、轻微片门晃动。核心是规模：背景布满宏伟建筑、雕像和重复元素，绝不空。唯一的主角（比如橙 #D97757）是画面里最饱和的东西；重复动作（步伐、轮、桨）节奏随速度。招牌镜头：全画幅等效 35 到 50mm，低机位贴着运动的主角跟拍；其次是大全景、正俯、近景、仰拍。避免：干净的 CG 光、空荡粗糙的布景、过曝。

shots.en: Wide on the white start line: nine four-horse chariots side by side, Clawd's white team among them, the packed stands behind; the teams launch as the lens slowly tightens.
shots.zh: 起跑白线大全景：九辆四马战车并排，Clawd 的白马队在其中，身后看台坐满；车队冲出，镜头慢慢收紧。

shots.en: High overhead on the east turn: the chariots sling round the gilded turning posts, dust arcing behind them.
shots.zh: 东弯高位俯拍：战车绕过镀金转弯柱甩出去，身后扬起弧形尘土。

shots.en: Low tracking shot alongside Clawd's chariot: white horses at full gallop, spinning spokes, dust; the camera moves forward with it.
shots.zh: 贴着 Clawd 的战车并行跟拍：白马全速奔跑、车辐飞转、尘土飞扬；镜头随车前移。

shots.en: Low between the two chariots: Messala's bladed hub bites into Clawd's wheel and throws sparks; the camera rides with the chariots.
shots.zh: 两车之间的低机位：梅萨拉的锯齿刀毂咬住 Clawd 的车轮，火花四溅；镜头跟车一起走。

shots.en: Close on Clawd cracking the whip from its chariot, Messala's black team alongside; slow push in.
shots.zh: Clawd 在战车上挥鞭的近景，旁边是梅萨拉的黑马；缓慢推近。

shots.en: The poster shot: low side angle as Clawd's white team draws level under a golden seated colossus on the spina, stands and governor's box behind; the lens slowly widens.
shots.zh: 海报构图：低角度侧拍，Clawd 的白马队在中央隔墙的金色坐像巨神下追平，身后是看台和总督看台；镜头慢慢放宽。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Judah Ben-Hur: a linen headband, reins in one hand and a whip in the other, behind four white horses. Six shots in five seconds cover the race the way the 1959 second unit did: start, turn, tracking, wheels, close, poster. Every set-up moves with the chariots, so the pace never drops.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮犹大·宾虚：额上一条亚麻头带，一手握缰一手举鞭，驾四匹白马。五秒六个镜头，照 1959 年第二摄制组的拍法走一遍：起跑、弯道、跟拍、车轮、近景、海报构图。每个机位都跟着战车在动，节奏不掉。

films.title: The Apartment
films.style_en: Saul Bass Line Titles in Black & White
films.style_zh: Saul Bass 线条片头 · 黑白
films.desc_en: Saul Bass's sliding white lines on black build the endless one-point-perspective office of the film's best-known shot, then fill with grey tones. Bass designed this film's titles; the only warm colour is Clawd and its key tag.
films.desc_zh: Saul Bass 式的白线在黑底上滑入，搭出电影最有名的一点透视无尽办公大厅，再填上灰调。本片片头就是 Bass 做的；全画面唯一的暖色是 Clawd 和钥匙牌。
films.prompt_en: Saul Bass title lines turned into a set. A shot opens on black: thin white lines (about 1/800 of frame width) slide in and grow into a grid; by 2–3 s grey planes fill in and lights switch on row by row. Then hold the finished frame 3 s: mid-to-light grey, flat fills in 4–5 even steps from #140F0D to #F4F1E8, every shape outlined in dark line about 1/600 of frame width. Strict one-point perspective, centred vanishing point; identical elements repeat into depth (desks and people, or posts, lamps, windows). Figures: flat two-tone shapes. The only warm colour is orange-red #E2472A, for the one hero subject and one prop; all light stays white. Camera: a fast push to the hero, a hard cut to top-down, the grid becoming pattern. Avoid: sketchy lines, gradients, colour leaks, skewed perspective, unfilled wireframe.
films.prompt_zh: 把 Saul Bass 片头的线条做成布景，黑白加一个暖色。镜头从全黑开始：细白线（约画面宽的 1/800）滑入、向纵深长成网格；两三秒内灰面填满，灯一排排亮起。之后完成态停约三秒：中到浅灰，从 #140F0D 到 #F4F1E8 均匀分四五级平涂，每个形体有约画面宽 1/600 的深色轮廓。严格一点透视，灭点居中；一样的东西重复排向纵深（有人群时是桌子和人，单人时是柱子、路灯、窗格）。人物是两色平涂。唯一的暖色是橙红 #E2472A，只给唯一的主角和一件道具；所有光都是白的。轻颗粒、柔暗角。镜头：急推到主角，硬切到正上方俯视，网格变成图案。避免：草稿感的线、渐变、颜色渗入、透视歪、没填色的暗线框。

shots.en: One continuous shot: white lines build the endless office out of black, grey tones and ceiling lights come up row by row; Clawd (Baxter) on its front-row desk lifts the apartment key on beat 2 and the camera crash-pushes in.
shots.zh: 一镜到底：白线从全黑里搭出无尽的办公大厅，灰调和天花灯一排排亮起；坐在前排桌沿的 Clawd（巴克斯特）在第 2 拍举起公寓钥匙，镜头急推过去。

shots.en: Hard cut to a straight-down top view: the desks become a grid, Clawd lying face-up on its desk with the key and tag; slow push in.
shots.zh: 硬切到正上方俯视：桌子排成一张网格，Clawd 仰面躺在自己桌上，手里是钥匙和牌子；缓慢推近。

films.direction_en: Clawd is C.C. Baxter: a bowler hat and the apartment key with its orange-red tag (51 W 67), sitting on the front edge of its desk. The office draws itself line by line, the key goes up on beat 2 with a crash push, and the cut to the overhead desk grid sets up the next film, which opens on Manhattan's street grid from above.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮 C.C. 巴克斯特：圆顶礼帽、挂着橙红牌子（51 W 67）的公寓钥匙，坐在前排桌沿。办公大厅一根线一根线画出来，第 2 拍举钥匙、镜头急推；最后切到俯视的桌阵网格，和下一部开场俯拍的曼哈顿街区网格做图形匹配。

films.title: West Side Story
blend_en: 1961 poster: red sky, black fire escape
films.desc_en: A saturated, stage-like 3D block of the Upper West Side under a red-orange Technicolor sunset: red brick, zigzag fire escapes, rooftop water towers, posable dancers. It restages the aerial opening, the Jets' snaps and the poster's leap against the red sky.
films.desc_zh: 红橙特艺七彩晚霞下的上西区 3D 街区，饱和、舞台化：红砖、之字形消防梯、屋顶水塔、能摆姿势的舞者人偶。重演电影的俯拍开场、Jets 打响指和海报上那一跃。
films.prompt_en: Technicolor 3D stage set, like a 1960s studio musical. Simplified geometry, dense detail on every built surface (openings with sills, ledges, railings, ladders, strung lines); textured brick, plaster or rock, never plain. Theatrical light: a low warm sun rakes surfaces with long shadows; cool fill a quarter of the key. Painted sky of red-orange #E0481E, gold-edged cloud bands, violet only at the top edge; warm haze in the distance. The one hero subject in saturated orange #D97757, at least 1/6 of frame height, set against dark brick or given a black rim so it never melts into the sky. Puppet-like mannequin figures. Warm, saturated grade, fine grain (±3%). Signature shot: a low angle against the orange sky; then one continuous descent into the set and a ground-level push. Avoid: photoreal grime, violet-pink skies, plain walls, poses that pop.
films.prompt_zh: Technicolor 3D 舞台布景，像 60 年代棚拍歌舞片。几何简化，每个面都细节密集（窗洞窗台、檐口、栏杆、梯子、绳线）；表面是有质感的砖、灰泥或岩石，不能素面。剧场布光：低角度暖阳斜扫表面拉出长影；冷补光约为主光四分之一。手绘天空以橙红 #E0481E 为主，云带镶金边，只在最上沿带一点紫；远处融进暖雾。唯一的主角用饱和橙 #D97757，至少占画面高六分之一，背后衬深色砖墙或加一圈黑边，不能化进天空。人物是木偶式假人。暖而饱和的调色，细颗粒（±3%）。招牌镜头：衬着橙色天空的低角度仰拍；其次一个连续镜头从高处降进布景、再贴地推进。避免：写实脏旧、紫粉天空、素面墙、动作跳变。

shots.en: Straight-down aerial over the West Side grid (rooftops, water towers, the playground court), descending and tilting up into the street.
shots.zh: 正上方俯拍西区街区网格（屋顶、水塔、操场球场），一路下降、抬头落进街道。

shots.en: Low at the court's edge, the Jets' wedge snapping fingers behind Clawd by the graffiti wall; one continuous push swings round and in to a close-up of Clawd snapping on the drum hits.
shots.zh: 球场边低机位，Jets 帮在涂鸦墙前排成楔形打响指，Clawd 在前；一条连续的推镜绕过去推到 Clawd 近景，它的响指卡在鼓点上。

shots.en: Low angle under the fire escape: Clawd crouches and leaps in one arc against the red sky beside a dancer's jeté, the camera tilting up with the arc.
shots.zh: 消防梯下仰拍：Clawd 下蹲、起跳，一条抛物线压在红天上，旁边是舞者的大跳；镜头随弧线抬起。

shots.en: Close on the fire-escape landing: Clawd strikes a match, the camera pushes in until the flame sits at frame centre, then it is blown out.
shots.zh: 消防梯平台近景：Clawd 划亮火柴，镜头推近直到火苗停在画面正中，随后被吹灭。

films.direction_en: Clawd joins the Jets with no costume; the set does the identifying. Snaps land on the drum hits, and the leap is one clean arc from crouch to landing squash. The opening aerial answers The Apartment's desk grid, and the struck match sits at frame centre exactly where Lawrence of Arabia's sun rises after the cut.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 混进 Jets 帮，没有戏服，靠场景认片。响指卡在鼓点上；腾跃是一条干净的抛物线，从下蹲到落地缓冲一气呵成。开场俯拍呼应上一部的桌阵网格；结尾划亮的火柴在画面正中，正是下一部日出的位置，做匹配剪辑。

films.title: Lawrence of Arabia
films.desc_en: Painterly epic-poster gouache with visible directional strokes and a hard warm–cool split: amber sand against cobalt sky. Lawrence of Arabia's original poster was painted by Howard Terpning in exactly this manner.
films.desc_zh: 看得见笔触方向的史诗海报水粉，冷暖对比强烈：琥珀色沙漠对钴蓝天空。《阿拉伯的劳伦斯》原海报就是 Howard Terpning 用这种画法画的。
films.prompt_en: 1960s hand-painted epic film poster, gouache with oil highlights. Draw forms solidly, then paint: an opaque mid-tone base, directional strokes following each form (1/80–1/50 of frame width on large areas, smaller on faces and hands), soft-blended edges; model every form in three values; dry-brush only on dust, cloth and distant figures; sharp warm-cream highlights last on lit edges. Warm–cool contrast: cobalt sky #1F4D97 to pale blue #A9C3D6, warming to cream near a low sun; ground #EEC27A (any terrain); ochre-red #B56A33 for skin, earth and costume; violet #6C6394 for distant shadows. The hero centred and largest, a diagonal gesture, cloth streaming; smaller, looser figures may recede behind. Light board grain (±3%), warm vignette, haze. Motion: bounce, slow push to a low close-up, a whip pan out. Avoid: scratchy uniform hatching, flat digital fills, cold-only colour.
films.prompt_zh: 60 年代手绘史诗电影海报，水粉打底、油彩提亮。先把形体画扎实再上色：铺不透明中间调底色，再用顺形体走的笔触（大面宽约画面宽的 1/80 到 1/50，脸和手用小笔），边缘柔和衔接；每个形体分亮、中、暗三级；干笔只用在尘土、布料和远处人物上；最后在受光边缘压锐利的暖奶油色高光。冷暖对比：钴蓝天空 #1F4D97 过渡到浅蓝 #A9C3D6，低垂的太阳周围转暖；地面 #EEC27A（任何地形），皮肤、泥土和衣服用赭红 #B56A33，远处阴影用紫 #6C6394。主角居中最大，一个斜向动作，布料飘起；身后可以有更小更松的人物退远。轻画板颗粒、暖暗角、雾气。运动：起伏、缓推到仰角近景、甩镜出画。避免：又碎又匀的刮擦线、平涂数码色、只有冷色。

shots.en: Extreme wide of an empty desert at dawn: a huge sun rising through heat haze at frame centre, matched to the blown-out match; slow push in.
shots.zh: 空旷沙漠的黎明大远景：一轮巨大的太阳在画面正中透过热浪升起，和上一部吹灭的火柴做匹配剪辑；缓慢推近。

shots.en: Poster framing from the camera car: Clawd (Lawrence) gallops in on a camel among charging riders, scimitar low, then raised on the beat with a glint; jolting shake, gentle push.
shots.zh: 跟拍车上的海报构图：Clawd（劳伦斯）骑骆驼混在冲锋的骑兵里奔来，弯刀先放低，卡拍举起、刀尖一闪；颠簸晃动，缓慢推近。

shots.en: Low angle pushing up to the raised blade, then a whip pan right, out of the frame and into the next film.
shots.zh: 低角度推向高举的弯刀，然后向右甩镜头出画，接下一部。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Lawrence: white robes, headcloth and gold agal, a raised scimitar, riding a camel. It opens on the most famous match cut in cinema, West Side Story's match flame becoming the rising sun. The charge plays at a constant 1.5×, the blade goes up on a beat with a glint, and a whip pan hands over to Tom Jones.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮劳伦斯：白袍、白头巾、金色头箍，骑骆驼举弯刀。开场就是影史最有名的匹配剪辑：上一部的火柴火苗变成沙漠日出。整段冲锋恒定 1.5 倍速，弯刀卡拍举起、刀尖一闪，最后甩镜头出画，接《汤姆·琼斯》。

films.title: Tom Jones
blend_zh: 罗兰森/吉尔雷式手工上色
films.desc_en: A Georgian satirical print: Hogarth's swelling burin lines and directional hatching under bright Rowlandson-style hand colour brushed slightly off the line, plus a speech balloon. The film itself imitates Hogarth's 18th-century England.
films.desc_zh: 乔治王时代的讽刺版画：霍加斯式粗细变化的刻线和有方向的排线，上面刷罗兰森式鲜艳的手工淡彩，稍稍出线，再加一个对白气泡。电影本身就在模仿霍加斯笔下的 18 世纪英国。
films.prompt_en: Georgian satirical print: a copperplate engraving, hand-coloured. Brown-black line only: swelling burin outlines about 1/400 of frame width, heavier on the shadow side; hatching follows each form and covers every surface (spacing about 1/250 of frame width), cross-hatched in the darks, ruled on flat areas. Colour covers nearly the whole picture, clear but strong: washes spilling a few pixels off the line in claret #B3262E, brass #D8A93A, flesh #F0C4A4, slate blue #6D8AA6, warm ochre and umber on large surfaces. Sepia laid paper, foxing, plate mark, engraved border. Stage it like William Hogarth: big-nosed caricatures, bystanders or comic props and animals around the subject; one slanted handwritten speech balloon in the user's language. Camera: hold the full plate 2 s, whip in, glide to another detail, close-up. Avoid: even mechanical hatching, blank paper, colour exactly inside lines, muddy colour.
films.prompt_zh: 乔治王时代讽刺版画：先刻铜版，印完再手工上色。墨只有棕黑色的线：雕刀轮廓约画面宽的 1/400，起伏鼓胀，背光一侧更粗；排线顺形体走、铺满每个面（线距约画面宽的 1/250），只在暗部交叉，平面用直尺排线。颜色几乎铺满整幅，清透但饱满：水色溢出墨线几像素，用酒红 #B3262E、黄铜 #D8A93A、肉色 #F0C4A4、石板蓝 #6D8AA6，大面用暖赭和棕褐。浅棕褐帘纹纸，淡霉点，版框印痕，刻线边框。按 William Hogarth 的方式布置：大鼻子的漫画人物，主体身边是旁观者或搞笑的道具、动物；一个手写斜体对话气泡，用用户的语言。镜头：全幅停两秒，急推，横滑到另一处细节，再给近景。避免：机械均匀的排线、大片空白纸、颜色严丝合缝填在线里、颜色发脏。

shots.en: Whip in from the left onto the two-shot across the laden table, Clawd (Tom) tearing into a drumstick; the camera glides across the table onto Mrs Waters as her speech balloon appears ('Another Leg, Mr Jones?') and she winks.
shots.zh: 从左边甩进隔着满桌菜的双人镜头，Clawd（汤姆）大口啃鸡腿；镜头横滑过桌面落到沃特斯夫人，她冒出对白气泡（Another Leg, Mr Jones?）并眨了一下眼。

shots.en: Close on Clawd: heart eyes pop, a swoon and a lovesick nibble, then it doffs the tricorn and claps it over the lens to black; slow push in.
shots.zh: Clawd 近景：眼睛变成心形，陶醉地一晃，又啃一小口，然后摘下三角帽扣向镜头，画面变黑；缓慢推近。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Tom Jones: a gold-trimmed tricorn, a lipstick kiss on its cheek, a drumstick in hand. One glide replaces shot/reverse, carrying the two-shot across the feast onto Mrs Waters' wink and balloon. Then the close: heart eyes, a swoon, and the hat comes at the lens, so the next film opens from black.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮汤姆·琼斯：金边三角帽、脸上一个口红唇印、手拿鸡腿。不用正反打，用一次横滑：从隔桌的双人镜头滑到沃特斯夫人眨眼、冒出对白气泡。再切近景：心形眼、陶醉一晃，摘下三角帽扣向镜头，画面全黑，下一部从黑里开场。
refs: William Hogarth, A Rake's Progress / Marriage A-la-Mode

films.title: My Fair Lady
blend_zh: Cecil Beaton 阿斯科特服装
films.desc_en: Fast, dry-edged ink line with pink and magenta watercolour washes, splatter and edges fading to white paper. The original 1964 poster was Bob Peak's ink and pink; the scene is Cecil Beaton's black-and-white Ascot.
films.desc_zh: 快速、带飞白的墨线，配粉色和品红水彩晕染、甩点，四周化进白纸。1964 年原海报就是 Bob Peak 的墨线加粉彩；场景是 Cecil Beaton 设计的黑白阿斯科特。
films.prompt_en: 1960s fashion illustration after Bob Peak. Fast ink line, thicker in turns, dry-brush tail, a flick off; 1/600–1/250 of frame width, thinning on tight curves. Solid black for dark clothing, hats and stripes; faces bare paper #FBF7F1. Loose, soft-edged watercolour pools, darker at drying edges: pink #EE84B2 as the main field, magenta #CE3076 for hot spots, rose #F4B2CC, a touch of plum #80285C; warm grey for secondary figures and shading; directional splatter. Settings are a few lines in these washes, not literal colour. The frieze is essential: slender profile figures 9–10 heads tall repeated across the frame (the hero plus grey-wash figures or echoes), black-and-white pattern over pink; washes cover 60–80% of the frame. Camera: slow drift along the figures; graphic-mask transitions. Avoid: even-width outlines, flat digital fills, polygon-edged washes, a lone figure on an empty page.
films.prompt_zh: 仿 Bob Peak 的 60 年代时装插画。墨线很快：转弯处变粗、直线处变细，后段飞白，收笔一甩；粗细在画面宽的 1/600 到 1/250 之间，小弯处变细。深色衣服、帽子和条纹用实心墨块；脸留白纸 #FBF7F1。水彩是松散柔边的色池，干后边缘积色更深：粉 #EE84B2 做主色，品红 #CE3076 做热点，加玫瑰粉 #F4B2CC 和一点梅紫 #80285C；次要人物和阴影用暖灰；带方向的甩点。场景只用几根线和这几种水彩带过。横排人物是核心：修长侧身，九到十个头高，横向重复（主角加暖灰人物或重影），黑白图案压在粉色上；水彩盖住画面六到八成。镜头：沿人物慢横移；转场借图形遮罩。避免：轮廓粗细一样、平涂数码色、多边形硬边色块、空白页上孤零零一个人。

shots.en: Out of black, the Ascot hat brim lifts to reveal Clawd (Eliza) close; it turns its eyes to the lens and dips a small curtsey as the frame settles back slightly.
shots.zh: 从黑里，阿斯科特大帽的帽檐抬起，露出 Clawd（伊莉莎）的近景；它把目光转向镜头，微微屈膝行礼，画面轻轻往后收。

shots.en: Wide on the Ascot tableau: Clawd in front of two rows of stiff aristocrats in Beaton black and white; slow lateral glide as it lifts its chin.
shots.zh: 阿斯科特全景：Clawd 站在两排穿 Beaton 黑白服装、僵立的贵族前面；缓慢横移，它抬起下巴。

shots.en: Pan along the frozen crowd as every pair of binoculars goes up, then the frame closes into two binocular circles.
shots.zh: 沿僵立的人群横摇，所有人同时举起望远镜，最后画面收进两个望远镜圆圈。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Eliza: an enormous white hat with striped ribbon, roses and ostrich plumes, a lace collar and hem. The film opens from Tom Jones' black under its own hat brim and closes inside the crowd's binoculars, so The Sound of Music can open within the same two circles. Three unhurried cuts.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮伊莉莎：巨大的白帽（条纹缎带、玫瑰、白鸵鸟羽），领口和裙边一圈蕾丝。开场从上一部的黑画面里掀起帽檐，结尾收进人群望远镜的两个圆圈，下一部《音乐之声》就在这两个圆里开场。三个镜头，节奏不急。

films.title: The Sound of Music
films.style_zh: 绘本感 3D 阿尔卑斯航拍
films.desc_en: Storybook 3D over procedural Alps: saturated emerald, cobalt and snow white, sculpted ridges, cotton-ball cumulus and gusts running through the grass. It restages the helicopter opening that ends on Maria spinning on the hilltop.
films.desc_zh: 绘本感的 3D 程序阿尔卑斯：饱和的翠绿、钴蓝、雪白，雕塑感的山脊，棉花团积云，风吹过草地的草浪。重演开场的直升机航拍，最后落到山顶转圈的玛丽亚。
films.prompt_en: Storybook 3D landscape in saturated 1960s widescreen colour: smooth sculpted forms, not low-poly or photoreal. Default light: bright sun high, a little behind the camera: emerald grass #3FA33A, cobalt sky #2F6FD0, clean white snow and clouds. Rounded ridges, snow lines following slope, grey-ochre rock bands, cloud shadows. Haze only on the farthest ridges, about 25% lilac. Cumulus are lit white cotton puffs. Knee-high grass and wildflowers fill the foreground, bending in gusts. A lower sun lengthens shadows and warms only cloud edges; other settings keep these colours. Camera: one continuous move: 0–2 s high flight, 2–4 s descent, then a low orbit through the grass around the subject (about 20° per second, subject about 1/4 of frame height). References: cinematographer Ted McCord (*The Sound of Music*, 1965); Miyazaki's meadows. Avoid: violet wash, needle peaks, grey photoreal rock, static grass.
films.prompt_zh: 绘本感的 3D 风景，60 年代宽银幕的饱和色，形体圆润光滑有雕塑感，不写实也不做低多边形。默认光：太阳高挂、略在镜头身后，大地满色：翠绿草地 #3FA33A、钴蓝天空 #2F6FD0、干净的白雪白云。风化山脊圆润，雪线顺坡，岩层暖灰赭，有云影。空气透视只加在最远的山脊，约两成半淡紫。积云是受光的白色棉花团。前景是齐膝密草和野花，随阵风弯伏。太阳低时只拉长影子、让云边变暖；其他场景也用这些颜色。一个连续镜头：前两秒高空飞越，再两秒降到草坡，之后贴草低机位环绕主体（每秒约 20°，主体约占画面高四分之一）。对标摄影师 Ted McCord（《音乐之声》，1965）和宫崎骏的草地。避免：泛紫、针尖山峰、写实灰岩、不动的草。

shots.en: Inside the two binocular circles carried over from My Fair Lady, which open to full frame: a high aerial gliding over snow peaks through cotton-ball clouds.
shots.zh: 画面从上一部的两个望远镜圆圈里打开到全屏：高空航拍，穿过棉花团积云掠过雪峰。

shots.en: Descent onto the hilltop meadow: Clawd small at frame centre, already turning with carpet bag and guitar case flung out, forest and field patchwork beyond; the camera drops toward it.
shots.zh: 下降逼近山顶草坡：Clawd 小小地在画面正中，已经甩着毯包和琴盒转起来，远处是森林和田地拼块；镜头朝它降下去。

shots.en: Low in the grass, the camera orbits as Clawd twirls a full turn, bag and case swinging, snow peaks and clouds behind, then throws its arms up.
shots.zh: 贴着草的低机位，镜头环绕转了一整圈的 Clawd，毯包和琴盒甩开，身后是雪峰和积云；最后它双臂高举。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Maria: an edelweiss and a small headscarf knot, with the poster's striped carpet bag in one hand and a guitar case in the other. The spin is one continuous curve across all three shots, so every cut lands mid-turn, and the arms go up on the last beat.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮玛丽亚：头顶一朵雪绒花和一个小头巾结，照海报一手拎条纹毯包、一手拎吉他琴盒。转圈是一条贯穿三个镜头的连续曲线，每一刀都切在转到一半的时候；最后一拍双臂高举。

films.title: A Man for All Seasons
films.style_zh: 霍尔拜因都铎肖像油画
blend_zh: 霍尔拜因《托马斯·莫尔爵士像》（1527）
films.desc_en: An Old Master oil portrait: smooth glazed modelling, fur painted hair by hair, velvet highlights, a gold chain link by link, varnish and craquelure. Holbein painted the real Thomas More in 1527, and this is his composition.
films.desc_zh: 古典大师油画肖像：平滑罩染塑形、一根根画出的毛领、天鹅绒高光、逐环刻画的金链，再加旧光油和龟裂纹。霍尔拜因 1527 年亲手画过托马斯·莫尔，这里用的就是他的构图。
films.prompt_en: Oil portrait after Hans Holbein the Younger. Paint in layers: a toned underlayer, directional strokes following light and shadow, soft glazes, fine detail last; smooth finish, brushwork faint in background and fabric. Render each material: fur hair by hair, velvet folds with sharp light ridges, metal with two highlights per piece, wool and leather with soft nap. Any subject becomes a formal half-length sitter in its own clothes; its setting shows through a window or in an object it holds. Palette: deep green curtain #1F4A26, black #141113, velvet red #6E0C15, gold #B0801E, fur brown #3E2818; warm, fully modelled skin. Soft light from upper left. Signature shot: the portrait against the curtain; then material close-ups, a slow pull back into a dark room lit by warm pools. Warm varnish, light craquelure. Avoid: flat fills, hard digital edges, even light, unmodelled faces.
films.prompt_zh: 仿小汉斯·霍尔拜因的北方文艺复兴油画肖像。一层层画：带色底、顺明暗的笔触、柔和罩染、最后细笔；成品光滑，背景和布料隐约见笔触。每种材质各有画法：毛皮一根根画，天鹅绒褶子亮脊锐利，金属每件两个高光点，呢料和皮革画出柔和绒面。任何主体都画成穿自己衣服的正式半身像；它的场景从窗口露出，或由手里一件东西交代。色板：深绿帘幕 #1F4A26，黑 #141113、天鹅绒红 #6E0C15、金 #B0801E、毛皮棕 #3E2818；皮肤暖色、体积完整。柔光从左上来。招牌镜头：衬着绿帘的半身像；其次是材质特写，再慢慢拉远到暖色光池照亮的暗房间。收尾叠暖色光油和轻龟裂。避免：平涂、数码硬边、均匀亮光、没有体积的脸。

shots.en: Extreme close on the face and the SS collar with its Tudor rose pendant: Clawd (More) looks aside, turns its eyes to the lens and blinks; slow push in.
shots.zh: 脸和 SS 金链、都铎玫瑰吊坠的大特写：Clawd（莫尔）先看向一侧，再把目光转向镜头，眨一下眼；缓慢推近。

shots.en: The Holbein portrait composition (Tudor cap, fur collar, red velvet sleeves, green damask, letter in hand): a grave nod, eyes drop to the letter, then a slow pull-back reveals the candlelit Tudor room; the candle gutters and the frame goes dark.
shots.zh: 霍尔拜因肖像构图（都铎扁帽、毛领、红天鹅绒袖子、绿色锦缎帘幕、手里的信）：庄重地点一下头，目光落到信上，然后缓慢拉远，露出烛光下的都铎房间；烛火将熄，画面暗下去。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Thomas More: a Tudor cap, black gown with fur collar, red velvet sleeves, the SS chain and a sealed letter. After the spinning meadow, stillness: one cut from close-up to portrait, then a single long pull-back, and the guttering candle carries the dark into the next film's night.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮托马斯·莫尔：都铎扁帽、黑袍毛领、红天鹅绒袖子、SS 金链，手拿封了红蜡的信。接在转圈的草坡之后，这里是静：从大特写切到肖像只有一刀，之后一路拉远；蜡烛将熄，暗下来的画面接上下一部的夜。
refs: Hans Holbein the Younger, Sir Thomas More (1527)

films.title: In the Heat of the Night
films.desc_en: A three-ink Risograph print in deep blue, poster orange-red and fluorescent pink, with halftone, grain and misregistration; light is printed as less ink. It echoes the 1967 poster's orange heat field and black silhouettes.
films.desc_zh: 三色 Risograph 印刷：深蓝、海报橙红、荧光粉，带网点、颗粒和套色错位；光是用「少上墨」印出来的。呼应 1967 年海报的橙红热浪底和黑色剪影。
films.prompt_en: Three-ink Risograph: orange-red #EC5032 as the dominant field (about 60%, with drip streaks), deep blue #162C76 for silhouettes and shadows, fluorescent pink #FF48B0 only for rims and halos, on warm paper #F7F2E7. Each ink is halftoned at its own angle, dots 1/300 of frame width, plates misregistered 2–4 px; grain, pinholes, slight boil. Knock orange out under blue silhouettes so they print pure blue; only the darkest accents overprint to near-black. Light is the absence of ink: beams, lamps and lit ground show bare paper, ringed in pink. Figures: blue silhouettes, pink rims; skin is 30–60% orange with a blue shadow step. At cooler times keep the red field; blue rises only into the top of the sky. Camera: handheld behind someone carrying a light, a reverse close-up, a push. Avoid: blue-dominated frames, smooth gradients, a fourth ink, clean registration.
films.prompt_zh: 三色专色 Risograph 印刷：橙红 #EC5032 是主场（约占画面六成，带竖向流淌痕），深蓝 #162C76 给剪影和阴影，荧光粉 #FF48B0 只给轮廓光和光晕，印在暖白纸 #F7F2E7 上。每色是各自网角的半调，点径约画面宽的 1/300，版间错位二到四像素；有墨粒、针孔，逐帧轻微抖动。蓝剪影底下挖掉橙色，印成纯蓝；只有最暗处两色叠成近黑。光就是没有墨：光束、灯和被照亮的地面露出纸白，外圈一道粉。人物是带粉色边缘光的蓝剪影，肤色用三到六成橙色网点加一级蓝暗部。时间偏冷时仍保留红场，只让蓝色升到天空顶部。镜头：手持跟在提着光源的人身后，一个反打近景，一次缓推。避免：蓝色占满画面、平滑渐变、第四种墨、套印太准。

shots.en: Handheld flashlight POV out of the dark: a deputy's beam sweeps the depot platform and finds Clawd (Tibbs) by its suitcase; it looks up, eyes wide, and the other beams snap on.
shots.zh: 黑暗中的手持手电主观镜头：副警长的光束扫过车站站台，找到手提箱旁的 Clawd（蒂布斯）；它抬头睁大眼，其他几束手电随即亮起。

shots.en: Reverse close on Chief Gillespie: peaked cap, aviator shades, chewing gum, then stopping; slow push in.
shots.zh: 反打警长吉莱斯皮近景：大檐帽、飞行员墨镜，嚼着口香糖，然后停住；缓慢推近。

shots.en: The stand-off, medium wide: Clawd between the deputies and the chief in crossing flashlight beams, the blue cruiser and the Sparta water tower behind; it straightens up and squares its shoulders as the camera pushes in.
shots.zh: 对峙中全景：Clawd 站在副警长和警长之间，几束手电光交叉打在它身上，身后是蓝色警车和斯巴达镇水塔；它挺直身子、端平肩膀，镜头推近。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Virgil Tibbs: white collar points, a narrow dark tie, shirt cuffs, a suitcase at its side. The night carries over from the previous film's snuffed candle. Three cuts build the confrontation: the flashlight finds it, Gillespie stops chewing, and Clawd draws itself up for "They call me MISTER Tibbs!"
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮维吉尔·蒂布斯：白衬衫领尖、深色窄领带、袖口，脚边一只手提箱。上一部熄灭的烛光把夜带进来。三个镜头堆出对峙：手电找到它、警长停下嚼口香糖、它挺直腰板，像在说「They call me MISTER Tibbs!」

films.title: Oliver!
films.desc_en: A Victorian toy theatre: hand-coloured lithographed card figures with a white scissor margin, layered flats on wire slides, a gilt proscenium and flickering candle footlights throwing shadows up the scenery. Oliver! is a musical, staged here on the Victorian home stage.
films.desc_zh: 维多利亚玩具纸剧场：手工上色的石印卡纸人物留着剪刀白边，景片分层插在滑杆上，镀金台口下的烛光脚灯把影子投上景片。《雾都孤儿》是歌舞片，正好搬上维多利亚家庭小舞台。
films.prompt_en: Victorian toy paper theatre (Pollock's), all printed card: black lithographic outlines about 1/400 of frame width, sparse crayon hatching on one side of each piece; muted antique hand colouring: deep red #C8262C and dull gold #E0AB36 on proscenium and curtains (never bright yellow), blue #2F5A9A for costumes; scenery, sky, water and skin in greyed browns, greys and cream card #F4ECD6. Every cut-out keeps a white scissor margin (1/200 of frame width). Flats are parallel 2.5D layers in parallax, flat within each plane. Candle footlights throw each cut-out's shadow onto the scenery behind, about 1.5× enlarged, soft, flickering. Gilt proscenium, red drapes and painted audience boxes frame a stage opening 80–90% of frame width. Camera: slow push, lateral tracking, shaky close-ups; a final pull-back shows the dark room. Avoid: bright vector colour, true 3D depth, soft studio light, figures without margins.
films.prompt_zh: 维多利亚玩具纸剧场（Pollock's 式）。一切都是印出来的卡纸：黑色石印轮廓约画面宽的 1/400，每张剪纸一侧有稀疏蜡笔排线；手工上色是沉稳旧色：深红 #C8262C 和暗金 #E0AB36 用在台口和帷幔（金色不能是亮黄），蓝 #2F5A9A 给服装；布景、天空、水和肤色用发灰的棕、灰和奶油卡纸 #F4ECD6。每个人物和景片留一圈剪刀白边（约画面宽的 1/200）。景片是平行的 2.5D 层，层间视差，层内无透视。烛光脚灯把剪纸影子放大约一倍半投到后面景片上，柔边，随烛火闪动。镀金台口、红帷幔和画出来的包厢观众框住舞台，台口宽占画面八到九成。镜头：慢推、横移，近景微震；结尾拉远露出暗房间。避免：鲜艳矢量色、真 3D 纵深、柔和摄影光、没有剪边的人物。

shots.en: Wide: the toy theatre on a mahogany table in a dark parlour, the 'Theatre Royal' proscenium, a sheet of cut-out characters and the player's hand at the side; slow push in.
shots.zh: 全景：暗房间里红木桌上的玩具剧场，「Theatre Royal」台口，桌上一张人物剪纸，旁边伸进来一只操偶的手；缓慢推近。

shots.en: Tracking shot across the stage, the workhouse hall: Clawd (Oliver) steps out of the line of boys and lifts its empty bowl ('Please, sir…') as Mr Bumble's brow gathers by the steaming copper; the camera tracks right with it.
shots.zh: 沿舞台横移，济贫院饭堂：Clawd（奥利弗）从一排孩子里走出来，举起空碗（Please, sir…），冒着热气的粥锅旁，班布尔的眉头皱起来；镜头随它向右跟。

shots.en: Close on Clawd and Mr Bumble: Bumble roars, Clawd cowers with a shiver but keeps the bowl up; a small camera shake on the roar.
shots.zh: Clawd 和班布尔的近景：班布尔一声大吼，Clawd 缩了一下、发抖，碗还是举着；吼声那一下镜头轻震。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Oliver: a cut-out on its own tin slide, holding out an empty bowl. Three clearly different sizes, wide to stage to close, give the request its build: step forward, bowl up on the beat, Bumble's roar, and Clawd still holding the bowl up.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮奥利弗：插在自己滑杆上的纸偶，手里举着空碗。全景、舞台、近景三种景别拉开层次：上前一步，卡拍举起空碗，班布尔一吼，它缩了一下，碗还是举着。

films.title: Midnight Cowboy
films.style_zh: 沃霍尔照片丝网 · Double Elvis
films.desc_en: Warhol's photo-silkscreen: a black halftone photo printed unevenly over loose flat colour blocks on silver, the image repeated two and three times. The film has a Factory-style party in it, and his Elvis is a cowboy.
films.desc_zh: 沃霍尔的照片丝网：黑色网点照片层印得不匀，错位地压在松散的平涂色块上，底是银色，画面重复两次、三次。片里就有沃霍尔工厂式的派对，而他画的猫王正是牛仔。
films.prompt_en: Andy Warhol photo-silkscreen. Two plates: a high-contrast black halftone photograph at 45°, dots about 1/200 of frame width, few mid-tones; and hand-painted flat colour blocks underneath, offset about 1/100 of frame width with wobbly edges: taxi yellow #F3BE14, skin pink #F2A197, cream #EFE6CF, red #E2462B, on brushed silver paint #BABCC0 with a soft sheen. The one hero subject takes the strongest block colour. Uneven squeegee pressure: dots flood into blotches in places, drag into dry horizontal streaks and pinholes elsewhere, over faint canvas weave. Repetition is the composition: the same figure or object, full-length, printed side by side two then three times, slightly overlapping, on empty silver. Settings appear only as drained-to-silver prints in the repeat. Camera: handheld shake, a push in, flat frontal tableaux. Reference: Andy Warhol, *Double Elvis* (1963). Avoid: clean even halftone, perfect registration, uniform crispness.
films.prompt_zh: 安迪·沃霍尔式照片丝网印。两块版：一块是 45° 的高反差黑色半调照片，网点约画面宽的 1/200，几乎没有中间调；下面是手刷平涂色块，相对照片错开约画面宽的 1/100，边缘歪扭：出租车黄 #F3BE14、肤粉 #F2A197、奶油 #EFE6CF、红 #E2462B，底是带柔和光泽的刷涂银漆 #BABCC0。唯一的主角用最强的那块颜色。刮板压力不匀：有的地方网点糊成墨团，有的地方拖成横向干笔条纹和针孔，底下隐约有画布纹。重复就是构图：同一个人物或物体全身，在空银底上并排印两次、再印三次，略有重叠。场景只以褪成银色的印样出现在重复里。镜头：手持晃动、推近、正面平面定格。对标沃霍尔《Double Elvis》（1963）。避免：干净均匀的网点、套色完全对齐、处处一样清晰。

shots.en: Sixth Avenue crosswalk: a yellow cab brakes in, Clawd (Joe Buck) jumps back and stares as Ratso slaps the hood; handheld shake, slow push.
shots.zh: 第六大道的人行横道：黄色出租车急刹冲进来，Clawd（乔·巴克）往后一跳、瞪着眼，拉索拍了一下车头；手持晃动，缓慢推近。

shots.en: Closer on Ratso yelling into the cab, cigarette on his lip, finger pointing ("I'm walkin' here!"); push in.
shots.zh: 拉索的近景：叼着烟冲出租车大吼、手指着司机（I'm walkin' here!）；推近。

shots.en: The street drains to silver and prints itself into Warhol's Double: two overlapping Clawds in Stetsons with revolvers, then three; flat frontal frame.
shots.zh: 街景褪成银色，印成沃霍尔的 Double：两个戴斯泰森帽、手持左轮的 Clawd 叠在一起，再变成三个；正面平视的定格画面。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Joe Buck: black Stetson, red neckerchief and suede fringe on its arms. First the film's "I'm walkin' here!": cab, jump back, slap, yell. Then the image turns into a Warhol print, with Clawd in Elvis's gunslinger stance, printed twice, then three times.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮乔·巴克：黑色斯泰森帽、红色领巾、手臂上的麂皮流苏。先演电影里那句「I'm walkin' here!」：出租车急刹、它往后一跳、拉索拍车头大吼。然后画面变成沃霍尔丝网，Clawd 摆出猫王的枪手站姿，先印两次，再印三次。
refs: Andy Warhol, Silver Car Crash (Double Disaster) (1963)

films.title: Patton
films.style_zh: 二战战争债券石印海报
blend_zh: 1942–45 美军征兵与战争债券海报
films.desc_en: Flat-colour stone lithograph in the manner of 1940s US war-bond posters: posterised folds, a dark key line, halftone shadows, yellowed stock. It fits Patton's opening speech, where a tiny general stands before a stage-high flag.
films.desc_zh: 仿 1940 年代美军战争债券海报的石印画法：分级平涂的褶皱、深色轮廓、网点阴影、泛黄的纸。对应《巴顿将军》开场：小小的将军站在一面占满舞台的巨幅国旗前训话。
films.prompt_en: 1940s US war-bond lithograph poster. Flat inks: red #C2342C, navy #213261, olive #5F5C31, khaki #B7975E, on fibrous, foxed cream #E6D5B3 paper. Three values per form (bare paper, flat ink, ink plus halftone), posterised in hard steps. Brown-black key line about 1/500 of frame width, printed last; shadows as coarse 45° halftone bands (dots about 1/150 of frame width) with crayon grain; colour plates offset about 1/600 of frame width. Default: a symmetrical frontal stage, a small subject before a huge graphic shape filling most of the frame (flag, emblem, sunburst), lights as hard pale shapes or bare paper; outdoors too, light falling as a hard pale pool. Lettering optional, in the user's language. Camera: slow push-ins, one crisp pull-back. Reference: US war-bond posters, 1942–45. Avoid: airbrushed gradients, perfect registration, halftone so fine it reads grey.
films.prompt_zh: 1940 年代美国战争债券石印海报。平涂油墨：红 #C2342C、海军蓝 #213261、橄榄绿 #5F5C31、卡其 #B7975E，印在米白 #E6D5B3 的纸上，有纤维、霉点和磨边。每个形体三档：留纸、平涂、油墨加网点，压成硬边色阶。棕黑轮廓线约画面宽的 1/500，最后压上；阴影是粗的 45° 网点带（点径约画面宽的 1/150），带蜡笔颗粒；色版错开约画面宽的 1/600。默认像舞台：对称正面，小主体站在占满大半画面的巨大图形前（旗帜、徽章、放射光芒），灯光是硬边浅色块或留纸；户外也一样，光落成地上的硬边浅斑。文字可有可无，用用户的语言。镜头慢推，配一次干脆的拉出。对标 1942–45 年美国战争债券海报。避免：喷枪渐变、套色完全对齐、网点细到像一片灰。

shots.en: Red and cream stripes fill the frame (a graphic match from the previous film's Warhol grid), then one pull-back finds Clawd walking up from below frame to its mark before the flag.
shots.zh: 红白条纹铺满画面（接上一部沃霍尔网格的图形匹配），随即一个拉镜头，Clawd 从画面下方走上来，站到巨幅国旗前。

shots.en: Medium close-up, a slow push with a slight shake: Clawd snaps up the salute under the four-star helmet, holds it, drops it, and the riding crop cracks into its palm with a hard nod.
shots.zh: 中近景，镜头带轻微抖动慢推：Clawd 在四星钢盔下啪地敬礼，停住，放下，马鞭拍进手心，用力一点头。

shots.en: Wide: the camera pulls out past the flag to the whole empty theatre, red curtains, gilt proscenium and footlights, Clawd tiny at centre stage.
shots.zh: 全景：镜头拉出，越过国旗看到整个空剧场：红幕、镀金台口、脚灯，Clawd 在舞台中央缩成一个小点。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Patton: four-star helmet, ribbon bars and medals, ivory-gripped revolver, riding crop. It walks to its mark under the stripes; on the cut to the close-up the salute snaps up, holds, drops, and the crop cracks into its palm with a nod, as if the speech begins. Two hard cuts; the final pull-back shrinks it before the flag.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮巴顿：四星钢盔、勋表和奖章、象牙柄左轮、马鞭。它在条纹下走到位，切进近景时啪地敬礼，停住，放下，马鞭拍进手心、一点头，像训话开始。两次硬切，最后的拉镜头让它在巨旗前缩成一个小点。

films.title: The French Connection
films.style_zh: 高架铁下追车 · 16mm 颗粒 3D
blend_zh: 暗部偏青的冷灰印片调色
films.desc_en: A full 3D Brooklyn avenue under the elevated railway, graded like grainy 16mm: cold grey, cyan shadows, high contrast, gate weave. The film is remembered for its car chase under the el, and only a real 3D world gives that speed.
films.desc_zh: 整条布鲁克林高架铁下的大街用 3D 建出来，再调成粗颗粒 16mm：冷灰、暗部偏青、高反差、片门抖动。这部片最有名的就是高架铁下的追车，3D 才拍得出那种速度。
films.prompt_en: Gritty early-1970s documentary look in a detailed 3D world, finished as pushed 16mm. Grade: low saturation, high contrast; neutral-cold greys #7A7C7A, cyan shadows #1E2A2C, warm-brown mid-tones #6E4A34 in brick, wood, vehicles (at least a quarter of the frame), never an overall blue; the one hero (e.g. #D97757) stays saturated. Default overcast, sky near-white, at any time of day; sun through any overhead grid (track, bridge, pier) falls in hard stripes. Grain clumps about 1/700 of frame width, ±8% brightness; gate weave, flicker, dust, occasional faint ghosts of bright lights. Dense clutter fitting the place. Handheld cameras ride the action: a low 18–25 mm lens rushing forward as repeated objects strobe past, a rig looking back at the subject, a corner wide. References: William Friedkin, *The French Connection* (1971); cinematographer Owen Roizman. Avoid: clean CG shine, blue tint, empty places, mushy grain.
films.prompt_zh: 70 年代初粗粝的纪实感，放在细致的 3D 世界里，按增感冲洗的 16mm 收尾。调色：低饱和、高反差；中性冷灰 #7A7C7A、带青的暗部 #1E2A2C，砖、木头、车辆保持暖棕 #6E4A34，至少占四分之一画面，绝不整体泛蓝；唯一的主角（比如橙 #D97757）保持饱和。默认阴天，天空亮到近白，任何时段都一样；阳光穿过头顶格栅（轨道、桥、栈桥）落成硬边条纹。颗粒成团，约画面宽的 1/700，亮度 ±8%；片门晃动、闪烁、灰尘，亮处偶有淡重影。杂物多且符合地点。手持机位跟着动作走：18 到 25mm 低机位向前冲，重复物体频闪掠过；回看主体的跟拍机位；墙角广角。对标 William Friedkin《法国贩毒网》（1971）和摄影师 Owen Roizman。避免：干净的 CG 反光、整体泛蓝、空荡的方块场景、颗粒糊成一片。

shots.en: Wide at the corner: a train crosses overhead as the brown Pontiac skids onto the avenue with its rear tyres smoking; the lens slowly widens.
shots.zh: 路口全景：列车从头顶驶过，棕色庞蒂亚克甩尾冲上大街，后轮冒烟；镜头视角慢慢放宽。

shots.en: The famous bumper mount: a low lens rushing up the avenue with motion blur, the el's columns strobing past.
shots.zh: 片中有名的保险杠机位：超低机位带着运动模糊往前冲，高架铁的柱子一根根闪过。

shots.en: Medium shot from outside the car through the rolled-down window: Clawd as Doyle in a pork-pie hat, grim at the wheel, the el and storefronts sliding behind, with vehicle shake.
shots.zh: 中景，从车外透过摇下的车窗看 Clawd 扮的道尔：猪肉派帽、咬牙握着方向盘，身后高架铁和店面滑过，带车载抖动。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Popeye Doyle: pork-pie hat, angry eyes, both hands on the wheel. The chase clock runs well ahead of screen time, so the speed-up reads as more speed. Three hard cuts, corner skid to bumper rush to the driver, with no pause in between.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮“大力水手”道尔：猪肉派帽、怒眼、双手握方向盘。追车的场景时间比屏幕时间跑得快得多，加速看起来就是车更快。三个硬切：路口甩尾 → 保险杠狂冲 → 驾驶员，中间不停。

films.title: The Godfather
blend_zh: 伦勃朗、卡拉瓦乔式罩染
films.desc_en: Oil painting in deep amber and umber where only the top light is warm: thin transparent glazes in the darks, thick impasto on the lit edges. It recreates Gordon Willis's overhead light in the 'I believe in America' study.
films.desc_zh: 深琥珀和赭褐的油画，只有顶光落下的地方是暖的：暗部是透明的薄罩染，受光边缘是厚涂。重现戈登·威利斯在“I believe in America”那间书房里的顶光。
films.prompt_en: Chiaroscuro oil painting after Rembrandt and Caravaggio, one overhead light. About 70% of the frame is readable warm dark, mostly umber #24150B, near-black #070403 only in the deepest corners. Amber #8F5D2A mid-tones about 20%; top planes reach #E2B673. The hero stands in the light pool, lit area at least 1/4 of frame height; brows shade the eyes. One red accent #9C1A1A. Darks thin smooth glazes; lights thick impasto, ridged strokes about 1/100 of frame width; modelling soft, never scratchy. Amber varnish, heavy vignette, canvas grain (±3%). A warm bright opening (window, doorway, horizon) may glow behind; a small lamp in frame is a small glow, not a second key. Camera: slow pull-backs and pushes. Reference: Francis Ford Coppola, *The Godfather* (1972), cinematographer Gordon Willis. Avoid: lifting the darks, flat light, faces popping out, frames too dark to read.
films.prompt_zh: 伦勃朗、卡拉瓦乔式明暗油画，只有一盏顶光。约七成画面是看得出形体的暖暗部，大多是赭褐 #24150B，近黑 #070403 只在最深的角落。琥珀 #8F5D2A 中间调约两成；朝上的面亮到 #E2B673。主角整个站在光池里，受光部分至少占画面高的四分之一；眉骨把眼睛压进阴影。一处饱和的红 #9C1A1A。暗部薄而平滑地罩染，亮部是带亮笔脊的厚涂，笔触约画面宽的 1/100；过渡柔和，不用刮擦线条。琥珀光油，重暗角，细画布纹（±3%）。背景可有一处暖色亮口（窗、门洞、发亮的天边）；画内的小灯只是一小团光，不算第二个主光。镜头慢拉、慢推。对标 Francis Ford Coppola《教父》（1972），摄影师 Gordon Willis。避免：提亮暗部、平光、人脸跳出来、暗到看不清。

shots.en: From Bonasera's grey head in the dark, the camera pulls slowly back to reveal the Don in his wing chair, a cat at his knee.
shots.zh: 从暗处博纳塞拉的灰发开始，镜头缓缓拉出，露出坐在翼背椅里的教父和他膝前的猫。

shots.en: Close on Clawd under the top light, slowly stroking the grey tabby, bow tie and red rose catching the light; a slow push.
shots.zh: 近景：顶光下的 Clawd 缓缓抚摸灰色虎斑猫，领结和红玫瑰吃到光；镜头慢推。

shots.en: Push toward the blinds: the wedding outside, soft and overexposed in the sun, Hagen silhouetted at left.
shots.zh: 推向百叶窗：窗外阳光下的婚礼，虚而过曝，左边是黑根的剪影。

shots.en: The whole study with a slight push: the puppeteer's hand comes down from the top of frame and its strings draw taut over Clawd.
shots.zh: 书房全景，镜头略推：提线木偶的手从画面顶上降下来，提线在 Clawd 身上慢慢绷紧。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Don Corleone: black bow tie, wing collar, red rose, white cuffs, one hand on a cat. All twelve beats run at 1× to keep Willis's patient camera; each stroke of the cat takes about four seconds, with one blink. Hard cuts; the last shot lowers Fujita's puppeteer hand from the poster over it.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮唐·柯里昂：黑领结、翼领、红玫瑰、白袖口，一只手压在猫背上。12 拍全按 1 倍速，保留威利斯那种耐心的镜头；抚猫一下约 4 秒，中间眨一次眼。全部硬切，最后一镜让原海报的提线手降到它头上。
refs: S. Neil Fujita, The Godfather poster logo

films.title: The Sting
films.desc_en: Warm, clean magazine illustration in the Leyendecker–Rockwell line: blocky lit planes, parallel strokes, crisp dark contours. The Sting's own chapter cards imitate Saturday Evening Post covers, so its 1936 betting parlour is drawn the same way.
films.desc_zh: Leyendecker、Rockwell 一路的杂志插画：块面受光、平行笔触、利落的深色轮廓。片中章节卡就仿《星期六晚邮报》封面，1936 年的下注厅也照这个画。
films.prompt_en: 1930s Saturday Evening Post cover illustration. Realist figures, correct proportions, expressive faces, built from blocky planes (lit, shadow, warm bounce from below) filled with blended strokes about 1/150 of frame width, varied in length, following the form, never stripes. Dark contour thicker on the shadow side, 1/800–1/300 of frame width. Warm key from upper left. Palette: plaster #E2C492, oak #764626, slate #28322C, brass #E2B046, ink #341E18; oak and ink darks about a third of the frame; sky plaster cooled with slate, water light slate, skin plaster plus brass. Grainy board (±3%), warm vignette. Default one-point perspective, period detail, haze, secondary figures if the story has any. Each figure is drawn once and moves whole (breathing, sway, sliding along a path). Camera: one long, smooth push in. References: J. C. Leyendecker, Norman Rockwell. Avoid: stiff cut-out figures, even outlines, muddy colour.
films.prompt_zh: 30 年代《星期六晚邮报》封面插画。写实人物，比例准确、表情生动，用块面塑造（受光、背光、下方暖色反光），块面里填顺着形体、长短不一的笔触，宽约画面宽的 1/150，柔和衔接，不成条纹。深色轮廓在背光一侧加粗，画面宽的 1/800 到 1/300。暖色主光从左上来。配色：灰泥 #E2C492、橡木 #764626、石板 #28322C、黄铜 #E2B046、墨 #341E18；橡木和墨色暗部约占三分之一画面；天空灰泥偏石板，水是浅石板，皮肤灰泥加黄铜。轻颗粒画板（±3%）加暖暗角。默认一点透视，时代细节，薄雾，故事有就加次要人物。每个人物只画一遍，整体移动（呼吸、摇摆、沿路径滑行）。镜头：一次长而平滑的推进。对标 J. C. Leyendecker、Norman Rockwell。避免：僵硬剪纸人物、粗细一样的轮廓、发脏的颜色。

shots.en: One continuous push from the whole betting parlour (odds board, betting cages, Gondorff in his window) in to Clawd as Hooker, who lays a finger beside its nose, then tips its hat to the camera.
shots.zh: 一镜到底：从下注厅全景（赔率黑板、下注窗口、窗口里的冈多夫）一路推到扮胡克的 Clawd，它把手指贴到鼻侧打暗号，再冲镜头压一下帽檐。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Johnny Hooker: pale fedora, red bow tie, braces. There is no cut, only one push. As the camera arrives it gives the con men's signal, a finger beside the nose, then tips its hat and blinks at the lens, letting the audience in on the con.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮胡克：浅色礼帽、红领结、背带。整段不切，只有一个推镜头。推到位时它打出骗子们的暗号（手指贴鼻侧），接着压帽檐、冲镜头眨眼，像把观众拉进骗局。

films.title: The Godfather Part II
blend_zh: Lewis Hine 的埃利斯岛照片
films.desc_en: A turn-of-the-century toned silver print with dyes brushed on by hand: sepia, soft lens, silver grain, foxing, a cracked corner, faint red, blue and verdigris. It shows young Vito arriving at Ellis Island in 1901, as in Lewis Hine's photographs.
films.desc_zh: 世纪之交的调色银盐照片，手工刷色：棕褐调、柔焦、银盐颗粒、霉斑、裂角，局部淡淡的红、蓝、铜绿。画的是 1901 年少年维托抵达埃利斯岛，像 Lewis Hine 的照片。
films.prompt_en: A hand-coloured toned silver print from about 1900. Build lit 3D forms, soft key from upper left, then 'print' them: soft focus, light halation, grain heaviest in mid-tones (±5%), full sepia range #281A12, #987048, #EEE0C2; at least a fifth of the frame reaches the dark end, in any light. Figures: real proportions (head 1/7 of body), soft shading. Transparent dyes brushed loosely past edges: the one hero subject strongly (e.g. orange-red #D97757 at 60–80% opacity), a faint touch on one or two props; dyes die in shadow. Light ageing: vignette, silvered edges (grey-blue sheen in border darks), small foxing spots, fine scratches, at most one cracked corner. Frontal, documentary: figures stand still facing the lens. Camera: slow pan across faces. References: Lewis Hine; Augustus Sherman (Ellis Island). Avoid: toy figures, digital fill colour, low-contrast fog, big mould blotches.
films.prompt_zh: 1900 年前后手工上色的棕褐银盐照片。先做受光的立体形体，柔光从左上来，再“印”出来：柔焦带轻微光晕，颗粒在中间调最重（±5%）；棕褐调从 #281A12 经 #987048 到 #EEE0C2 完整铺开，至少五分之一画面落到最深一端，任何光线下都一样。人物比例真实（头约七分之一身高），明暗柔和。透明颜料松松地刷，溢出边缘：唯一的主角最重（比如橙红 #D97757，不透明度六到八成），一两件道具轻点；颜色进暗部就被吞掉。做旧要轻：暗角、边缘银化（靠边暗部泛灰蓝金属光）、几个小霉点、细划痕，最多一个裂角。构图正面、纪实，人物静立面对镜头。镜头缓慢横摇扫过人脸。对标 Lewis Hine、Augustus Sherman 的埃利斯岛照片。避免：积木人物、数码填色、低反差雾灰、大片霉斑。

shots.en: A horizontal sweep across the upturned faces of immigrants on deck, rising and falling with the ship's roll.
shots.zh: 横摇扫过甲板上仰头的移民群像，画面随船身起伏。

shots.en: Clawd's point of view: the Statue of Liberty emerging from the harbour fog, tinted verdigris; a slow push.
shots.zh: Clawd 的主观视角：自由女神从港口的雾里显出来，带一点铜绿色；镜头慢推。

shots.en: Close on Clawd as young Vito in a tweed flat cap, the 'VITO ANDOLINI' tag on its chest; it looks down at the tag and up again, rising on its toes; a slight pull back.
shots.zh: 近景：戴粗花呢鸭舌帽的少年维托（Clawd），胸前挂着“VITO ANDOLINI”名牌；它低头看名牌，又抬头踮脚；镜头略微拉开。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays the boy Vito Andolini: a grey tweed flat cap and a paper name tag round its neck, small among adults. Screen time averages 1.3×, with Liberty at 1×. Hard cuts run faces, statue (point of view), reaction; the last beat is a glance down at its new name, then up at the new country.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮少年维托：灰色粗花呢鸭舌帽，脖子上挂着纸名牌，夹在大人中间显得很小。平均 1.3 倍速，自由女神那一镜是 1 倍。三个硬切：人群 → 雕像（主观）→ 反应；最后的表演点是低头看自己的新名字，再抬头望向新的国家。
refs: Francis Ford Coppola, The Godfather Part II (1974)

films.title: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
blend_en: flat oil planes with dragged strokes
films.desc_en: Quiet American realism after Edward Hopper: big flat planes of pale green, hard parallelograms of low morning sun, figures standing apart. It suits the ward of Cuckoo's Nest, fluorescent order broken by one act of escape.
films.desc_zh: 仿爱德华·霍珀的安静写实：大块平整的淡绿墙面、低角度晨光投下的硬边平行四边形、彼此隔开的人。正合《飞越疯人院》的病房：日光灯下的秩序，被一次出逃打破。
films.prompt_en: Edward Hopper-style American realist painting. Large flat planes of restrained, pale colour: institutional greens #9EB8A0 and #5E7C66, grey-green floor #7E8876, cream #ECE6D2, on visible canvas (±3%), with a few long dragged strokes about 1/80 of frame width, 5–10% off the base. Low side sun throws hard-edged parallelograms of warm light #FCE6AC on walls and ground, crossed by crisp shadows of frames or railings, indoors or out. Sky pale cream-green; skin warmed cream; clothes darkened greens. Figures painted from 3–4 overlapping soft-edged value shapes, no outline, real proportions; several people stand apart. Stillness, then one sudden event under a second: a whip pan, a burst of light. Signature shot: a still one-point interior, light on the floor. References: Edward Hopper, *Office in a Small City* (1953). Avoid: heavy outlines, vector figures, dark saturated walls, fuzzy light patches.
films.prompt_zh: 爱德华·霍珀式美国写实绘画。大块克制、偏浅的平面色：机构绿 #9EB8A0 和 #5E7C66、灰绿地面 #7E8876、奶油 #ECE6D2，看得见画布纹（±3%），每块拖几笔长笔触，宽约画面宽的 1/80，亮或暗百分之五到十。低角度阳光从一侧射来，在墙和地上投下硬边暖色平行四边形 #FCE6AC，压着窗框或栏杆的清晰影子，室内户外都一样。天空浅奶油绿，皮肤是提暖的奶油色，衣服用压暗的绿。人物由三四块边缘柔和的明暗色块叠成，不勾轮廓，比例写实；几个人时分开站。大部分时间静止，然后一件不到一秒的突发：甩镜或一阵强光。招牌镜头：一点透视的静止室内，地上有光块。对标霍珀《Office in a Small City》（1953）。避免：粗轮廓、矢量人物、深而饱和的墙、模糊光斑。

shots.en: One travelling shot in the day room: Clawd heaves a marble hydrotherapy console over its head and hurls it; the camera whip-pans with it to the back window as the glass explodes and dawn pours in, then swings back through the light to Clawd cheering, arms up.
shots.zh: 日间活动室里的一镜到底：Clawd 把大理石水疗台举过头顶扔出去，镜头跟着甩到后窗，玻璃炸开、晨光涌进来，再穿过光甩回 Clawd，它举起双臂欢呼。

films.direction_en: Clawd wears McMurphy's black watch cap and plaid collar but performs the film's ending: the console through the window. Screen time equals scene time: crouch and strain, lift, the throw at 1.0 s, impact at 1.3 s with a flash and shards flying at the lens, then the cheer. Blurred whip pans replace cuts.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 戴着麦克墨菲的黑色针织帽和格子领，演的是片尾那一下：把水疗台砸出窗外。屏幕时间等于场景时间：蹲下用力、举起、1.0 秒扔出、1.3 秒撞窗，闪光加碎玻璃飞向镜头，然后欢呼。用带运动模糊的甩镜代替剪切。
refs: Miloš Forman, One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest (1975)
Edward Hopper, Office in a Small City; Morning Sun

films.title: Rocky
films.style_zh: 费城台阶日出 3D · 35mm 调色
blend_zh: 斯坦尼康跟拍与环绕升镜
films.desc_en: A full 3D Philadelphia at sunrise, from meat locker to museum steps, graded like 1970s 35mm: cold blue sky, low gold sun, long shadows, haze, fine grain. The run up the 72 steps and the rising orbit at the top are what people remember.
films.desc_zh: 清晨的费城整个做成 3D，从肉库到博物馆 72 级台阶，调成 70 年代 35mm：冷蓝天、低低的金色太阳、长影子、薄雾、细颗粒。跑上台阶和顶上的环绕升镜是这部片的记忆点。
films.prompt_en: 1970s 35mm realism in a detailed 3D world, sunrise by default (sunset the same). Sun 5–10° up, warm orange #F0A060, lighting the hero from the side or three-quarter front so the lit body and long ground shadows read; no full backlight. Cool blue sky #7FA3CF, pink cloud undersides #E6B2AE; haze golden toward the sun, blue-violet away. Grade: fine grain (±3%), cool shadows, warm highlights, nothing clipped; flare and ghosts only with the sun in frame. Camera: a low Steadicam following the hero from behind up an ascent, then at the top one continuous orbit that circles, rises and pulls back over 6–8 s, showing the lit face, until the place spreads out below. References: John G. Avildsen, *Rocky* (1976); Steadicam operator Garrett Brown. Avoid: flat noon light, detail-less silhouettes, a static climax, plastic CG shine.
films.prompt_zh: 70 年代 35mm 写实，放在细致的 3D 世界里，默认日出（日落同理）。太阳离地平线五到十度，暖橙 #F0A060，从侧面或前侧方照亮主角，让受光的身体和拉过地面的长影看得清；不要完全逆光。天空冷蓝 #7FA3CF，云底染粉 #E6B2AE；雾朝太阳一侧发金、背光一侧发蓝紫。调色：细颗粒（±3%），暗部偏冷、高光偏暖，不过曝；只有太阳入画时才有光晕和鬼影。镜头：低机位斯坦尼康从背后跟着主角爬上一段坡或台阶，到最高处接一个连续环绕，边转边升边退，六到八秒，转到受光的脸，直到整个地方在下面铺开。对标 John G. Avildsen《洛奇》（1976）、斯坦尼康操作者 Garrett Brown。避免：正午平光、没细节的剪影、高潮时机位不动、塑料感反光。

shots.en: Meat locker, medium shot, fixed camera: Clawd in a grey hood jabs at a hanging side of beef among white tiles and bare bulbs.
shots.zh: 肉库中景，定机位：戴灰色兜帽的 Clawd 对着挂着的牛肉出拳，白瓷砖、裸灯泡。

shots.en: Closer, fixed camera: the punches land and the beef swings.
shots.zh: 更近一些，定机位：拳头打在牛肉上，牛肉晃荡。

shots.en: The Italian Market before dawn, fixed camera: Clawd jogs toward the lens past fire barrels, fruit stands and lit streetlamps.
shots.zh: 黎明前的意大利市场，定机位：Clawd 迎着镜头慢跑，经过油桶火、果蔬摊和还亮着的路灯。

shots.en: A low Steadicam chases Clawd from behind as it runs up the 72 steps toward the museum's columns.
shots.zh: 低机位斯坦尼康从背后追着 Clawd 跑上 72 级台阶，前方是博物馆的立柱。

shots.en: At the top Clawd throws its arms up in a V and hops; the camera circles round it, rising and pulling back until the whole Parkway and the city open up at sunrise.
shots.zh: 到顶，Clawd 双臂举成 V 字一跳；镜头绕着它转、上升、后退，直到整条大道和城市在日出里铺开。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Rocky: a grey sweatshirt hood up and a white towel on one shoulder. The training montage runs at about 1.7× over three quick cuts; from the steps on, the scene plays at 1×. A hard cut into the Steadicam run, then no cut: the run flows straight into the orbit, and the victory hop lands as the camera starts to rise.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮洛奇：灰色卫衣兜帽戴起，肩上搭一条白毛巾。训练蒙太奇三个快切，约 1.7 倍速；上台阶以后回到 1 倍。硬切进斯坦尼康跟跑，之后不再切：跑到顶直接接环绕升镜，举臂一跳正好落在镜头开始升起的时候。
refs: Philadelphia Museum of Art, east façade

films.title: Annie Hall
films.style_en: New Yorker Cartoon, Ink and Wash
films.style_zh: 《纽约客》单格漫画 · 墨线淡彩
films.desc_en: A New Yorker single-panel cartoon: lively nib-pen lines, a few restrained washes, plenty of white paper and a hand-lettered caption beneath. Woody Allen's comedy shares the magazine's voice, and the lobster scene plays as one gag panel.
films.desc_zh: 《纽约客》单格漫画：灵动的钢笔墨线、几块克制的淡彩、大量白纸，画下面一行手写图说。伍迪·艾伦的喜剧和这本杂志是一个调子，龙虾那场戏正好是一格笑话漫画。
films.prompt_en: New Yorker single-panel cartoon, full-bleed, no border. Nib-pen lines about 1/1000 of frame width on straights, swelling to 1/300 in turns, flicking off at the ends; box corners overlap. Pale watercolour washes with pooled edges over most objects, slipping past the lines by at most 1/150 of frame width: grey #9698A0, sea blue #78A0BE, sand #E2CCA0, rust #C45C32, on cold-press paper #FBF8F1 fading to white at the edges. Exaggerated, expressive figures with drawn faces among everyday props. One hand-lettered caption line under the action, in the user's language, about 1/30 of frame height, appearing letter by letter: a deadpan remark. The drawing holds still; living things wobble. Camera: small drifts and pushes; the frame may split into two side-by-side drawings. References: James Thurber, William Steig, Jean-Jacques Sempé. Avoid: saturated colour, uniform vector lines, a small framed panel floating in white.
films.prompt_zh: 《纽约客》单格漫画，满版出血，不画格框。蘸水笔墨线直线处细到约画面宽的 1/1000，转弯处粗到约 1/300，收笔一甩；方盒子几笔分开画，角上交叉出头。淡水彩带积色边，铺在大部分物体上，溢出墨线不超过画面宽的 1/150：灰 #9698A0、海蓝 #78A0BE、沙色 #E2CCA0、铁锈 #C45C32，底是冷压纸 #FBF8F1，四边化成白。人物夸张、有表情、画出五官，周围有日常道具，留白但不空荡。画面下方一行手写说明，用用户的语言，字高约画面高的 1/30，逐字写出：一句冷面幽默。画面不动，活物微微颤动。镜头：轻微漂移和推近；画面可一分为二，左右并排两幅。对标 James Thurber、William Steig、桑贝。避免：浓重饱和的颜色、粗细一样的矢量线、白纸中间漂着一个小格子。

shots.en: Extreme close-up on the gap behind the fridge: a lobster slowly peeks out; a slow drift.
shots.zh: 冰箱后缝的大特写：一只龙虾慢慢探出头；镜头缓慢漂移。

shots.en: The kitchen: Clawd as Annie laughs and snaps flash photos of Alvy clutching a stockpot; a lobster reaches its foot, it hops, lands laughing, and 'TALK TO HIM. YOU SPEAK SHELLFISH.' writes itself out below; a slight pull back with a handheld wobble.
shots.zh: 厨房全景：扮安妮的 Clawd 边笑边给抱着汤锅的艾尔维拍闪光照；龙虾爬到脚边，它一跳，落地笑开，下方一笔笔写出“TALK TO HIM. YOU SPEAK SHELLFISH.”；镜头略微拉开，带一点手持晃动。

shots.en: The Easter dinner split screen: the quiet Halls on the left with Clawd seated among them, the noisy Singers on the right.
shots.zh: 复活节饭桌分屏：左边安静的霍尔家，Clawd 坐在其中；右边吵闹的辛格家。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Annie in Diane Keaton's wide-brimmed hat, loose striped tie and vest, with a 35mm camera. The scene runs at about 1.8× with the jump near 1×: two flash photos, a lobster at its foot, a startled hop, a landing in laughter. Hard cuts; the split-screen dinner is a graphic exit.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮安妮：黛安·基顿那顶宽檐帽、松垮的条纹领带和马甲，手里一台 35mm 相机。约 1.8 倍速，跳起来那一下接近 1 倍：两次闪光拍照，龙虾爬到脚边，吓得一跳，落地笑开。全部硬切，最后用分屏饭桌做一个图形化的出口。

films.title: The Deer Hunter
films.desc_en: Dry, finely hatched egg tempera after Andrew Wyeth: muted straw, umber and grey-green, grass drawn blade by blade, a pale empty sky. Wyeth was a Pennsylvania painter, and the 'one shot' hunt takes place in the Pennsylvania mountains above a steel town.
films.desc_zh: 仿安德鲁·怀斯的蛋彩：干燥细密的交叉短笔，低饱和的草黄、赭褐、灰绿，草叶一根根画出来，天空苍白。怀斯是宾州画家，“一枪”猎鹿就在宾州钢铁小镇上方的山里。
films.prompt_en: Egg tempera on gesso panel after Andrew Wyeth. Dry, matte, very fine: colour built from dense cross-hatched strokes, each about 1/400 of frame width long, hairline thin. Muted palette: pale overcast sky #D9D5C6, straw grass #CDB27A, umber #6A5234, misty grey-green hills #8E938C, rust #8A4E32; water, stone, clothes and skin mixed from these. One accent colour, only on the one hero subject (e.g. a red cap); any light source is a small pale dot, no halo. Ground (dry grass by default, other ground alike): big light and dark patches, fine strokes, dark tufts, then single wind-combed blades; rocks, buildings hatched along their planes. Empty, lonely space; the subject small, off-centre. Soft overcast light; at other times of day stay pale, no warm glow. Camera: slow drift, quiet push; a circular iris may mark a cut. Avoid: wet watercolour blooms, saturated colour, thick shiny strokes.
films.prompt_zh: 安德鲁·怀斯式石膏底板蛋彩画。干、哑光、极细：颜色全靠密密的交叉短笔叠出来，每笔长约画面宽的 1/400，细如发丝。低饱和配色：苍白阴天 #D9D5C6、草黄 #CDB27A、赭褐 #6A5234、灰绿远山 #8E938C、铁锈色 #8A4E32；水、石、衣服和皮肤都从这几色调出。强调色只给唯一的主角（比如一顶红帽）；画里的光源只是一个淡淡的小点，不带光晕。地面（默认枯草，其他地面同理）先铺大块深浅，再叠细笔、暗色草团，最后是被风梳过的单根草叶；岩石和房屋用短笔顺着各面排。空间空旷孤独，主体小而偏离中心。默认阴天软光，其他时段也保持苍白、不要暖光。镜头缓慢漂移、安静推近；圆形遮罩可作剪切点。避免：湿水彩晕染、饱和色、厚重发亮的笔触。

shots.en: Wide on the steel town in the valley mist (blast furnaces, smoking chimneys, an onion-domed church), drifting sideways.
shots.zh: 河谷雾里的钢铁小镇全景：高炉、冒烟的烟囱、洋葱顶教堂；镜头缓慢横移。

shots.en: Through the rifle scope: the buck on the crest inside a black circular mask and crosshair, swaying slightly with the hunter's hands.
shots.zh: 瞄准镜视角：黑色圆形遮罩和十字线里，山脊上的雄鹿；画面随猎人的手微微晃动。

shots.en: Close-up of the buck's head and eye; a slow push.
shots.zh: 雄鹿头部和眼睛的特写；镜头慢推。

shots.en: Clawd as Michael on a granite outcrop lowers the rifle, shuts its eyes, breathes out and looks up at the buck again, as the camera pulls back to the whole ridge.
shots.zh: Clawd 扮麦克站在花岗岩上，放下猎枪，闭眼呼出一口气，再抬头望向雄鹿；镜头拉开到整条山脊。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Michael in a red wool hunting cap with a scoped rifle. Valley, scope, eye, hunter: four hard cuts, never faster than about 1.25×, quiet and steady. The beat is the shot not taken: the rifle comes down, eyes shut, one breath out, and it looks up at the buck again.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮麦克：红色羊毛猎帽、带瞄准镜的猎枪。河谷 → 瞄准镜 → 鹿眼 → 猎人，四个硬切，平均约 1.24 倍速，安静、稳。表演点是那一枪没开：枪放下，闭眼，呼出一口气，再抬头看那头鹿。

films.title: Kramer vs. Kramer
films.desc_en: A kitchen drawn by a child in wax crayon: wobbly lines, colour pressed into the paper grain and over the edges, labels and arrows, a smiling sun. It is Billy's view of making French toast with his father.
films.desc_zh: 孩子用蜡笔画的厨房：歪扭的线、用力涂进纸纹又涂出边界的颜色、标签和箭头、带笑脸的太阳。这是比利眼里他和爸爸做法式吐司的样子。
films.prompt_en: A careful 6–8-year-old's wax-crayon drawing on white paper. Crayon catches the paper grain's peaks; light pressure leaves 40–60% paper showing, heavy pressure fills it; overlaps show through. Outlines in black or dark-brown crayon, waxy, wobbling, about 1/300 of frame width. Fills are back-and-forth scribbles, strokes about 1/40 of frame width long and 1/250 wide, rows overshooting the outlines, each area in its own direction, spacing and angle uneven, never a regular mesh. Primary box: red #E0382C, orange #F28A1E, yellow #F7D23A, green #3AA345, blue #2E6BD8. Child conventions: a ground line, flattened perspective, arrowed labels, a smiling sun, one mirrored letter (in Chinese, a reversed stroke), patterns coloured cell by cell. Text in the user's language, in wobbly crayon strokes, not a typeface. Camera: shaky close-ups, then a calm drift. Avoid: neat adult rendering, random scrawl, uniform stipple or mesh, smooth gradients.
films.prompt_zh: 认真的六到八岁孩子在白纸上画的蜡笔画。蜡笔只蹭到纸纹凸起；轻涂露出四到六成纸白，用力处填满；叠色时下层透出。轮廓用黑色或深棕蜡笔，蜡质、发抖，粗约画面宽的 1/300。填色是来回涂抹，每笔长约画面宽的 1/40、宽约 1/250，一排排涂、冲出轮廓，每块各有方向，间距和角度不均匀，不能排成规整的网。基础色：红 #E0382C、橙 #F28A1E、黄 #F7D23A、绿 #3AA345、蓝 #2E6BD8。儿童画惯例：地面线、压扁的透视、带箭头的标注、笑脸太阳、写反一个字母（中文写反一个偏旁）、图案一格格涂。文字用用户的语言、发抖的蜡笔笔画写，不用字体。镜头：先晃动近景，再平稳扫过全画。避免：大人式的工整画法、没细节的乱涂、均匀点状或网状肌理、平滑渐变。

shots.en: Extreme close-up of the pan the first time: burnt toast, black crayon smoke, eggshells; a shaky handheld slowly pulling back.
shots.zh: 第一次做的平底锅大特写：焦吐司、黑色蜡笔烟、蛋壳；手持抖动，慢慢拉开。

shots.en: Match cut to the same pan at the end of the film, clean now: a golden slice flips up out of it.
shots.zh: 匹配剪辑到片尾的同一口锅，干干净净：一片金黄的吐司从锅里翻起来。

shots.en: Father and son side by side under the title 'ME AND DADDY MAKE FRENCH TOAST': Clawd catches the toast on its spatula, Billy beams and a heart pops up, Clawd hops with pride; the camera drifts up to the crayon skyline in the window.
shots.zh: 标题“ME AND DADDY MAKE FRENCH TOAST”下父子并肩：Clawd 用锅铲接住吐司，比利笑开，冒出一颗红心，Clawd 得意地小跳一下；镜头往上漂到窗外的蜡笔天际线。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Ted Kramer with a blue apron tie and a spatula; Billy stands on a chair whisking. The first attempt and the last are joined by a match cut on the same pan, so the whole relationship fits in one jump. About 1.35× overall; the catch lands on the cut to the wide shot, then a hop and a glance at camera.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮泰德：系着蓝色围裙带，拿锅铲；比利站在椅子上打蛋。第一次和最后一次用同一口锅做匹配剪辑，父子关系在一次跳切里讲完。整体约 1.35 倍速；切进全景时正好接住吐司，接着小跳一下、看一眼镜头。

films.title: Ordinary People
blend_en: Winslow Homer and John Singer Sargent
blend_zh: Winslow Homer 与 John Singer Sargent
films.desc_en: Transparent watercolour in layered glazes: wet-in-wet sky and lake, tide-mark edges, blooms, white paper left for highlights, autumn gold and rust against cool grey-blue. It matches the quiet, sad Lake Forest autumn of the film's opening.
films.desc_zh: 层层叠色的透明水彩：湿画法的天空和湖面、水渍边线、回流花、留白的纸当高光，秋天的金和锈红配上冷灰蓝。对上影片开场那个安静又带点忧伤的 Lake Forest 秋天。
films.prompt_en: Transparent watercolour in layered glazes on cold-press paper. Draw shapes crisply first, then two or three glazes, each smaller and darker, drying to a tide-mark edge; two or three blooms, about 1/10 of frame width, inside large washes, never on figures; light granulation (±4%). Paper is the brightest white; light objects and highlights left as paper. Sky and water wet-in-wet, ripples dry-brush. Roles: autumn gold #ECAA34, scarlet #E46030, rust #B8743C for foliage and accents, against grey-blue mist #C2C6D2 and violet-grey shadows #8A8496; sky pale and cool at any time of day; ground pale green-ochre. Foliage: pale wash, scallop-edged clusters, dark dots, flicked leaves; with few trees, warm colours go to scrub, roofs, clothes. Light from one side. Camera: slow pan, gentle push, leaves drifting past the lens. Reference: Winslow Homer's watercolours. Avoid: opaque gouache, airbrushed blur, vector edges, muddy colour, saturated sunsets.
films.prompt_zh: 透明水彩，在冷压纸上一层层罩色。先把形状画清楚，再罩两三层，每层更小更深，干后边缘积成深一点的水渍线；每帧两三处回流花，约画面宽的 1/10，只在大块湿画里，不落在人物上；颗粒轻沉进纸纹（±4%）。纸是最亮的白，浅色物体和高光留纸。天空和水面湿画，涟漪干笔。分工：秋金 #ECAA34、猩红 #E46030、锈色 #B8743C 给树叶和点缀，对着冷灰蓝的雾 #C2C6D2 和紫灰阴影 #8A8496；天空任何时段都浅而冷；地面浅绿赭。树冠：先铺淡色，叠扇贝边叶团，点深色，甩散叶；树少时暖色给灌木、屋顶、衣服。光从一侧来。镜头缓慢横摇、轻推，落叶从镜头前飘过。对标 Winslow Homer 的水彩。避免：水粉式覆盖、喷枪模糊、矢量硬边、脏色、饱和晚霞。

shots.en: Empty dawn shot of Lake Michigan: a paper-white sun path on grey-blue water, then a slow pan right to the autumn bluff.
shots.zh: 黎明的密歇根湖空镜：灰蓝湖面上留白的太阳光路，镜头慢慢右摇到秋天的崖岸。

shots.en: The street under the maples: Clawd as Conrad, long striped scarf and satchel, stops on the sidewalk and turns to look back at the white colonial house where Calvin rakes leaves, then drops its eyes and turns away; a slow drift right with a slight pull back.
shots.zh: 枫树下的街道：扮康拉德的 Clawd 围着长条纹围巾、背着书包，在人行道上停下，回头看那栋白色殖民地式房子（卡尔文在院里耙叶），又垂下眼睛转开；镜头缓慢右移并略微拉开。

shots.en: Beth on the porch, arms folded, cold; the camera creeps in on her.
shots.zh: 门廊上的贝丝抱着双臂，神情冷淡；镜头慢慢推近她。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Conrad: a long navy-and-cream school scarf blown by the lake wind, and a leather satchel. The scene runs at 1.1× throughout, as slow as the Pachelbel opening. Three hard cuts: the lake, the son looking back at the house, the mother who gives nothing back. Its eyes moving from the house to the ground is the whole performance.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮康拉德：一条藏青配奶白的长校园围巾被湖风吹起，背一只皮书包。全程 1.1 倍速，和帕赫贝尔卡农的慢开场一样慢。三个硬切：湖、回头看家的儿子、没有回应的母亲。它的目光从房子落到地上，就是全部表演。

films.title: Chariots of Fire
blend_zh: Jean Droit 的 1924 奥运海报
films.desc_en: A four-colour stone lithograph after Jean Droit's 1924 Paris Olympics poster: classical bodies, a few inks, clumped stone grain, ragged registration on cream paper. Chariots of Fire builds to the 1924 Games, so its beach run becomes that poster coming to life.
films.desc_zh: 仿 Jean Droit 1924 巴黎奥运海报的四色石印：古典人体、有限油墨、成团的石版颗粒、参差套色。《烈火战车》讲的是 1924 年奥运，海滩长跑像那张海报活了过来。
films.prompt_en: 1920s stone lithograph poster in four inks: sea blue #245A8C, ochre #D49640, deep brown #40271B, warm red #E47E62, on aged cream #F1E7D1, misregistered about 1/700 of frame width. Every tone is ink grain, never a flat fill: specks about 1/1000 of frame width in soft clumps, covering 20–40% of pale areas, 50–80% of mid-tones, nearly all of solids (with pinholes); no stray specks on bare paper. Roles: blue for sky, water, cool shadow; ochre for ground and skin; brown for outlines, darks, clothes; red sparingly. Values calm and pale. Classical figures: ochre lit side, brown core-shadow line down each limb, head 1/8 of body; groups in a row. Slow motion carried by spray, dust, hair, cloth. Camera: long-lens front views, ground-level shots; optional serif title band. Reference: Jean Droit, 1924 Paris Olympics poster. Avoid: coarse speckle, pictogram figures, vector fills.
