films.direction_en: Clawd wears an olive EOD helmet with the visor up and holds wire cutters among six half-buried 155mm shells. Four cuts tighten from the page to the snap: the long walk, the face in the visor, Clawd's eyes, the cut. The snap comes just before the film ends.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 戴橄榄绿拆弹头盔、面罩掀起，手拿剪线钳，站在六枚半埋的 155mm 炮弹中间。四个镜头从整页一路收紧到剪断：漫长的走路、面罩里的脸、Clawd 的眼睛、剪线。咔的一声落在这段快结束的地方。

films.title: The King's Speech
films.style_zh: 斑驳墙 + 金色广播间
films.desc_en: Painterly interiors with heavy wall texture: Logue's peeling, many-coloured wall in cool grey-green, then a padded broadcast booth in amber gold with a sprung microphone and fine gold sound waves. It follows Eve Stewart's famous wall and the poster's gold.
films.desc_zh: 墙面肌理很重的油画质感室内：罗格诊室那面冷灰绿的多层斑驳墙，再到琥珀金的软包广播间、弹簧吊着的话筒和细细的金色声波。照着 Eve Stewart 设计的墙和海报的金黄。
films.prompt_en: Painterly interiors where the wall carries the image (outdoor subjects move into a related room with a window). Primary: a diamond-tufted padded wall in gold #C9A050 over deep brown #3A2610, brass button highlights, a warm glow behind the sound source (e.g. a hanging microphone). Secondary, for quiet scenes: a cool grey-green wall worn through to blue, pink, ochre and plaster, with damp lines and fine cracks; patches irregular, under a third of the wall. Clean-edged shapes under a subtle brush texture (strokes ~1/120 of frame width, ±5% brightness); faces, small objects crisp. Sound: 4–8 thin gold oscilloscope lines crossing the wall, spiky, later smooth. Figures in a corner, lots of wall. Camera: slow push-ins, one close-up of the source. References: cinematographer Danny Cohen, designer Eve Stewart (*The King's Speech*, 2010). Avoid: centred symmetry; coarse dabbed strokes; map-like peel; neon-bright waves.
films.prompt_zh: 墙面就是画面的油画质感室内（户外题材搬进相关的有窗屋子）。主调：菱形钉扣软包墙，金 #C9A050 压在深褐 #3A2610 上，扣子带黄铜高光，声源（比如吊着的话筒）后面一团暖金光。副调用于安静的场景：冷灰绿墙面，局部磨穿露出蓝、粉、赭和灰泥，有潮线和细裂纹；剥落块不规则，最多占墙面三分之一。形状边缘干净，只罩一层淡淡的笔触纹理（笔触约画宽 1/120，亮度起伏 ±5%）；脸和小物件画清楚。声音画成 4–8 条细金色示波线，扩过墙面，先带尖刺，后来平滑。人物偏到角落，留大片墙。镜头慢推，插一个声源特写。对标摄影师 Danny Cohen、美术指导 Eve Stewart（《国王的演讲》，2010）。避免：居中对称；粗糙点戳笔触；地图般的剥落；霓虹般亮的声波。

shots.en: Wide of Logue's consulting room: Clawd hunched at the left end of the old leather sofa with a cigarette, the huge peeling wall above it, a horn gramophone at right; a slow push in.
shots.zh: 全景：罗格的诊室，Clawd 缩在旧皮沙发左端夹着烟，上方是大片斑驳墙，右边一台喇叭留声机；镜头慢推。

shots.en: Big close-up of the marble microphone on its sprung ring, Clawd's crown and eyes at left: the gold sound waves come out broken (the stammer), then run smooth; a slow push in.
shots.zh: 大特写：弹簧吊环里的大理石话筒，左边是 Clawd 的王冠和眼睛；金色声波先是断断续续（口吃），然后变得流畅；镜头慢推。

shots.en: Medium wide of the 1939 broadcast room: Clawd with the speech at left, the microphone in the middle, Logue at right beating time with his hands as the ON AIR light comes on; a slight pull back.
shots.zh: 中全景：1939 年的广播间，Clawd 拿着讲稿在左，话筒居中，罗格在右边用手打拍子，ON AIR 灯亮起；镜头略拉。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays George VI: a small crown, a wing collar and dark tie, a cigarette in the room and the typed speech in the booth. Three hard cuts tell the cure: hunched in a corner, the stammer smoothing out in the waves, then the speech going out with Logue beating time.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮乔治六世：小王冠、翼领和深色领带，诊室里夹着烟，广播间里拿着打字稿。三个镜头硬切讲完治疗：缩在角落，声波从口吃变流畅，然后罗格打着拍子，演讲播出去。

films.title: The Artist
blend_zh: 好莱坞片厂的魅力布光
films.desc_en: Clean, glossy black and white with bright highlights and soft greys, Art Deco intertitles, light flicker and grain; Clawd is the only colour. The Artist was a 2011 love letter to silent Hollywood, so this is a sharper, cleaner silent film than No. 1.
films.desc_zh: 干净发亮的黑白：高光明亮、灰阶柔和，装饰艺术边框的字幕卡，轻微闪烁和颗粒；Clawd 是唯一的颜色。《艺术家》是 2011 年写给默片好莱坞的情书，所以比第 1 部更精致。
films.prompt_en: A modern homage to late-1920s silent film in black and white. Clean tones: glowing highlights, soft mid-greys, deep blacks; a gentle S-curve, grey halation around lights, slight flicker (±3%), fine grain, rare dust, a 1.33 pillarbox inside 16:9. Intertitles on black with an Art Deco border and spaced capitals, in the user's language. Settings: the subject's world staged as grand, ordered interiors or stage sets (e.g. a wrought-iron staircase, a gilt proscenium, a crowd in backlit silhouette); figures in elegant profile. The one hero subject the story centres on is the only coloured thing, wholly in tones of terracotta #D97757; lamps and fire stay grey. Camera: smooth push-ins and pull-backs, title cards flashed in, cuts landing on gestures (a bow, a wave). Reference: cinematographer Guillaume Schiffman (*The Artist*, 2011). Avoid: heavy scratches; sepia tint; colour bleeding into the greys.
films.prompt_zh: 致敬 20 年代末默片的现代黑白片。影调干净：发光的高光、柔和的中灰、深黑；温和的 S 曲线，灯周围有灰色光晕，轻微闪烁（±3%），细颗粒，偶有灰尘，16:9 里加 1.33 的左右黑边。字幕卡是黑底、装饰艺术风边框、字距拉开的大字，用观众的语言。场景：把题材的世界布置成宏大规整的室内或舞台布景（比如带铁艺栏杆的楼梯、金色台口、逆光剪影的人群），人物多取优雅侧面。故事围绕的那个主角是画面里唯一有颜色的东西，整个都用陶土橙 #D97757 的深浅来画；灯和火都保持灰色。镜头：平滑的推拉，字幕卡闪入，剪辑落在动作上（鞠躬、挥手）。对标摄影师 Guillaume Schiffman（《艺术家》，2011）。避免：重划痕；棕褐色调；颜色渗到灰色里。

shots.en: Wide of the Kinograph staircase, pushing in: Clawd as George on the landing lifts its top hat to Peppy on her way up, extras crossing up and down, Uggie at its side.
shots.zh: 楼梯全景往里推：Clawd 扮乔治站在平台上，向上楼的佩皮举起高礼帽致意，群演上下交错，Uggie 在它身边。

shots.en: Close on Clawd: the hat comes off in its raised hand, Uggie looking up at it; a slight push in.
shots.zh: 近景：Clawd 举起的手摘下帽子，Uggie 仰头看它；镜头略推。

shots.en: A full-screen intertitle: BANG! in an Art Deco border.
shots.zh: 全屏字幕卡：装饰艺术边框里写着 BANG!。

shots.en: On stage, Clawd points a finger-gun and Uggie keels over to play dead; a slow push in.
shots.zh: 舞台上，Clawd 用手指比枪，Uggie 往后一倒装死；镜头慢推。

shots.en: Wide of the premiere: THE END on the screen, Constance applauding at right, the house rising in silhouette as Clawd bows with its hat raised and its cane, Uggie at its feet; a slight pull back as the curtain starts to close.
shots.zh: 首映礼全景：银幕上是 THE END，右边 Constance 在鼓掌，观众剪影站起来，Clawd 举帽拄杖鞠躬，Uggie 在脚边；镜头略拉，大幕开始合上。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays George Valentin: white wing collar, black bow tie, silk top hat, cane, and Uggie the Jack Russell. Five quick cuts at near real speed: the hat lift on the stairs, the BANG! card flashed in, the dog's fall, then the bow as the audience stands. Clawd is the only colour.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮乔治·瓦伦丁：白色翼领、黑领结、丝质高礼帽、手杖，还有杰克罗素梗 Uggie。五个快切，接近真实速度：楼梯上举帽，BANG! 字幕卡一闪，小狗倒地，最后观众起立时鞠躬。Clawd 是唯一的颜色。

films.title: Argo
films.style_zh: 杰克·柯比 70 年代漫画页
films.desc_en: A 1970s Kirby comic book on a production desk: heavy ink, Kirby Krackle, Ben-Day dots on yellowed newsprint. The film's fake sci-fi movie was sold with real Kirby concept art, so the pages run from fake epic to the real runway escape.
films.desc_zh: 摊在制片桌上的 70 年代柯比漫画：粗墨线、柯比能量泡、泛黄新闻纸上的四色网点。片中那部假科幻片用的正是柯比画的概念图，所以漫画从假史诗一路翻到真实的跑道出逃。
films.prompt_en: 1970s Jack Kirby comic page. Heavy tapered brush contours, feathered spot blacks, exaggerated perspective, Kirby Krackle energy bubbles, block sound effects, hand-lettered balloons and yellow captions. CMYK flats printed as 45° Ben-Day dots: cyan #1696CD, magenta #DE2C70, yellow #FFD616, black #1C161A on aged newsprint #EEE2C2, colour plates 1 px off register. Paper grain, browned edges, a gutter fold shadow, warm lamp falloff. Lay the story out in panels and move between them: push into the splash, pan along a strip. Dots stay round and grow into pop-art dots on push-ins. Avoid: smooth digital gradients, clean white paper, stiff tube-like machines.
films.prompt_zh: 70 年代杰克·柯比漫画页。粗细变化的毛笔墨线，大块涂黑，透视夸张，黑色柯比能量泡，方块拟声字，手写对白框。CMYK 平涂用 45° 网点印出：青 #1696CD、品红 #DE2C70、黄 #FFD616、黑 #1C161A，泛黄新闻纸 #EEE2C2，色版错位 1 像素，纸有纤维和中缝阴影。分格叙事，镜头在格间推进、横移，推近时网点放大成波普圆点。避免：顺滑数码渐变、雪白的纸、僵硬的管状机械。

shots.en: Medium shot of the cosmic splash panel, slow push-in: Clawd, the caped space hero on a rock ledge, fires its ray gun and the beam blows up the robot's reactor with a KRAKA-THOOM.
shots.zh: 宇宙跨页大格的中景，缓慢推进：披风太空英雄 Clawd 站在岩架上开光枪，光束打爆机器人的反应堆，「KRAKA-THOOM」。

shots.en: Hard cut to the red film-strip panel: the houseguests in the terminal and the caption "THE MOVIE WAS FAKE. THE MISSION WAS REAL.", with a slight pan right.
shots.zh: 硬切到红色胶片条那一格：航站楼里的几位人质和旁白「THE MOVIE WAS FAKE. THE MISSION WAS REAL.」，镜头轻微右移。

shots.en: Hard cut to the night runway panel in steel blue, panning left to right past the chasing truck and jeeps to the airliner lifting off; Clawd sits behind a porthole in the corner inset, looking back.
shots.zh: 硬切到钢蓝色的夜间跑道格，从左往右横移，掠过追来的卡车和吉普，停在离地的客机；角上的舷窗小格里 Clawd 坐在窗后回望。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays the comic's space hero: a high red-lined collar, blue cape, gold cuffs and a Kirby ray gun. The beam fires inside the first beat, then two hard cuts turn the page from fake epic to real escape, ending with Clawd as a plain passenger at the plane window. Three panels in 2.5 seconds, read like a comic.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮漫画里的太空英雄：红里子高领、蓝披风、金护腕，手拿柯比式光枪。第一拍内光束开火，然后两刀硬切把书页从假史诗翻到真实出逃，最后 Clawd 卸下戏服，成了舷窗后的一名乘客。2.5 秒三格，像在读漫画。
refs: Jack Kirby, Lord of Light concept art (1979)

films.title: 12 Years a Slave
films.desc_en: An 1850s silver-plate photograph in a brass mat and velvet case, developing from blank: a violin on a chair, Clawd beside it, head bowed. It is the photography of Solomon Northup's own time, and tells the film with one object and no people.
films.desc_zh: 铜框丝绒盒里的 1850 年代银版照片，从空白显影：椅子上靠着小提琴，Clawd 低头站在旁边。这是所罗门·诺瑟普那个年代的照相术，只用一件物件讲这部片，不画人。
films.prompt_en: A cased 1850s daguerreotype, developing. Signature shot: the silver plate fills about 85% of the frame width inside a beaded brass mat #8a6a2c with a rounded-rectangle opening; velvet and leather only at the edges. Greyscale silver, near-black #1c1a18 to pale #ecebe6; a thin blue-violet to amber tarnish halo round the opening. Light swirls, hairline scratches, specks (±4% brightness). Soft window light from upper left; the subject poses still before a plain backdrop (an outdoor place is painted on it). One shot: the camera pushes from the open case to this framing in ~1 s, then holds; the image develops from blank mirror-grey, shadows first, a front sweeping left to right, done by ~3 s. Only the story's one hero is hand-tinted: a translucent flat wash (e.g. #D97757), shading showing through; lamps stay grey. Avoid: sepia, a small plate, fast cuts.
films.prompt_zh: 1850 年代盒装银版照片在显影。招牌镜头：银版宽度占画面约 85%，外圈是带珠串的黄铜衬框 #8a6a2c、圆角矩形开口，红丝绒和皮盒只露在边上。银版是灰阶银色，从近黑 #1c1a18 到浅银 #ecebe6；蓝紫到琥珀的氧化晕只在开口边缘窄窄一圈。抛光旋纹、发丝划痕和斑点都要轻（亮度 ±4%）。左上方柔和窗光，主体静止摆姿，背后素色布景，户外地点画在布景上。一镜到底：前 1 秒左右镜头从打开的盒子推到招牌景别，然后停住；影像从空白的镜面灰开始，暗部先出，显影前沿从左扫到右，约 3 秒显完。只有故事围绕的那个主角手工上色：一层半透明平涂（如 #D97757），透出底下的明暗；灯保持灰色。避免：棕褐色、银版太小、快切。

shots.en: One continuous shot: wide on the cased plate lying on the table, blank silver; the picture develops across it (a violin leaning on a ladder-back chair, Clawd standing beside it) while the camera pushes slowly in until the plate fills the frame and Clawd lowers its head.
shots.zh: 一镜到底：开场是桌上整只照相盒，银版一片空白；画面从一侧显影出来（小提琴靠在梯背椅上，Clawd 站在一旁），镜头慢慢推进直到银版铺满画面，Clawd 低下头。

films.direction_en: No costume and no people: Clawd stands beside Solomon's violin and slowly bows its head. The only movements are the image developing, one slow push-in and the bow, held as one uncut shot for the whole 2.5 seconds.
films.direction_zh: 没有戏服，也不画人：Clawd 站在所罗门的小提琴旁，慢慢低头。整段只有三种动：影像显影、一次慢推、低头，2.5 秒一刀不剪。
refs: Solomon Northup, Twelve Years a Slave (1853)

films.title: Birdman
films.desc_en: A detailed 3D backstage of a Broadway theatre shot as a handheld long take, warm tungsten against cold fluorescent, ending in the glare of Times Square. Birdman is remembered for looking like one unbroken shot, so the style is the camera move itself.
films.desc_zh: 细致的 3D 百老汇剧院后台，用手持长镜头拍：暖钨丝灯对冷日光灯，最后冲进时代广场的强光。《鸟人》最出名的就是假装一镜到底，所以这段的风格就是那条运镜。
films.prompt_en: Real-time 3D, one unbroken handheld long take, after cinematographer Emmanuel Lubezki (*Birdman*, 2014). A narrow, lived-in passage (default a backstage corridor; an outdoor subject gets its nearest interior, e.g. a stairwell): chipped blood-red enamel dado #6e2a22 on the lower third, stained nicotine plaster #cdb98e above, pipes, cable trays, doors, pinned notices. Light only from practicals every 2–3 m: warm caged tungsten bulbs, one cold flickering fluorescent tube, a red exit sign #ff2a1a; the far door glows. Mid-key: plaster light near lamps, never below mid-grey between them; floor visible. Wide lens (18–24 mm), slow sway (±1°), soft ambient occlusion, light bloom, fine grain (±3%). Over 20–40 s, in any order: lead the subject walking backwards, whip aside to a doorway, let it brush past the lens, turn and follow. Avoid: a locked-off camera, blank walls, repeated textures, a crushed dark frame.
films.prompt_zh: 实时 3D，仿摄影师埃马努埃尔·卢贝兹基（《鸟人》，2014），一条不断的手持长镜头。主体在窄而旧的通道里（默认后台走廊；户外题材放进最近的室内）：下三分之一是掉漆的血红搪瓷墙裙 #6e2a22，上面是带水渍的烟黄石膏墙 #cdb98e，头顶水管和桥架，墙上有门和告示。光只来自画内灯具，每两三米一盏：铁笼钨丝灯（暖）、一根在闪的日光灯（冷）、一盏红色出口灯 #ff2a1a；远处门外发亮。中等曝光：灯旁墙亮，灯间不低于中灰，地面看得清。广角 18–24 毫米，低频晃动约 ±1°，柔和环境光遮蔽、轻辉光、细颗粒（±3%）。运镜 20–40 秒，次序不限：倒退领路，甩向一侧的门洞，让主体擦过镜头，再转身跟上。避免：锁死机位、空白墙面、重复纹理、压得太黑。

shots.en: Handheld medium shot backing down the corridor ahead of Clawd in its Birdman helmet, whipping left to the jazz drummer in his alcove, then swinging back as Clawd passes the kit and brushes past the lens.
shots.zh: 手持中景，镜头在戴鸟人头盔的 Clawd 前面倒退着走，向左甩到小房间里打爵士鼓的鼓手，再甩回来，Clawd 走过鼓组、擦着镜头过去。

shots.en: Cut to behind Clawd at the stage door under the red EXIT light; the camera drifts sideways as Clawd shoves the door open onto white glare.
shots.zh: 切到后门，从 Clawd 背后拍，头顶是红色 EXIT 灯；镜头轻轻侧移，Clawd 一把推开门，门外一片白光。

shots.en: Cut to Times Square at night: wide on Clawd on the sidewalk with walls of LED screens behind it; it takes a step and looks up at the screens while the handheld camera drifts slightly.
shots.zh: 切到夜里的时代广场：全景，Clawd 站在人行道上，身后是成片的 LED 屏；它迈一步、抬头看屏幕，手持镜头轻轻漂移。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Riggan in a slate-blue Birdman helmet with a gold beak and feather wings. The corridor runs as one fast handheld move with the drummer's swing in frame; the shove on the stage door is the beat that cuts us out into Times Square, where Clawd stops and looks up.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮里根，戴一顶石板蓝的鸟人头盔，金色鸟喙、两侧羽翼。走廊是一条很快的手持运镜，鼓手的摇摆鼓点就在画面里；推开后门那一下卡在拍点上，切到时代广场，Clawd 停下抬头看。

films.title: Spotlight
films.style_zh: 缩微胶片阅读机 · 报纸网点
blend_zh: 图书馆缩微胶片阅读机
films.desc_en: A newspaper-halftone picture seen on the green-grey screen of a library microfiche reader, with scan lines, a rolling scan bar and dust on the glass. The reporters dug the story out of archives like this, and the fiche transport replaces the cuts.
films.desc_zh: 印成报纸网点的画面，放到缩微胶片阅读机的灰绿屏幕上：扫描线、滚动的扫描光带、玻璃上的灰尘。片中记者就在这种档案里挖出真相，换镜头也做成胶片横移。
films.prompt_en: A 2001 newspaper colour halftone on a library microfiche reader. Signature shot: the picture fills the frame, no headline or columns; lines and lettering inside it stay solid. CMYK screens at 15°, 75°, 0°, 45°, dots about 1/250 of frame width, 1 px misregistration. Convert to low-contrast phosphor-green monochrome, dots still clearly visible: film base #1b2320, frame gaps #0c110f, highlights no brighter than #a0dcaf. Only the story's one hero keeps its colour, whole figure (e.g. #D97757), screened and equally low-contrast; every light source turns green. Scan lines every 3 px, a faint scan bar every 4 s, a lamp hot-spot, dust, a hair, a light rounded hood vignette (outer ~5%), a small monospace fiche index. Scene changes slide the fiche sideways past a dark gap (0.5 s); slow push-ins. Avoid: newspaper layout, colour leaking, hard cuts.
films.prompt_zh: 2001 年报纸彩色网点，放在图书馆缩微胶片阅读机上看。招牌镜头：图片本身铺满画面，不要报头和文字栏；图里的线条和字（招牌、标签）保持实线。四色网点角度 15°、75°、0°、45°，网点约为画面宽度的 1/250，套色错 1 像素。整体转成低反差荧光绿单色，网点依然清楚可见：片基 #1b2320，帧间隙 #0c110f，高光不亮过 #a0dcaf。只有故事的主角整个人保留原色（如 #D97757），照样带网点，反差一样低；光源一律变绿。每 3 像素一条扫描线，每 4 秒滚过一道淡扫描带，一块柔和灯斑，玻璃上有灰和一根头发，圆角遮光罩只轻压外圈约 5%，一行小等宽胶片编号。换场把胶片横向滑过暗色帧间隙（0.5 秒）；镜头内慢推。避免：报纸版面、颜色外漏、硬切。

shots.en: Wide on the basement newsroom: reporters round paper-buried desks under fluorescent panels, Clawd in front with a press badge and notepad; slow pull-back.
shots.zh: 地下编辑部全景：记者围着堆满纸的桌子，头顶是荧光灯格栅，Clawd 站在前面，挂着工作证、拿着速记本；镜头慢慢拉开。

shots.en: The fiche slides sideways to the next frame: top-down on a printed list of priests, a toy-sized Clawd pushing a giant highlighter down the lines while the camera drifts down.
shots.zh: 胶片横向滑到下一帧：俯拍打印的神父名单，玩具大小的 Clawd 推着一支大荧光笔一行行往下划，镜头跟着往下移。

shots.en: Another slide to the loading dock: medium close-up of Clawd beside the front page headline "Church allowed abuse by priest for years", slow push-in.
shots.zh: 再滑到印刷厂码头：中近景，Clawd 站在头版旁，标题是「Church allowed abuse by priest for years」，镜头慢推。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays a Spotlight reporter: a staff badge on a lanyard, a notepad, later a highlighter. Three frames of fiche, each joined by the reader's sideways transport instead of a hard cut, landing on the front page as the last beat.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮 Spotlight 小组的记者：挂绳工作证、速记本，后面换成荧光笔。三帧缩微胶片，衔接不用硬切，而是阅读机里胶片的横向滑动，最后一拍落在头版上。
refs: The Boston Globe front page, 6 January 2002

films.title: Moonlight
blend_zh: 青绿 / 品红 / 蓝紫双色调
films.desc_en: Painted oil portraiture in saturated teal, magenta and moon-blue, with sculpted heads repainted in form-following strokes. It takes the film's title line, "in moonlight black boys look blue", literally.
films.desc_zh: 饱满的青绿、品红和月光蓝油画肖像，雕出来的头像再用顺着形体的笔触重新画一遍。直接照着片名那句「月光下，黑人男孩看起来是蓝色的」来画。
films.prompt_en: Night oil portraiture: smooth volumes repainted in two passes of short, low-contrast (±8% value) form-following strokes: broad (1/60 of frame width) on water, sky and cloth, fine (1/150) on faces, which stay smooth. Palette by role: sky, sea and far land mid blue-violet #32377a, about 60% of the frame; moonlit planes and sand pale lavender-blue; teal #128a91 in water and lit sides; magenta #7a2f86 rim; deepest shadows #07071c. Any skin takes blue top planes and a wet highlight, eyes open and lit. Default night: one key, a full moon with a broken glitter path on water; magenta only as a soft rim from a distant glow; other small light sources stay cyan-white points. Grain ±3%. Signature shot: the figure calm, ~2/3 of frame height. Slow push-ins. Reference: Barry Jenkins, *Moonlight* (2016). Avoid: coarse dabs, small dark statue eyes, a murky frame.
films.prompt_zh: 夜色油画肖像。平滑实心体积上，顺着形体用两遍短笔触重画，笔触反差小（明度 ±8%）：海、天、衣服用宽笔，约为画面宽度的 1/60；脸用细笔 1/150，保持平滑。按用途分色：天、海、远处陆地用中等明度的蓝紫 #32377a，约占画面六成；受月光的面和沙地提亮成淡薰衣草蓝；青绿 #128a91 用在水里和受光一侧；轮廓光用品红 #7a2f86；最深暗部 #07071c。任何肤色顶面都受蓝光、带湿亮高光，眼睛睁开有光。默认夜晚，唯一主光是满月，水面铺出碎光；品红只是远处光源的柔和轮廓光；其他小光源只是一小点青白光。颗粒 ±3%。招牌镜头：人物平静，约占画高三分之二。慢推。参照巴里·詹金斯《月光男孩》（2016）。避免：粗块笔触、石膏像小黑眼、发闷的近黑画面。

shots.en: Split-level shot on the waterline of a turquoise Miami sea: a man stands chest-deep and holds Clawd up on his palm, his hand visible under the surface; slow push-in.
shots.zh: 贴着碧绿海面的半水上半水下镜头：一个男人站在齐胸深的水里，用手掌托着 Clawd，水下能看见他的手；镜头慢推。

shots.en: Cut to three painted portraits side by side in teal, magenta and violet; they slide into a single wedge collage as the camera reframes, with Clawd standing in the teal panel.
shots.zh: 切到并排的三张油画肖像，青绿、品红、蓝紫各一张；镜头重新取景，三张脸滑拼成一个楔形拼贴，Clawd 站在青绿那一块里。

shots.en: Cut to the moonlit beach: two-shot of Kevin and Clawd sitting on the blue sand, full moon upper right, surf breaking; slow push-in.
shots.zh: 切到月光下的海滩：凯文和 Clawd 并排坐在蓝色沙滩上的双人镜头，满月在右上，浪花拍岸；镜头慢推。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Little with no costume: held on the waterline in the swimming lesson, standing among the three faces, then sitting on the sand beside Kevin. Three chapters in three hard cuts; the sea and beach shots push in slowly so the stillness carries.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮小喀戎，不穿戏服：先在游泳课上被托在水面，再站在三张脸之间，最后坐在凯文身边的沙滩上。三个章节三个镜头硬切；海里和海滩两个镜头都慢慢推近，让安静延续下去。

films.title: The Shape of Water
blend_en: Projected caustics and volumetric light shafts
blend_zh: Dan Laustsen 的青绿配暖金调色
films.desc_en: A flooded 1960s bathroom and a lab tank in real-time 3D, soaked in teal with moving caustics, light shafts from above, bubbles and warm practical lamps. Del Toro's film lives in that green-blue water, so the whole segment is shot inside it.
films.desc_zh: 实时 3D 的被淹浴室和实验室水箱，整片浸在青绿里：流动的焦散、从上方落下的光束、气泡和几盏暖色灯。德尔·托罗这部片就泡在这种水里，所以整段在水中拍。
films.prompt_en: Real-time 3D, fully under water (land subjects sink into a flooded room or sunken place), in teal: background #041414, hemisphere light #5fb3a6 above and #0c2a24 below; teal fog, reds fading first with distance. A strong source above the surface projects moving caustics: bright cells about 1/20 of frame width on near surfaces, sliding over floor, walls and the subject. Shafts fan down; edges stay dark. Bubbles, motes, the rippled surface from below. Warm gold on 1–3 practicals, at least one large (a lit window or lamp ~1/10 of frame width), plus cyan bioluminescence. Smooth-shaded models, ambient occlusion, shallow focus, modest bloom, grain ±3%. Signature shot: low angle looking up, the subject half the frame height, off-centre beside the light; slow push-ins. Reference: Guillermo del Toro, *The Shape of Water* (2017). Avoid: flat water, caustics as sky stripes, tiny warm accents.
films.prompt_zh: 实时 3D，全在水下（陆上题材就沉进淹水的屋子或水下遗迹），泡在青绿里：背景 #041414，半球光上方 #5fb3a6、下方 #0c2a24，青绿雾，红色随距离最先消失。水面上方一个强光源投下流动焦散：近处表面上的亮格子约为画面宽度的 1/20，滑过地面、墙面和主体。光柱向下散开，画面四边保持暗。气泡、微粒、从下仰看的波纹水面。暖金色给一到三处实际灯光，至少一处要大（亮窗或灯，约为画面宽度的 1/10），加青色生物荧光。平滑着色，环境光遮蔽、浅景深、适度辉光、颗粒（±3%）。招牌镜头：低机位仰拍，主体约占画面高度一半，偏在光源一侧；慢推。参照吉尔莫·德尔·托罗《水形物语》（2017）。避免：平板的水、焦散画成天上的条纹、暖色点缀太小。

shots.en: Low-angle wide inside the flooded bathroom: the amphibian man holds Clawd in an embrace under the light shafts, a red shoe sinking; slow push-in.
shots.zh: 被淹浴室里的低机位全景：两栖人在光束下抱着 Clawd，一只红鞋在下沉；镜头慢推。

shots.en: Cut to a close-up of the faces: his crest and gills against Clawd's corner, the red ribbon bow, bubbles rising; easing in.
shots.zh: 切到脸部近景：他的头冠和鳃贴着 Clawd 的一角，红色发带蝴蝶结，气泡上升；镜头缓缓推近。

shots.en: Cut to the lab: medium shot of Clawd in front of the glowing tank holding a boiled egg, reaching back to lay its hand on the glass; slow push-in.
shots.zh: 切到实验室：中景，Clawd 站在发光的水箱前，手里拿着白煮蛋，向后伸手贴上玻璃；镜头慢推。

shots.en: Cut to a close-up of the two hands meeting through the glass as a cyan glow blooms where they touch.
shots.zh: 切到特写：两只手隔着玻璃相贴，接触处亮起一团青光。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Elisa with a deep-red velvet ribbon and bow, later a boiled egg in hand. Four cuts in 2.5 seconds, a steady 1.25× pace: the embrace under the light, the faces, the tank, then the hands, with the cyan glow on the touch as the closing beat.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮埃莉莎，头上一条深红丝绒发带和蝴蝶结，后面手里拿一个白煮蛋。2.5 秒四刀，节奏稳定在 1.25 倍：光束下的拥抱、贴着的脸、水箱，最后是两只手，接触处亮起青光作为收尾的一拍。
refs: Guillermo del Toro, The Shape of Water (2017)

films.title: Green Book
blend_zh: Curt Teich 亚麻纹明信片
films.desc_en: A "Greetings from the Deep South" linen postcard that comes alive: woven paper texture, airbrushed saturated colour, chrome sparkles. The film is a 1962 road trip through the South, the same roads these cards sold to tourists.
films.desc_zh: 一张「南方问候」亚麻纹明信片活了过来：布纹纸、喷枪上的饱和色、镀铬上的星形闪光。影片是 1962 年穿越美国南方的公路旅行，走的正是这种明信片上的路。
films.prompt_en: A 1950s–60s linen postcard, Curt Teich manner. Linen-weave card: ink only on raised threads, a fine crosshatch about 1/300 of frame width, white specks in the hollows. Saturated hand-separated colour, airbrush blends: sky blue #3fa0dc, grass green #4fae57, pink #f08cb0, teal #2fb5b8 for the main object or water, cream card #f6e4b8 for paper and border. The main object large, side-on, about half the card's height. Star glints on shiny surfaces; registration off 1–2 px. Big navy 3D block letters with white outlines across the top third spell the place or title (invent one if needed), a small scene in each letter, a red ribbon banner above. Open on the card on a desk, push in until it fills the frame and comes alive (water, figures move), then track sideways. Avoid: weave-less gradients, greyish colour, photographic perspective.
films.prompt_zh: 五六十年代亚麻纹明信片，柯特·泰希出版社那一路。平纹布纹卡纸：油墨只落在凸起的经纬上，形成约为画面宽度 1/300 的细格纹，凹处露白点。手工分色的饱和色，喷枪柔和过渡：天蓝 #3fa0dc、草绿 #4fae57、粉红 #f08cb0，主体物或水面用青绿 #2fb5b8，奶油卡纸 #f6e4b8 作底色和白边。主体物要大，正侧面，约占卡片高度一半。亮面加四角星闪光；套色错位 1–2 像素。藏青立体大字带白描边，横在卡片上三分之一，写地名或片名（没有就按题材编一个），每个字母里嵌一小幅风景，上方配红飘带。开场明信片放在桌上，推进到满屏后画面活过来（水在动、人在走），再侧向横移。避免：没有布纹的渐变、发灰的颜色、照片式透视。

shots.en: One continuous move: the postcard on a motel desk beside a Green Book and a room key; the camera pushes into the card until the picture comes alive, the teal Cadillac pulls away and the camera pulls back into a side-on tracking shot of Clawd at the wheel with Dr. Shirley in the back.
shots.zh: 一个连续运镜：汽车旅馆书桌上的明信片，旁边是绿皮书和房门钥匙；镜头一路推进明信片，画面活过来，青绿色凯迪拉克开动，镜头往后拉开，变成侧面跟拍，Clawd 握着方向盘，雪利博士坐在后座。

shots.en: One cut to the concert hall: wide on Dr. Shirley at the grand piano with his trio under red velvet curtains, Clawd standing at the wing watching; slight push-in.
shots.zh: 唯一一刀切到音乐厅：全景，雪利博士和他的三重奏在红丝绒幕前演奏三角钢琴，Clawd 站在侧幕边看；镜头轻推。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Tony: a slicked black pompadour, short sky-blue sleeves, a lit cigarette, one hand on the wheel. The push into the postcard carries us into the road without a cut; the single cut lands on the concert hall, where Dr. Shirley plays and Clawd watches from the wing.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮托尼：油亮的黑色大背头、浅蓝短袖口、一支点着的烟，一手握方向盘。推进明信片的运镜直接带进公路，不切；唯一的一刀落在音乐厅，雪利博士弹琴，Clawd 在侧幕边看。

films.title: Parasite
blend_zh: 建筑剖切填充与比例人
films.desc_en: One architectural section through a Seoul hillside: the glass house on top, a hidden bunker beneath, stairs down to a flooding half-basement, in fine lines and soft material colours. Parasite is built on that vertical class divide, so one drawing holds the film.
films.desc_zh: 一张剖开首尔山坡的建筑剖面图：山顶的玻璃豪宅、地下的秘密掩体、一路通到被淹的半地下室，细线、柔和的材质色。《寄生虫》建在这种上下的阶级落差上，一张图装下整部片。
films.prompt_en: Vector section axonometric, low dimetric view: the cut face lies along the near-flat 7° axis, facing us, depth along the 42° axis at half scale; roof and near walls cut away to show the rooms. Cut through the subject's place (a house, a tower, a ship, a hillside). Poché on cut faces: dark concrete with aggregate, earth hatched at 45° with stones. 1 px dark-grey lines at every zoom. Default daylight under a pale sky: concrete #b3ada2, oak #d6b58a, charcoal #3e4146, pine #3f6b3e, white walls, green lawn, translucent blue water. Furnished rooms, simple scale figures. Night or other low light is a variation: multiply 30–40% moonlit blue, lit rooms painted back warm. Crane slowly framing 2–3 rooms along one continuous path; end on the whole drawing at ~80% of the frame. Avoid: 30° isometric, thick outlines, cuts between levels, a small drawing.
films.prompt_zh: 矢量建筑剖面轴测图，用低角度二等角视图：剖切面沿接近水平的 7° 轴正对观众，进深沿 42° 轴、按一半缩短；屋顶和近侧墙剖掉，露出房间。剖切穿过主体所在之处（房子、塔、船、山坡）。切面填涂黑：深色混凝土带骨料，土层画 45° 斜线夹小石块。任何缩放都是 1 像素深灰线。默认白天、淡色天空：混凝土 #b3ada2、橡木 #d6b58a、炭灰 #3e4146、松绿 #3f6b3e，白墙、绿草坪、半透明蓝水。房间配家具和简洁的小比例人。夜景或其他暗光只是变体：叠乘三到四成月光蓝，亮灯的房间涂回暖色。镜头沿剖面慢慢升降，框住两三个房间，跟主体走一条不断的路线，最后停在占画面约八成的整张图上。避免：30° 等轴测、粗卡通描边、楼层间切镜头、图太小。

shots.en: Daytime section of the glass house and its striped lawn party: Clawd stands in the garden doorway holding the scholar's stone over its head; slow push-in.
shots.zh: 白天的玻璃豪宅剖面和条纹草坪上的派对：Clawd 站在花园门口，双手把山水石举过头顶；镜头慢慢推近。

shots.en: Cut to the stormy night: the Parks' living room with Clawd hiding by the coffee table, then the camera cranes down through the floor slab and the basement to the bunker, where the lights blink Morse.
shots.zh: 切到暴雨夜：朴家客厅，Clawd 躲在茶几边；镜头像升降机一样往下，穿过楼板和地下室，落到掩体，灯在按摩斯码闪。

shots.en: Cut to one continuous descent in the rain: the camera follows Clawd, the stone held over its head, from the gate down the long flights, through a tunnel under the road, into the low town and the flooding half-basement, then cranes out to the whole section, the house on top and the flood at the bottom.
shots.zh: 切到雨中一路往下的长镜头：镜头跟着头顶山水石的 Clawd 从大门走下一段段长台阶，穿过马路底下的隧道，进到低处的街巷和正在被淹的半地下室，再升起拉开成整张剖面，豪宅在顶上，淹水在最底下。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Ki-woo, carrying the scholar's stone the whole way: over its head on the lawn, crouched by the table in the storm, carrying it down the hill. Two cuts only; inside each shot the camera travels the section vertically so rich and poor share a frame, and the film's 12 beats end on the full drawing.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮基宇，山水石一路不离手：在草坪上举过头顶，暴雨夜躲在茶几边，再一路顶着它下山。全段只切两刀；每个镜头里镜头都沿剖面上下走，让富人和穷人在同一个画面里，12 拍最后停在整张剖面上。

films.title: Nomadland
films.desc_en: Chalky soft-pastel strokes on grey-violet paper, the sky turning from gold to rose to violet over a wide plain with an old camper van. Nomadland lives in that long, empty horizon at dusk, and pastel keeps it soft and quiet.
films.desc_zh: 灰紫色纸上的粉质色粉笔触，一片开阔的平原和一辆旧房车，天空从金黄变成玫瑰色再到紫色。《无依之地》就活在黄昏那条又长又空的地平线上，色粉让它安静、柔和。
films.prompt_en: Soft pastel on grey-violet toned paper #7d7079, tooth showing everywhere as fine speckle (±8% brightness). Sky blended smooth, a few long thin cloud bands. The land carries the texture: dry-grass ochre (gold dulled toward the paper grey) under fine upright grass strokes (1/400 of frame width wide, 1/40 long, ±15% value), dense in the foreground, thinning toward the horizon. Objects get soft diagonal hatching, broken edges. Palette by role: gold #f6cf7a at the horizon, rose #c9738a in the lower sky, violet #4b3f78 for high sky, clouds and far land, dusk blue #2b2d5c for shadows. A long horizon near mid-frame over open land or water; the subject mid-sized in the lower half. The sky drifts gold to rose to violet; lamps brighten as it darkens. One slow pan with a light push-in. Avoid: oily impasto, sharp edges, bare smooth ground.
films.prompt_zh: 灰紫色纸 #7d7079 上的软色粉画，纸的齿纹处处透出来，成细密颗粒（亮度 ±8%）。天空揉开抹平，只有几条细长的横向云带。质感集中在地面：干草赭色（金黄往纸的灰色压暗），上面铺满直立的细草笔，每笔宽约为画面宽度的 1/400、长约 1/40，明度起伏 ±15%，前景密，往地平线渐稀。物体用柔和的斜向排笔，边缘软而碎。按用途分色：地平线金黄 #f6cf7a，下层天空玫瑰 #c9738a，高空、云带和远处陆地用紫 #4b3f78，暗部用暮蓝 #2b2d5c。地平线长，在画面中线附近，下面是原野或水面；主体和身边的东西中等大小，放在下半幅。天色从金黄转玫瑰再转紫，越暗暖灯越亮。一个缓慢横移带轻推的镜头。避免：油画厚涂感、锐利数码边、光秃平滑的地面。

shots.en: One continuous wide shot: Clawd walks in front of an old white camper van with its side door open while the camera travels with it and pushes in slightly, the plain and buttes sliding by; it reaches a striped rug by a lantern, sits down and looks out at the horizon as the sky turns from gold to violet.
shots.zh: 一镜到底的全景：Clawd 从一辆侧门敞开的白色旧房车前走过，镜头跟着它横移并轻轻推近，平原和远处的孤丘缓缓滑过；它走到露营灯旁的条纹毯子上坐下，望向地平线，天色从金黄变成紫色。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Fern with no props, just a walk, a sit and a look. One uncut shot: the walk eases to a stop on the rug, it sits, then lifts its eyes to the horizon while the lantern and the van's doorway glow warmer as the dusk falls.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮弗恩，不拿道具，只有走、坐、看三个动作。整段一刀不剪：走路慢慢停在毯子上，坐下，再抬眼望向地平线；天色暗下来，露营灯和房车门口的光越来越暖。

films.title: CODA
films.desc_en: A polished sperm-whale tooth on an oak table, engraved in fine black lines with touches of red, blue and yellow: a Gloucester fishing boat, the family hauling nets, Ruby singing at the bow. It is the folk art of CODA's own New England coast.
films.desc_zh: 橡木桌上一颗抛光的抹香鲸牙，刻着细密的黑线，点缀红、蓝、黄：格洛斯特的渔船、收网的一家人、船头唱歌的鲁比。这是影片所在的新英格兰海岸自己的民间工艺。
films.prompt_en: Scrimshaw: 19th-century sailor's engraving on a whale tooth. Signature shot: a broad, flat-sided tooth lies horizontal on an oak table, about 85% of frame width and 70% of its height; ink bottle, jackknife beside. Engrave in near-black #17110c: needle hatching (lines 1/800 of frame width, spaced about 1/500), swelling outlines, stipple. Lines cover ~70% of the face, dense in sea, subject and land, sky lightly hatched; seas as rows of stylised waves. The hero is large (~1/3 of the tooth's height), coloured; otherwise red #9a2a22, blue #2b4a78, yellow #e9b526 only as small touches. Warm ivory, growth bands, scratches, honey tip. Folk layout: rope border, ribbon motto, rayed sun, motifs from the subject's world. Shade the edges, one gloss streak; don't warp the picture. Push in, then pan slowly as waves animate. Avoid: thick lines, solid fills, a slim horn.
films.prompt_zh: 19 世纪水手在抛光鲸牙上的针刻画。招牌镜头：宽而扁的鲸牙横躺在橡木桌上，占画面宽约 85%、高约 70%，墨水瓶和折刀在边上。用近黑墨 #17110c 刻：细针排线（线宽约画面宽的 1/800，线距约 1/500）、粗细起伏的轮廓线和点刻。刻线覆盖牙面约七成：海、主体和陆地密，天空轻排线；海是成排的程式化波浪。主角要大（约占牙面高三分之一）并上色；此外红 #9a2a22、蓝 #2b4a78、黄 #e9b526 只作点缀。暖象牙底、淡生长纹、抛光划痕、牙尖蜜黄。民间朴拙构图：绳纹边框、飘带题词、放射光芒的太阳、主体世界的图案。弧度靠边缘明暗和一道窗户反光，画面不变形。先拍整颗牙，推进后慢慢横移，波浪随之动起来。避免：粗线、实色填涂、细长的牛角形。

shots.en: Wide on the engraved whale tooth lying on an oak table with a jackknife and an ink bottle; the camera pushes in until the tooth fills the frame.
shots.zh: 全景：刻好的鲸牙放在橡木桌上，旁边是折刀和墨水瓶；镜头推进，直到鲸牙铺满画面。

shots.en: Cut into the engraving: medium-wide on the fishing boat, panning slowly left to right with a slight push-in, from Frank signing I-love-you while the net is hauled to Clawd singing at the bow, a stave of notes unrolling from its raised arm.
shots.zh: 切进刻画：渔船的中全景，镜头从左往右慢慢横移并轻推，从一边收网一边打出「我爱你」手语的弗兰克，移到船头唱歌的 Clawd，一行五线谱从它举起的手臂上展开。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Ruby in a yellow sou'wester, standing on a fish crate at the bow. One cut from the object into the picture, then a single gentle pan carries the eye from the father's sign to the song as the stave of notes unrolls.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮鲁比，戴一顶黄色防水渔夫帽，站在船头的鱼箱上。只有一刀：从物件切进刻画，然后一次轻轻的横移，把视线从父亲的手语带到歌声上，五线谱跟着歌声展开。
refs: New Bedford Whaling Museum scrimshaw collection

films.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
films.style_zh: 光线步进多元宇宙跳切
blend_en: One look per universe (office realism, cosmic surreal, landscape, commercial)
blend_zh: GLSL 光线步进的多个宇宙
一个宇宙一种画法（写实办公室、超现实宇宙、风景、广告）
films.desc_en: Four universes, each with its own look, all ray-marched in real time: a cold-green IRS office, a hot-dog-finger piano lit like an advert, a silent canyon of googly-eyed rocks, the Everything Bagel as a black hole. A googly eye jumps between them.
films.desc_zh: 四个宇宙四种画法，全部实时光线步进：冷绿的国税局、广告光下的热狗手指钢琴、贴大眼睛石头的寂静峡谷、变成黑洞的万物贝果。像电影里一样，靠大眼睛贴纸在宇宙间跳转。
films.prompt_en: Ray-marched real-time 3D multiverse montage: the subject jumps through 3–4 universes, each its own look, invented from its world, e.g. a realistic workplace under cold green fluorescents, densely dressed; a surreal cosmic version with a gravitational-lens halo; a silent wide landscape with white subtitles; a candy-pink product shot with pink-and-cyan rims. Each holds 2–4 s with its own grade. One link through all: a googly-eye sticker on the subject, about 1/10 of frame height. Transition, 0.5–0.8 s: push into the eye, smear, split RGB, then a rainbow ring of colour segments (#e5322d, #f7c928, #1fa39a, #2a6fc0, #e0478f) studded with googly eyes and pink beads blooms to ~80% of frame height and bursts to white. Signature frame: the ring around the subject; first jump at ~1 s. Reference: Daniels, *Everything Everywhere All at Once* (2022). Avoid: look-alike universes, a small plain ring.
films.prompt_zh: 实时光线步进 3D 的多元宇宙蒙太奇：主体在三到四个宇宙之间跳转，各有画法，都从主体自己的世界变出来，例如：冷绿日光灯下的写实工作场所，陈设很满；带引力透镜光环的超现实宇宙；配白字幕的安静旷野远景；糖果粉背景、粉青轮廓光的广告产品照。每个停 2–4 秒，各自调色。贯穿始终的衔接物：主体身上的一只活动眼贴纸，约占画高十分之一。跳转 0.5–0.8 秒：推进这只眼睛，拖影、RGB 分离，再炸开一圈彩虹色块环（#e5322d、#f7c928、#1fa39a、#2a6fc0、#e0478f），环上嵌满活动眼和粉珠，扩到画高约八成后白闪。招牌画面：彩虹环围着主体绽开；第一次跳转在 1 秒左右。参照丹尼尔斯兄弟《瞬息全宇宙》（2022）。避免：宇宙都一个样、环太小太素。

shots.en: Wide on the IRS office with receipts flying, the camera dollying down the aisle toward Clawd, who wears a googly eye on its forehead and a bum bag.
shots.zh: 国税局办公室全景，收据满天飞，镜头沿过道推向 Clawd；它额头贴着一只大眼睛，腰上挂着腰包。

shots.en: Cut to the auditor at her steel desk piled with receipts, holding one up; slow push-in.
shots.zh: 切到审计员和她堆满收据的钢制办公桌，她举着一张收据；镜头慢推。

shots.en: Cut to Clawd, arms raised, as the camera pushes hard into the googly eye on its forehead and the verse-jump flash fires.
shots.zh: 切到举起双臂的 Clawd，镜头猛推进它额头的大眼睛，跳宇宙的闪光炸开。

shots.en: The hot-dog-finger universe: wide on a glossy piano under candy-pink light, a hand of floppy hot-dog fingers on the keys, Clawd standing on the keys.
shots.zh: 热狗手指宇宙：糖果粉光下的亮面钢琴全景，一只手的热狗手指软软地瘫在琴键上，Clawd 站在琴键上。

shots.en: Cut closer to Clawd's feet stomping the keys, little hot dogs on the ends of its arms.
shots.zh: 切近到 Clawd 的脚，一下下踩着琴键，两臂末端也长出小热狗。

shots.en: Push into the googly eye again, and the next jump.
shots.zh: 再次推进大眼睛，接下一次跳宇宙。

shots.en: Wide, still canyon rim: two rocks with googly eyes beside Clawd sitting quietly, subtitle "We're all small and stupid."; the camera drifts slowly along the edge.
shots.zh: 寂静峡谷边的全景：两块贴着大眼睛的石头，Clawd 安静地坐在旁边，字幕「We're all small and stupid.」；镜头沿崖边慢慢漂移。

shots.en: The Everything Bagel: Clawd looks up at the giant black bagel, then the camera pushes into its black-hole centre and through the event horizon as Clawd is pulled forward.
shots.zh: 万物贝果：Clawd 仰望巨大的黑色贝果，镜头一路推进中间的黑洞，穿过视界，Clawd 被吸得往前倾。

shots.en: Back in the office: Clawd flings its arms open as a rainbow mandala ring of googly eyes grows behind it; slight pull-back.
shots.zh: 回到办公室：Clawd 张开双臂，身后长出一圈带大眼睛的彩虹曼陀罗环；镜头轻轻拉开。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Evelyn with a googly eye on its forehead and a bum bag. Each jump is a push into that eye followed by a smear, RGB split and white flash timed to the cut, then a different action per universe: standing, stomping piano keys, sitting with the rocks, being pulled into the bagel. It ends where it started, arms open in the mandala.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮秀莲，额头贴大眼睛、腰挂腰包。每次跳宇宙都是先推进那只眼睛，再接拖影、RGB 分离和白闪，卡在切点上；每个宇宙一个不同的动作：站着、用脚踩琴键、陪石头坐着、被吸进贝果。最后回到起点，在曼陀罗里张开双臂。
refs: Daniels, Everything Everywhere All at Once (2022)
Everything Everywhere All at Once (2022) poster

films.title: Oppenheimer
films.style_zh: 3D 粒子火球 · IMAX 颗粒
blend_zh: 三位一体试验高速照片
films.desc_en: The Trinity test site before dawn rebuilt in real-time 3D, with a fireball of about 720,000 particles, quantum visions of orbits and waves, deep pre-dawn blue against orange-gold fire and IMAX-style grain. Oppenheimer is built on that one light.
films.desc_zh: 用实时 3D 重建黎明前的三位一体试验场：约 72 万粒子的火球、轨道和波组成的量子幻象，深蓝夜色对橙金火光，加 IMAX 式颗粒。《奥本海默》就围着这一道光展开。
films.prompt_en: Real-time 3D night lit by one huge particle event: a ~500k-particle fireball (or flare, eruption, wildfire) whose shape follows time: white flash (0.5 s), billowing dome by 1 s, a rolling toroid, a dust wall sweeping out. Right behind the subject like a halo, ~40% of the frame: white-gold core, bright orange-gold billows #ff9a50 with visible texture, black smoke only as thin veins and the top edge (under 15%). Its glow fills everything: warm #ffd8a0 on ground and cloud undersides, a hot rim on the subject, faces lit warm at half strength; long shadows toward camera. The rest is pre-dawn blue #2a3654 and dark earth #16120e. Clip only the core. IMAX grade: grain ±3%, warm halation, vignette, slight gate weave. Low wide angle, subject centred, slow push-ins. Reference: Christopher Nolan, *Oppenheimer* (2023). Avoid: a smooth CG ball, smoke-shrouded fire.
films.prompt_zh: 实时 3D 夜景，主角光是一场巨大的粒子事件：几十万粒子的火球（或照明弹、火山喷发、山火），形状随时间走：白闪（0.5 秒），1 秒成翻滚的斑驳穹顶，再卷成环，尘墙外扫。在主体正后方像光环，约占画面四成：核心白金，大部分是有纹理的亮橙金火团 #ff9a50，黑烟只做细暗纹和顶边，不超一成半。火光照亮全场：暖色 #ffd8a0 铺满地面和云底，主体有热轮廓光，脸上仍有半强度暖光；长影子朝镜头拖来，火星飘飞。其余是黎明前的深蓝 #2a3654 和暗土 #16120e。只让核心过曝。IMAX 拷贝调色：细颗粒（±3%）、暖色光晕溢出、暗角、轻微片门晃动。低机位广角，主体居中，慢推。参照克里斯托弗·诺兰《奥本海默》（2023）。避免：光滑的 CG 光球、被黑烟裹住的火。

shots.en: Low-angle wide on the floodlit steel tower before dawn, the countdown beacon blinking, the camera slowly pushing in.
shots.zh: 黎明前低机位仰拍被探照灯照亮的钢塔，倒计时的信号灯在闪，镜头慢推。

shots.en: Cut to the bomb in its corrugated shack: the bolted sphere wrapped in cables under a warm work light; locked off.
shots.zh: 切到波纹铁皮小屋里的炸弹：缠满电缆的螺栓球体，暖色工作灯；固定机位。

shots.en: Cut to the quantum vision on black: glowing orbits round a core, interference waves below, a star collapsing.
shots.zh: 切到黑底上的量子幻象：围绕核心的发光轨道、下方的干涉波、一颗坍缩的恒星。

shots.en: A white flash, then the reverse shot: observers in hats hold welding glass to their eyes, lit by the fire, with Clawd in the middle in a porkpie hat and pipe; locked off.
shots.zh: 一道白闪，接反打：戴帽子的观察者举着焊接玻璃，脸被火光照亮，Clawd 戴平顶软呢帽、拿着烟斗站在中间；固定机位。

shots.en: Low-angle wide on Clawd standing in the road, the fireball rising behind it like a halo and embers drifting in the air; slow push-in.
shots.zh: 低机位全景：Clawd 站在路中间，身后的火球像光环一样升起，火星在空中飘；镜头慢推。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Oppenheimer with a camel porkpie hat and a briar pipe that smokes. Five hard-cut shots build the countdown: tower, device, vision, then the flash lands on the cut into the watchers, and the music keeps going while the fireball swells behind Clawd for the last second.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮奥本海默：一顶浅驼色平顶软呢帽，手里一只冒烟的石楠烟斗。五个镜头硬切，垒出倒计时：铁塔、装置、幻象，白闪正好落在切进观察者的那一刀上；音乐不停，最后一秒火球在 Clawd 身后膨胀。

films.title: Anora
films.desc_en: Glowing neon tubes in pink, cyan and orange, smeared into wet boardwalk planks and caught in falling snow, with bloom, bokeh and grain. Anora runs from Brighton Beach's Cyrillic neon to a Vegas wedding sign, so the whole segment is lit by tubes.
films.desc_zh: 粉、青、橙的霓虹灯管发着光，倒影拖在湿栈道上，落进飘雪里，加上辉光、虚焦光斑和颗粒。《阿诺拉》从布莱顿海滩的俄文霓虹走到维加斯的婚礼招牌，整段都用灯管照亮。
films.prompt_en: Photographic 2D neon night. Real tubes: glass tube, glow, bright tube, white-hot core, clips, dark jumper wires; rare flicker (every 5–10 s). Neon pink #ff4fa8, cyan #4fdcff, orange #ff9a2e, green #3dff9a plus warm sodium light over a deep purple-blue night #1e1838. Put neon where the subject's world allows (shopfronts, a harbour bar, its own building). Wet ground fills the lower quarter: signs stretch into long vertical reflections broken by plank gaps, paving joints or ripples; snow falls and drifts at the edges, tinted by the spill. The subject keeps a warm key on the face (a lamp, a window, its own light), narrow neon rims on both sides; the distance melts into bokeh. Bloom, vignette, grain ±3%. Short 2–3 s shots, new angles on one place, each a slow push-in. Reference: Sean Baker, *Anora* (2024). Avoid: flat neon lettering, strobing.
films.prompt_zh: 照片感的 2D 霓虹夜景。招牌是真实灯管：玻璃管、辉光、亮管、白热管芯，带卡子和深色跳线；轻微起伏，很少抖一下（5–10 秒一次）。粉 #ff4fa8、青 #4fdcff、橙 #ff9a2e、绿 #3dff9a，加暖色钠灯，压在深紫蓝夜色 #1e1838 上。霓虹放在主体世界里说得通的地方（店面、港口酒吧、主体自己那栋楼）。画面下四分之一留给湿地面：招牌拉成长长的竖向倒影，被木板缝、地砖缝或水纹打断；雪在下，边上积成雪堆，被溢光染色。主体脸上保留暖色主光（来自近处的灯、窗或它自己的灯），两侧各一条窄霓虹轮廓光；远处虚成光斑。辉光、暗角、颗粒（±3%）。每个短镜头 2–3 秒，同一地点换角度，各自慢推。参照肖恩·贝克《阿诺拉》（2024）。避免：平涂彩字式霓虹、干地面、频闪。

shots.en: Long-lens shot of the lit Ferris wheel and the parachute tower over the sea, a New Year firework bursting; slow push-in.
shots.zh: 长焦拍海边亮灯的摩天轮和跳伞塔，一朵新年烟花炸开；镜头慢推。

shots.en: Cut to the snowy boardwalk under Cyrillic neon shop signs: Clawd in a fur trapper hat and collar stands in front, Vanya laughing and waving beside it, the signs reflected in the wet planks; slow pull-back.
shots.zh: 切到下雪的栈道，旁边一排俄文霓虹店招：戴毛皮护耳帽和毛领的 Clawd 站在前面，万尼亚在它旁边大笑挥手，招牌倒映在湿木板上；镜头慢慢拉开。

shots.en: Cut to Las Vegas: the heart-and-arrow "Wedding" sign and the CHAPEL light box fill the frame next to a white chapel; slow push-in.
shots.zh: 切到拉斯维加斯：心形穿箭的「Wedding」招牌和 CHAPEL 灯箱铺满画面，旁边是白色小教堂；镜头慢推。

shots.en: Cut to the final scene inside a parked car: Clawd sits on the dashboard against a windshield where snow falls and settles, Igor at the wheel in the foreground; slow push-in.
shots.zh: 切到最后一场戏，停着的车里：Clawd 坐在仪表台上，背后挡风玻璃上的雪落下、积住，伊戈尔在前景握着方向盘；镜头慢推。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Ani in a cream fur trapper hat, a standing fur collar and a big hoop earring. Four short shots on the beat, each with a slight push or pull: fireworks, the boardwalk with Vanya, the wedding sign, then the quiet car with snow.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮阿诺拉：奶油色毛皮护耳帽、竖起的毛领、一只大圆耳环。四个短镜头卡着拍子走，每个都带一点推拉：烟花、和万尼亚在栈道上、婚礼招牌，最后是安静的车里和落雪。

films.title: One Battle After Another
films.style_zh: 3D 起伏公路追车 · 长焦压缩
films.desc_en: A real-time 3D desert road that rises and falls like a roller coaster, three cars chasing over the dips, shot through extreme long lenses with heat haze, bleached sunlight and fine grain. It rebuilds the film's best-known sequence, the dip-road chase.
films.desc_zh: 实时 3D 的沙漠公路，像过山车一样一起一伏，三辆车翻着一道道坡追逐，用超长焦拍，带热浪、漂白的强光和细颗粒。复刻的是这部片最有名的段落：起伏公路追车。
films.prompt_en: Real-time 3D, bleached desert daylight. Signature shot (3–5 s): a straight road over rolling dips and crests at a 2–5° horizontal field of view, stacking dips into waves; the travelling subject sinks and reappears; sky a thin band at most. Then 1–2 s each, a low camera at a crest, a mount on the vehicle or rider. Palette: sky #7fb0e0, haze #ece4d2 only at the far horizon, pale sand #d2ae80 (never orange), hard sun #fff0d8 from high to one side, the main vehicle faded seafoam #86b5ad. Contrast: dark cracked asphalt, crisp shadows, dense green scrub, roadside posts. Default midday; at other hours keep hard sun. Heat shimmer and mirage grow with distance; dust on landings; vehicles leave the ground over crests. Grain ±2%. Reference: Paul Thomas Anderson, *One Battle After Another* (2025). Avoid: wide lenses, a washed-out frame.
films.prompt_zh: 实时 3D，漂白般的沙漠日光。招牌镜头（3–5 秒）：一条笔直的路在连续起伏的坡谷上，水平视角 2–5°，让坡谷叠成波浪，行进的主体沉下去又冒出来；构图先保坡谷，天空最多留一条窄带。再接各 1–2 秒的坡顶低机位、车载或骑手机位。配色：天空 #7fb0e0，雾气 #ece4d2 只在最远的地平线，浅沙色 #d2ae80（不能发橙），硬朗阳光 #fff0d8 从高处侧打，主车是褪色海沫绿 #86b5ad。反差来自前景：开裂的深色沥青、清晰阴影、茂密的绿灌木、路边桩。默认正午，其他时段也保持硬光。热浪扭曲和路面蜃景随距离加重；落地扬尘；车过坡顶腾空、落地弹跳。大画幅细颗粒（±2%）。参照保罗·托马斯·安德森《一战再战》（2025）。避免：广角、发白发灰的画面、粘在路上的车。

shots.en: Extreme long-lens shot looking back down the road from far ahead: the dips stacked into waves, the three cars sinking and rising through them, heat shimmer on the asphalt.
shots.zh: 超长焦从远处车队前方往回看公路：起伏压成一层层波浪，三辆车在波浪里沉下去又冒出来，柏油路面上热浪晃动。

shots.en: Cut to a hood-mounted shot of Clawd at the wheel of the seafoam convertible, sunglasses pushed up, gripping the wheel then glancing up at the mirror.
shots.zh: 切到引擎盖上的机位：Clawd 坐在海沫绿敞篷车的驾驶座，墨镜推在头顶，双手握紧方向盘，然后抬眼看后视镜。

shots.en: Cut to a low tripod on the shoulder at a crest: the convertible flies over the top toward the lens.
shots.zh: 切到坡顶路肩的低机位三脚架：敞篷车飞过坡顶，冲向镜头。

shots.en: Cut to the long lens again, now from behind the pack, the cars dipping out of sight and reappearing over the waves of road.
shots.zh: 再切回长焦，这次在车队后方往前看，几辆车在一道道起伏里消失又出现。

shots.en: Cut to a long-lens tracking shot from ahead: Clawd's convertible leaves the ground over a crest with the dark green and grey sedans closing in behind, lands, and Clawd raises one arm out of the car and holds it to the last frame.
shots.zh: 切到车前方的长焦跟拍：Clawd 的敞篷车翻过坡顶离地，深绿和灰色两辆轿车从后面追上来；落地后 Clawd 把一只手伸出车外举起，一直举到最后一帧。

films.direction_en: Clawd plays Bob with a plaid bathrobe collar and gold aviators pushed up on its head, driving the lead car. The chase runs at real speed through five set-ups, alternating long-lens waves with close moments; the last shot ends on Clawd's raised arm, a pose held still so the finale can pick it up.
films.direction_zh: Clawd 扮鲍勃：格子浴袍的翻领、推到头顶的金框墨镜，开着最前面那辆车。追车按真实速度走，五个机位在长焦的波浪和近处的瞬间之间交替；最后一个镜头停在 Clawd 举起的手臂上，这个姿势定住，好让终章接过去。
refs: Paul Thomas Anderson, One Battle After Another (2025)
